pbs:backup:restore:
    desc: "Restore app data from PBS backup (APP=n8n|etc, SNAPSHOT=latest or timestamp)"
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    cmds:
      - |
        source ./scripts/backup/containers.sh

        if ! app_exists "{{.APP}}"; then
          echo "Unknown app: {{.APP}}"
          print_app_list
          exit 1
        fi

        VMID=$(get_container_id "{{.APP}}")
        IP=$(cd tofu/apps/{{.APP}} && tofu output -raw ip_address 2>/dev/null || echo "")

        if [ -z "$IP" ]; then
          echo "Could not get IP for {{.APP}}."
          exit 1
        fi

        # Get snapshot to restore (default: latest)
        SNAPSHOT="{{.SNAPSHOT}}"
        if [ -z "$SNAPSHOT" ] || [ "$SNAPSHOT" = "latest" ]; then
          echo "Finding latest snapshot for {{.APP}} (lxc-$VMID)..."
          SNAPSHOT=$(ssh root@$IP "source /root/.pbs-backup-env && export PBS_PASSWORD && export PBS_FINGERPRINT && proxmox-backup-client snapshot list --repository \$PBS_REPOSITORY --ns lxc-$VMID --output-format json" | jq -r '.[-1]["backup-id"] + "/" + .[-1]["backup-time"]')
          if [ -z "$SNAPSHOT" ]; then
            echo "No snapshots found for lxc-$VMID"
            exit 1
          fi
        fi

        echo "=== PBS Restore for {{.APP}} (LXC $VMID) ==="
        echo "Snapshot: $SNAPSHOT"
        echo "Target: $IP"
        echo ""

        # Stop docker services first
        echo "Stopping Docker services..."
        ssh root@$IP "cd /config && docker compose down" || true

        echo ""
        echo "Restoring /config from PBS..."
        ssh root@$IP "source /root/.pbs-backup-env && export PBS_PASSWORD && export PBS_FINGERPRINT && proxmox-backup-client restore host/lxc-$VMID/$SNAPSHOT config.pxar /config --repository \$PBS_REPOSITORY --ns lxc-$VMID"

        echo ""
        echo "Restoring docker volume data from PBS..."
        ssh root@$IP "source /root/.pbs-backup-env && export PBS_PASSWORD && export PBS_FINGERPRINT && proxmox-backup-client restore host/lxc-$VMID/$SNAPSHOT _data.pxar /var/lib/docker/volumes/config_n8n_data/_data --repository \$PBS_REPOSITORY --ns lxc-$VMID" || echo "Note: Volume restore may fail if path doesn't exist yet"

        echo ""
        echo "Starting Docker services..."
        ssh root@$IP "cd /config && docker compose up -d"

        echo ""
        echo "=== Restore Complete ==="
        echo "Verify services at the app URL"

# Proxmox Backup Server Operations
# https://taskfile.dev
#
# PBS provides incremental, deduplicated backups for VMs and containers.
# Uses the community-scripts for installation.

version: '3'

tasks:
  pbs:install:
    desc: "Install PBS LXC container using community script (run on Proxmox)"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "=== Proxmox Backup Server Installation ==="
        echo ""
        echo "Run this command directly on your Proxmox host:"
        echo ""
        echo '  bash -c "$(wget -qLO - https://github.com/community-scripts/ProxmoxVE/raw/main/ct/proxmox-backup-server.sh)"'
        echo ""
        echo "Or SSH and run:"
        echo '  ssh root@homelab '"'"'bash -c "$(wget -qLO - https://github.com/community-scripts/ProxmoxVE/raw/main/ct/proxmox-backup-server.sh)"'"'"
        echo ""
        echo "Default settings: 2 cores, 2GB RAM, 10GB disk, Port 8007"

  pbs:status:
    desc: "Check PBS container status"
    cmds:
      - |
        PBS_ID=$(ssh root@homelab "pct list" | grep -i "proxmox-backup" | awk '{print $1}')
        if [ -z "$PBS_ID" ]; then
          echo "PBS container not found. Run 'task pbs:install' first."
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "PBS Container ID: $PBS_ID"
        ssh root@homelab "pct status $PBS_ID"
        PBS_IP=$(ssh root@homelab "pct exec $PBS_ID -- hostname -I" | awk '{print $1}')
        echo ""
        echo "Web UI: https://$PBS_IP:8007"

  pbs:logs:
    desc: "View PBS service logs"
    cmds:
      - |
        PBS_ID=$(ssh root@homelab "pct list" | grep -i "proxmox-backup" | awk '{print $1}')
        if [ -z "$PBS_ID" ]; then
          echo "PBS container not found."
          exit 1
        fi
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec $PBS_ID -- journalctl -u proxmox-backup-proxy -f"

  pbs:gc:
    desc: "Trigger garbage collection on PBS datastore"
    cmds:
      - |
        PBS_ID=$(ssh root@homelab "pct list" | grep -i "proxmox-backup" | awk '{print $1}')
        if [ -z "$PBS_ID" ]; then
          echo "PBS container not found."
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "Running garbage collection..."
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec $PBS_ID -- proxmox-backup-manager gc run homelab"

  pbs:prune:
    desc: "Trigger prune job on PBS datastore"
    cmds:
      - |
        PBS_ID=$(ssh root@homelab "pct list" | grep -i "proxmox-backup" | awk '{print $1}')
        if [ -z "$PBS_ID" ]; then
          echo "PBS container not found."
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "Running prune job..."
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec $PBS_ID -- proxmox-backup-manager prune run homelab"

  # ===========================================================================
  # PBS Client Backups (per-LXC backups via proxmox-backup-client)
  # ===========================================================================

  pbs:backup:
    desc: "Trigger manual PBS backup for an app (APP=dashboards|immich|etc)"
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    cmds:
      - |
        # Source container registry for ID lookup
        source ./scripts/backup/containers.sh

        if ! app_exists "{{.APP}}"; then
          echo "Unknown app: {{.APP}}"
          echo ""
          print_app_list
          exit 1
        fi

        VMID=$(get_container_id "{{.APP}}")

        # Get IP from tofu state
        IP=$(cd tofu/apps/{{.APP}} && tofu output -raw ip_address 2>/dev/null || echo "")

        if [ -z "$IP" ]; then
          echo "Could not get IP for {{.APP}}. Run 'task tofu:apply APP={{.APP}}' first."
          exit 1
        fi

        echo "Triggering PBS backup for {{.APP}} (LXC $VMID @ $IP)..."
        ssh root@$IP "systemctl start pbs-backup-$VMID.service"

        echo ""
        echo "Backup triggered. Waiting for completion..."
        sleep 3
        echo ""
        echo "=== Backup Log ==="
        ssh root@$IP "tail -30 /var/log/pbs-backups/lxc-$VMID.log"

  pbs:backup:status:
    desc: "Show PBS backup status for an app (APP=dashboards|immich|etc)"
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    cmds:
      - |
        source ./scripts/backup/containers.sh

        if ! app_exists "{{.APP}}"; then
          echo "Unknown app: {{.APP}}"
          echo ""
          print_app_list
          exit 1
        fi

        VMID=$(get_container_id "{{.APP}}")
        IP=$(cd tofu/apps/{{.APP}} && tofu output -raw ip_address 2>/dev/null || echo "")

        if [ -z "$IP" ]; then
          echo "Could not get IP for {{.APP}}."
          exit 1
        fi

        echo "=== PBS Backup Status for {{.APP}} (LXC $VMID) ==="
        echo ""
        ssh root@$IP "systemctl status pbs-backup-$VMID.timer --no-pager" 2>/dev/null || echo "Timer not found"
        echo ""
        echo "=== Next Scheduled Run ==="
        ssh root@$IP "systemctl list-timers pbs-backup-$VMID.timer --no-pager" 2>/dev/null || echo "Timer not found"
        echo ""
        echo "=== Recent Backup Log ==="
        ssh root@$IP "tail -30 /var/log/pbs-backups/lxc-$VMID.log 2>/dev/null || echo 'No backup log found'"

  pbs:backup:all:
    desc: "Trigger PBS backup for all apps"
    cmds:
      - |
        source ./scripts/backup/containers.sh
        FAILED=""
        for app in $(list_apps); do
          echo "========================================"
          echo "Backing up: $app"
          echo "========================================"
          if task pbs:backup APP=$app; then

# Disaster Recovery Runbook

This document describes how to recover an LXC container from a PBS (Proxmox Backup Server) backup when the container is lost or corrupted.

## Prerequisites

- PBS backups are running via the `lxc-sidecars` module (weekly timer per container)
- OpenTofu state files exist in `tofu/apps/<app>/`
- SSH access to the Proxmox host and PBS server

## Recovery Scenarios

| Scenario | State Action | Infrastructure | Data |
|----------|--------------|----------------|------|
| LXC deleted/gone | Rename state | `tofu apply` creates fresh | `pbs:backup:restore` |
| LXC corrupted but running | None | Stop and fix, or destroy+recreate | `pbs:backup:restore` |
| Data corruption only | None | None | `pbs:backup:restore` |

## Full Recovery Procedure (LXC Gone)

### Step 1: Rename OpenTofu State

This forces OpenTofu to recreate all resources from scratch.

```bash
cd tofu/apps/<APP>
mv terraform.tfstate terraform.tfstate.old
```

### Step 2: Recreate Infrastructure

```bash
task tofu:init APP=<APP>
task tofu:apply APP=<APP>
```

This will:
- Create new LXC container with same VMID
- Run Ansible to configure base system
- Deploy docker-compose and config files
- Start Docker containers (with empty/fresh data)
- Configure PBS backup client
- Deploy Pulse/Arcane agents

### Step 3: Fix SSH Host Key

The new LXC has a different SSH host key. Update your known_hosts:

```bash
# Get IP from tofu output
IP=$(cd tofu/apps/<APP> && tofu output -raw ip_address)

# Remove old key and add new one
ssh-keygen -R $IP
ssh-keyscan -H $IP >> ~/.ssh/known_hosts
```

### Step 4: Restore Data from PBS

```bash
task pbs:backup:restore APP=<APP>
```

This will:
- Stop Docker containers
- Restore `/config` directory from PBS backup
- Restore Docker volume data from PBS backup
- Start Docker containers

### Step 5: Verify and Cleanup

1. Check the app is working at its URL
2. Verify data is restored correctly
3. Clean up old state file:

```bash
rm tofu/apps/<APP>/terraform.tfstate.old
```

## Data-Only Recovery (LXC Running)

If the LXC is running but data is corrupted:

```bash
task pbs:backup:restore APP=<APP>
```

This stops containers, restores data, and restarts containers.

## Example: Recovering n8n

```bash
# 1. Rename state
mv tofu/apps/n8n/terraform.tfstate tofu/apps/n8n/terraform.tfstate.old

# 2. Recreate
task tofu:init APP=n8n
task tofu:apply APP=n8n

# 3. Fix SSH
ssh-keygen -R 10.100.5.102
ssh-keyscan -H 10.100.5.102 >> ~/.ssh/known_hosts

# 4. Restore data
task pbs:backup:restore APP=n8n

# 5. Verify
curl -s http://10.100.5.102:5678/healthz
# Should return: {"status":"ok"}

# 6. Cleanup
rm tofu/apps/n8n/terraform.tfstate.old
```

## Checking PBS Backups

### List available snapshots
```bash
task pbs:backup:list APP=<APP>
```

### Check backup status/timer
```bash
task pbs:backup:status APP=<APP>
```

### Trigger manual backup before recovery test
```bash
task pbs:backup APP=<APP>
```

## Troubleshooting

### "No snapshots found"
- Check PBS server is accessible: `ssh root@10.100.1.102`
- Verify namespace exists: `ls /mnt/datastore/ns/lxc-<VMID>/`
- Check backup timer is running: `systemctl status pbs-backup-<VMID>.timer`

### SSH connection refused after recreate
- Wait for LXC to fully boot (10-20 seconds)
- Check LXC is running: `ssh root@homelab "pct status <VMID>"`

### Volume restore fails
- Some apps don't have separate volume data (config-only)
- Check if `_data.pxar` exists in the snapshot

### State comparison (optional)
After recovery, compare old and new state to verify resources match:
```bash
cd tofu/apps/<APP>
tofu show -json terraform.tfstate > new.json
tofu show -json terraform.tfstate.old > old.json
# Compare VMID, IP, resource counts
jq '.values.root_module.resources | length' new.json old.json
```

## Container ID Reference

| App | VMID | IP |
|-----|------|-----|
| network-services | 101 | 10.100.1.101 |
| container-mgmt | 104 | 10.100.1.104 |
| traefik | 200 | 10.100.2.200 |
| dashboards | 201 | 10.100.2.201 |
| authelia | 202 | 10.100.2.202 |
| immich | 304 | 10.100.3.104 |
| jellyfin | 401 | 10.100.4.101 |
| media-management | 402 | 10.100.4.102 |
| monitoring | 500 | 10.100.5.100 |
| openwebui | 501 | 10.100.5.101 |
| n8n | 502 | 10.100.5.102 |
| obsidian-sync | 503 | 10.100.5.103 |
| documents | 504 | 10.100.5.104 |

# Disaster Recovery Runbook

## Overview

This document outlines procedures for recovering the homelab from various failure scenarios. For detailed backup information, see [backups.md](./backups.md).

## Quick Reference

| Scenario | RTO | RPO | Procedure |
|----------|-----|-----|-----------|
| Single container failure | 15 min | < 24 hrs | [Container Recovery](#single-container-recovery) |
| Proxmox host failure | 2-4 hrs | < 24 hrs | [Full Host Recovery](#full-host-recovery) |
| Database corruption | 30 min | < 24 hrs | [Database Recovery](#database-recovery) |
| Network services down | 5 min | N/A | [Network Recovery](#network-services-recovery) |

## Service Dependencies

### Recovery Order (Critical Path)

Recovery must follow this order due to service dependencies:

```
1. Proxmox VE host
   └── 2. Network Services (LXC 101) - AdGuard DNS
       └── 3. Traefik (LXC 200) - Reverse proxy
           └── 4. Authelia (LXC 202) - SSO/Auth
               └── 5. All other services
```

### Tier 1: Infrastructure (Recover First)

| ID | Service | IP | Dependencies | Critical For |
|----|---------|----|--------------|--------------|
| - | Proxmox VE | 192.168.1.215 | None | Everything |
| 101 | Network Services | 10.100.1.101 / 192.168.1.196 | Proxmox | DNS resolution |
| 200 | Traefik | 10.100.2.200 / 192.168.1.235 | DNS | HTTPS access to all services |
| 202 | Authelia | 10.100.2.202 | Traefik | Protected service access |

### Tier 2: Core Services

| ID | Service | IP | Dependencies |
|----|---------|----|--------------|
| 500 | Monitoring | 10.100.5.100 | Traefik |
| 201 | Dashboards | 10.100.2.201 | Traefik |

### Tier 3: Application Services

| ID | Service | IP | Dependencies |
|----|---------|----|--------------|
| 304 | Immich | 10.100.3.104 / 192.168.1.222 | Traefik, Authelia |
| 401 | Jellyfin | 10.100.4.101 / 192.168.1.226 | Traefik |
| 402 | Media Management | 10.100.4.102 | Traefik, Authelia, VPN (gluetun) |
| 501 | OpenWebUI | 10.100.5.101 | Traefik, Authelia |
| 502 | n8n | 10.100.5.102 | Traefik, Authelia |
| 503 | Obsidian Sync | 10.100.5.103 | Traefik |
| 504 | Documents | 10.100.5.104 | Traefik, Authelia |

## Recovery Procedures

### Single Container Recovery

**Time estimate: 15-30 minutes**

1. **Identify the failed container**

   ```bash
   ssh root@192.168.1.215 "pct list"
   ```

2. **Check available backups**

   ```bash
   task backup:list APP=<app-name>
   # Example: task backup:list APP=immich
   ```

3. **Restore to a new container ID** (safer - allows verification)

   ```bash
   task backup:restore BACKUP=<backup-file> TARGET_ID=<new-id>
   # Example: task backup:restore BACKUP=vzdump-lxc-304-2025_12_07-02_00_00.tar.zst TARGET_ID=350
   ```

4. **Verify the restored container**

   ```bash
   ssh root@192.168.1.215 "pct start <new-id>"
   # Check services are running
   ssh root@<container-ip> "docker ps"
   ```

5. **Swap containers** (if verification passes)

   ```bash
   # Stop original
   ssh root@192.168.1.215 "pct stop <original-id>"

   # Update network config on new container to use original IP
   # Then start new container
   ssh root@192.168.1.215 "pct start <new-id>"

   # If using OpenTofu, update state:
   task tofu:state:rm APP=<app> RESOURCE="module.<app>.module.lxc.proxmox_virtual_environment_container.lxc"
   ```

### Database Recovery

**Time estimate: 30 minutes**

#### Immich (PostgreSQL with pgvecto-rs)

```bash
# 1. List available dumps
ssh root@192.168.1.215 "ls -lh /tank/backups/database-dumps/immich-postgres-*"

# 2. Restore using task
task backup:immich:db:restore DUMP=immich-postgres-20251207_020000.sql.gz
```

#### Jellystat (PostgreSQL)

```bash
# 1. Copy dump to container
ssh root@192.168.1.215 "pct push 401 /tank/backups/database-dumps/jellystat-postgres-*.sql.gz /tmp/"

# 2. SSH to Jellyfin container
ssh root@10.100.4.101

# 3. Restore
docker exec -i jellystat-db psql -U jellystat -d jellystat < /tmp/jellystat-postgres-*.sql
```

#### SQLite Databases (OpenWebUI, n8n)

```bash
# Copy from backup dump directory to container
ssh root@192.168.1.215 "pct push 501 /tank/backups/database-dumps/openwebui-*.db /config/openwebui/webui.db"

# Restart the service
ssh root@10.100.5.101 "cd /config && docker compose restart"
```

### Network Services Recovery

**Time estimate: 5-10 minutes**

If DNS (AdGuard) is down, LAN devices cannot resolve homelab domains.

1. **Temporary workaround** - Use direct IPs:
   - Proxmox: https://192.168.1.215:8006
   - Traefik: http://192.168.1.235:8080 (dashboard)

2. **Recover AdGuard container**

   ```bash
   # Check container status
   ssh root@192.168.1.215 "pct status 101"

   # Start if stopped
   ssh root@192.168.1.215 "pct start 101"

   # Check AdGuard service
   ssh root@10.100.1.101 "docker ps"
   ssh root@10.100.1.101 "cd /config && docker compose up -d"
   ```

3. **Verify DNS resolution**

   ```bash
   dig @192.168.1.196 homepage.homelab.rambtech.dev
   ```

### Full Host Recovery

**Time estimate: 2-4 hours**

This procedure assumes complete Proxmox host failure requiring reinstall.

#### Phase 1: Proxmox Installation (30 min)

1. Boot from Proxmox ISO
2. Install to boot drive
3. Configure network:
   - IP: 192.168.1.215/24
   - Gateway: 192.168.1.1
   - DNS: 1.1.1.1 (temporarily)
4. Import ZFS pool:

   ```bash
   zpool import tank
   ```

#### Phase 2: Restore Configuration (30 min)

1. Clone the homelab repo:

   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/<user>/homelab.git
   cd homelab
   ```

2. Sync backup configuration:

   ```bash
   task backup:sync
   ```

3. Restore containers from local backups (if ZFS pool survived):

   ```bash
   # List available backups
   ls /tank/backups/vzdump/dump/

   # Restore each container - start with Tier 1
   pct restore 101 /tank/backups/vzdump/dump/vzdump-lxc-101-*.tar.zst
   pct restore 200 /tank/backups/vzdump/dump/vzdump-lxc-200-*.tar.zst
   # ... continue for all containers
   ```

#### Phase 3: Cloud Recovery (if local backups lost)

If ZFS pool is lost, restore from Backblaze B2:

1. Install rclone and configure with existing credentials:

   ```bash
   apt install rclone
   # Configure b2 and b2-crypt remotes
   ```

2. Download backups:

   ```bash
   rclone copy b2-crypt:vzdump /tank/backups/vzdump/dump/
   rclone copy b2-crypt:database-dumps /tank/backups/database-dumps/
   ```

3. Restore containers as in Phase 2

#### Phase 4: Verification (30 min)

1. Start containers in dependency order:

   ```bash
   pct start 101  # Network Services
   pct start 200  # Traefik
   pct start 202  # Authelia
   # ... rest of containers
   ```

2. Verify services:

   ```bash
   # DNS
   dig @192.168.1.196 homepage.homelab.rambtech.dev

   # Web services
   curl -k https://homepage.homelab.rambtech.dev
   ```

3. Re-apply OpenTofu if needed:

   ```bash
   task tofu:init APP=traefik
   task tofu:plan APP=traefik
   # Review and apply if needed
   ```

## Verification Checklist

After any recovery, verify:

- [ ] DNS resolution working (`dig @192.168.1.196 homepage.homelab.rambtech.dev`)
- [ ] Traefik dashboard accessible (https://traefik.homelab.rambtech.dev)
- [ ] Authelia login working
- [ ] Homepage loads and shows service status
- [ ] Immich accessible and photos loading
- [ ] Monitoring (Grafana) showing metrics
- [ ] Backups scheduled (`cat /etc/pve/jobs.cfg`)

## Preventive Measures

### Regular Testing

- Monthly: Test restore of one container to verify backups
- Quarterly: Full DR drill - document actual recovery time

### Monitoring Gaps to Address

- [ ] Add backup failure alerting (see proxmox-homelab-v9t)
- [ ] Add Prometheus scrape targets for all services (see proxmox-homelab-30m)

## Contact & Escalation

For issues beyond this runbook:

- Proxmox Forums: https://forum.proxmox.com/
- Backblaze Support: https://www.backblaze.com/help/

### Single Container Recovery (PBS - Recommended)

**Time estimate: 15-30 minutes**

This uses PBS (Proxmox Backup Server) incremental backups with OpenTofu for infrastructure recreation.

#### Step 1: Rename OpenTofu State

This forces OpenTofu to recreate all resources from scratch.

```bash
cd tofu/apps/<APP>
mv terraform.tfstate terraform.tfstate.old
```

#### Step 2: Recreate Infrastructure

```bash
task tofu:init APP=<APP>
task tofu:apply APP=<APP>
```

This will:
- Create new LXC container with same VMID
- Run Ansible to configure base system
- Deploy docker-compose and config files
- Start Docker containers (with empty/fresh data)
- Configure PBS backup client
- Deploy Pulse/Arcane agents

#### Step 3: Fix SSH Host Key

The new LXC has a different SSH host key. Update your known_hosts:

```bash
# Get IP from tofu output
IP=$(cd tofu/apps/<APP> && tofu output -raw ip_address)

# Remove old key and add new one
ssh-keygen -R $IP
ssh-keyscan -H $IP >> ~/.ssh/known_hosts
```

#### Step 4: Restore Data from PBS

```bash
task pbs:backup:restore APP=<APP>
```

This will:
- Stop Docker containers
- Restore `/config` directory from PBS backup
- Restore Docker volume data from PBS backup
- Start Docker containers

#### Step 5: Verify and Cleanup

1. Check the app is working at its URL
2. Verify data is restored correctly
3. Clean up old state file:

```bash
rm tofu/apps/<APP>/terraform.tfstate.old
```

#### Example: Recovering n8n

```bash
# 1. Rename state
mv tofu/apps/n8n/terraform.tfstate tofu/apps/n8n/terraform.tfstate.old

# 2. Recreate
task tofu:init APP=n8n
task tofu:apply APP=n8n

# 3. Fix SSH (IP: 10.100.5.102)
ssh-keygen -R 10.100.5.102
ssh-keyscan -H 10.100.5.102 >> ~/.ssh/known_hosts

# 4. Restore data
task pbs:backup:restore APP=n8n

# 5. Verify
curl -s http://10.100.5.102:5678/healthz
# Should return: {"status":"ok"}

# 6. Cleanup
rm tofu/apps/n8n/terraform.tfstate.old
```

### Single Container Recovery (vzdump - Legacy)

**Time estimate: 15-30 minutes**

This uses full vzdump container backups (older method).

1. **Identify the failed container**

   ```bash
   ssh root@192.168.1.215 "pct list"
   ```

2. **Check available backups**

   ```bash
   task backup:list APP=<app-name>
   # Example: task backup:list APP=immich
   ```

3. **Restore to a new container ID** (safer - allows verification)

   ```bash
   task backup:restore BACKUP=<backup-file> TARGET_ID=<new-id>

### Single Container Recovery (PBS - Recommended)

**Time estimate: 15-30 minutes**

This uses PBS (Proxmox Backup Server) incremental backups with OpenTofu for infrastructure recreation.

#### Step 1: Rename OpenTofu State

This forces OpenTofu to recreate all resources from scratch.

```bash
cd tofu/apps/<APP>
mv terraform.tfstate terraform.tfstate.old
```

#### Step 2: Recreate Infrastructure

```bash
task tofu:init APP=<APP>
task tofu:apply APP=<APP>
```

This will:
- Create new LXC container with same VMID
- Run Ansible to configure base system
- Deploy docker-compose and config files
- Start Docker containers (with empty/fresh data)
- Configure PBS backup client
- Deploy Pulse/Arcane agents

#### Step 3: Fix SSH Host Key

The new LXC has a different SSH host key. Update your known_hosts:

```bash
# Get IP from tofu output
IP=$(cd tofu/apps/<APP> && tofu output -raw ip_address)

# Remove old key and add new one
ssh-keygen -R $IP
ssh-keyscan -H $IP >> ~/.ssh/known_hosts
```

#### Step 4: Restore Data from PBS

```bash
task pbs:backup:restore APP=<APP>
```

This will:
- Stop Docker containers
- Restore `/config` directory from PBS backup
- Restore Docker volume data from PBS backup
- Start Docker containers

#### Step 5: Verify and Cleanup

1. Check the app is working at its URL
2. Verify data is restored correctly
3. Clean up old state file:

```bash
rm tofu/apps/<APP>/terraform.tfstate.old

# Disaster Recovery Runbook

## Overview

This document outlines procedures for recovering the homelab from various failure scenarios. For detailed backup information, see [backups.md](./backups.md).

## Quick Reference

| Scenario | RTO | RPO | Procedure |
|----------|-----|-----|-----------|
| Single container failure | 15 min | < 24 hrs | [Container Recovery](#single-container-recovery) |
| Proxmox host failure | 2-4 hrs | < 24 hrs | [Full Host Recovery](#full-host-recovery) |
| Database corruption | 30 min | < 24 hrs | [Database Recovery](#database-recovery) |
| Network services down | 5 min | N/A | [Network Recovery](#network-services-recovery) |

## Service Dependencies

### Recovery Order (Critical Path)

Recovery must follow this order due to service dependencies:

```
1. Proxmox VE host
   └── 2. Network Services (LXC 101) - AdGuard DNS
       └── 3. Traefik (LXC 200) - Reverse proxy
           └── 4. Authelia (LXC 202) - SSO/Auth
               └── 5. All other services
```

### Tier 1: Infrastructure (Recover First)

| ID | Service | IP | Dependencies | Critical For |
|----|---------|----|--------------|--------------|
| - | Proxmox VE | 192.168.1.215 | None | Everything |
| 101 | Network Services | 10.100.1.101 / 192.168.1.196 | Proxmox | DNS resolution |
| 200 | Traefik | 10.100.2.200 / 192.168.1.235 | DNS | HTTPS access to all services |
| 202 | Authelia | 10.100.2.202 | Traefik | Protected service access |

### Tier 2: Core Services

| ID | Service | IP | Dependencies |
|----|---------|----|--------------|
| 500 | Monitoring | 10.100.5.100 | Traefik |
| 201 | Dashboards | 10.100.2.201 | Traefik |

### Tier 3: Application Services

| ID | Service | IP | Dependencies |
|----|---------|----|--------------|
| 304 | Immich | 10.100.3.104 / 192.168.1.222 | Traefik, Authelia |
| 401 | Jellyfin | 10.100.4.101 / 192.168.1.226 | Traefik |
| 402 | Media Management | 10.100.4.102 | Traefik, Authelia, VPN (gluetun) |
| 501 | OpenWebUI | 10.100.5.101 | Traefik, Authelia |
| 502 | n8n | 10.100.5.102 | Traefik, Authelia |
| 503 | Obsidian Sync | 10.100.5.103 | Traefik |
| 504 | Documents | 10.100.5.104 | Traefik, Authelia |

## Recovery Procedures

### Single Container Recovery

**Time estimate: 15-30 minutes**

1. **Identify the failed container**

   ```bash
   ssh root@192.168.1.215 "pct list"
   ```

2. **Check available backups**

   ```bash
   task backup:list APP=<app-name>
   # Example: task backup:list APP=immich
   ```

3. **Restore to a new container ID** (safer - allows verification)

   ```bash
   task backup:restore BACKUP=<backup-file> TARGET_ID=<new-id>
   # Example: task backup:restore BACKUP=vzdump-lxc-304-2025_12_07-02_00_00.tar.zst TARGET_ID=350
   ```

4. **Verify the restored container**

   ```bash
   ssh root@192.168.1.215 "pct start <new-id>"
   # Check services are running
   ssh root@<container-ip> "docker ps"
   ```

5. **Swap containers** (if verification passes)

   ```bash
   # Stop original
   ssh root@192.168.1.215 "pct stop <original-id>"

   # Update network config on new container to use original IP
   # Then start new container
   ssh root@192.168.1.215 "pct start <new-id>"

   # If using OpenTofu, update state:
   task tofu:state:rm APP=<app> RESOURCE="module.<app>.module.lxc.proxmox_virtual_environment_container.lxc"
   ```

### Database Recovery

**Time estimate: 30 minutes**

#### Immich (PostgreSQL with pgvecto-rs)

```bash
# 1. List available dumps
ssh root@192.168.1.215 "ls -lh /tank/backups/database-dumps/immich-postgres-*"

# 2. Restore using task
task backup:immich:db:restore DUMP=immich-postgres-20251207_020000.sql.gz
```

#### Jellystat (PostgreSQL)

```bash
# 1. Copy dump to container
ssh root@192.168.1.215 "pct push 401 /tank/backups/database-dumps/jellystat-postgres-*.sql.gz /tmp/"

# 2. SSH to Jellyfin container
ssh root@10.100.4.101

# 3. Restore
docker exec -i jellystat-db psql -U jellystat -d jellystat < /tmp/jellystat-postgres-*.sql
```

#### SQLite Databases (OpenWebUI, n8n)

```bash
# Copy from backup dump directory to container
ssh root@192.168.1.215 "pct push 501 /tank/backups/database-dumps/openwebui-*.db /config/openwebui/webui.db"

# Restart the service
ssh root@10.100.5.101 "cd /config && docker compose restart"
```

### Network Services Recovery

**Time estimate: 5-10 minutes**

If DNS (AdGuard) is down, LAN devices cannot resolve homelab domains.

1. **Temporary workaround** - Use direct IPs:
   - Proxmox: https://192.168.1.215:8006
   - Traefik: http://192.168.1.235:8080 (dashboard)

2. **Recover AdGuard container**

   ```bash
   # Check container status
   ssh root@192.168.1.215 "pct status 101"

   # Start if stopped
   ssh root@192.168.1.215 "pct start 101"

   # Check AdGuard service
   ssh root@10.100.1.101 "docker ps"
   ssh root@10.100.1.101 "cd /config && docker compose up -d"
   ```

3. **Verify DNS resolution**

   ```bash
   dig @192.168.1.196 homepage.homelab.rambtech.dev
   ```

### Full Host Recovery

**Time estimate: 2-4 hours**

This procedure assumes complete Proxmox host failure requiring reinstall.

#### Phase 1: Proxmox Installation (30 min)

1. Boot from Proxmox ISO
2. Install to boot drive
3. Configure network:
   - IP: 192.168.1.215/24
   - Gateway: 192.168.1.1
   - DNS: 1.1.1.1 (temporarily)
4. Import ZFS pool:

   ```bash
   zpool import tank
   ```

#### Phase 2: Restore Configuration (30 min)

1. Clone the homelab repo:

   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/<user>/homelab.git
   cd homelab
   ```

2. Sync backup configuration:

   ```bash
   task backup:sync
   ```

3. Restore containers from local backups (if ZFS pool survived):

   ```bash
   # List available backups
   ls /tank/backups/vzdump/dump/

   # Restore each container - start with Tier 1
   pct restore 101 /tank/backups/vzdump/dump/vzdump-lxc-101-*.tar.zst
   pct restore 200 /tank/backups/vzdump/dump/vzdump-lxc-200-*.tar.zst
   # ... continue for all containers
   ```

#### Phase 3: Cloud Recovery (if local backups lost)

If ZFS pool is lost, restore from Backblaze B2:

1. Install rclone and configure with existing credentials:

   ```bash
   apt install rclone
   # Configure b2 and b2-crypt remotes
   ```

2. Download backups:

   ```bash
   rclone copy b2-crypt:vzdump /tank/backups/vzdump/dump/
   rclone copy b2-crypt:database-dumps /tank/backups/database-dumps/
   ```

3. Restore containers as in Phase 2

#### Phase 4: Verification (30 min)

1. Start containers in dependency order:

   ```bash
   pct start 101  # Network Services
   pct start 200  # Traefik
   pct start 202  # Authelia
   # ... rest of containers
   ```

2. Verify services:

   ```bash
   # DNS
   dig @192.168.1.196 homepage.homelab.rambtech.dev

   # Web services
   curl -k https://homepage.homelab.rambtech.dev
   ```

3. Re-apply OpenTofu if needed:

   ```bash
   task tofu:init APP=traefik
   task tofu:plan APP=traefik
   # Review and apply if needed
   ```

## Verification Checklist

After any recovery, verify:

- [ ] DNS resolution working (`dig @192.168.1.196 homepage.homelab.rambtech.dev`)
- [ ] Traefik dashboard accessible (https://traefik.homelab.rambtech.dev)
- [ ] Authelia login working
- [ ] Homepage loads and shows service status
- [ ] Immich accessible and photos loading
- [ ] Monitoring (Grafana) showing metrics
- [ ] Backups scheduled (`cat /etc/pve/jobs.cfg`)

## Preventive Measures

### Regular Testing

- Monthly: Test restore of one container to verify backups
- Quarterly: Full DR drill - document actual recovery time

### Monitoring Gaps to Address

- [ ] Add backup failure alerting (see proxmox-homelab-v9t)
- [ ] Add Prometheus scrape targets for all services (see proxmox-homelab-30m)

## Contact & Escalation

For issues beyond this runbook:

- Proxmox Forums: https://forum.proxmox.com/
- Backblaze Support: https://www.backblaze.com/help/

    desc: "Restore app data from PBS backup (APP=n8n|etc, SNAPSHOT=latest or timestamp)"
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    cmds:
      - |
        source ./scripts/backup/containers.sh

        if ! app_exists "{{.APP}}"; then
          echo "Unknown app: {{.APP}}"
          print_app_list
          exit 1
        fi

        VMID=$(get_container_id "{{.APP}}")
        IP=$(cd tofu/apps/{{.APP}} && tofu output -raw ip_address 2>/dev/null || echo "")

        if [ -z "$IP" ]; then
          echo "Could not get IP for {{.APP}}."
          exit 1
        fi

        # Get snapshot to restore (default: latest)
        SNAPSHOT="{{.SNAPSHOT}}"
        if [ -z "$SNAPSHOT" ] || [ "$SNAPSHOT" = "latest" ]; then
          echo "Finding latest snapshot for {{.APP}} (lxc-$VMID)..."
          SNAPSHOT=$(ssh root@$IP "source /root/.pbs-backup-env && export PBS_PASSWORD && export PBS_FINGERPRINT && proxmox-backup-client snapshot list --repository \$PBS_REPOSITORY --ns lxc-$VMID --output-format json" | jq -r '.[-1]["backup-id"] + "/" + .[-1]["backup-time"]')
          if [ -z "$SNAPSHOT" ]; then
            echo "No snapshots found for lxc-$VMID"
            exit 1
          fi
        fi

        echo "=== PBS Restore for {{.APP}} (LXC $VMID) ==="
        echo "Snapshot: $SNAPSHOT"
        echo "Target: $IP"
        echo ""

        # Stop docker services first
        echo "Stopping Docker services..."

# Proxmox Backup Server Operations
# https://taskfile.dev
#
# PBS provides incremental, deduplicated backups for VMs and containers.
# Uses the community-scripts for installation.

version: '3'

tasks:
  pbs:install:
    desc: "Install PBS LXC container using community script (run on Proxmox)"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "=== Proxmox Backup Server Installation ==="
        echo ""
        echo "Run this command directly on your Proxmox host:"
        echo ""
        echo '  bash -c "$(wget -qLO - https://github.com/community-scripts/ProxmoxVE/raw/main/ct/proxmox-backup-server.sh)"'
        echo ""
        echo "Or SSH and run:"
        echo '  ssh root@homelab '"'"'bash -c "$(wget -qLO - https://github.com/community-scripts/ProxmoxVE/raw/main/ct/proxmox-backup-server.sh)"'"'"
        echo ""
        echo "Default settings: 2 cores, 2GB RAM, 10GB disk, Port 8007"

  pbs:status:
    desc: "Check PBS container status"
    cmds:
      - |
        PBS_ID=$(ssh root@homelab "pct list" | grep -i "proxmox-backup" | awk '{print $1}')
        if [ -z "$PBS_ID" ]; then
          echo "PBS container not found. Run 'task pbs:install' first."
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "PBS Container ID: $PBS_ID"
        ssh root@homelab "pct status $PBS_ID"
        PBS_IP=$(ssh root@homelab "pct exec $PBS_ID -- hostname -I" | awk '{print $1}')
        echo ""
        echo "Web UI: https://$PBS_IP:8007"

  pbs:logs:
    desc: "View PBS service logs"
    cmds:
      - |
        PBS_ID=$(ssh root@homelab "pct list" | grep -i "proxmox-backup" | awk '{print $1}')
        if [ -z "$PBS_ID" ]; then
          echo "PBS container not found."
          exit 1
        fi
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec $PBS_ID -- journalctl -u proxmox-backup-proxy -f"

  pbs:gc:
    desc: "Trigger garbage collection on PBS datastore"
    cmds:
      - |
        PBS_ID=$(ssh root@homelab "pct list" | grep -i "proxmox-backup" | awk '{print $1}')
        if [ -z "$PBS_ID" ]; then
          echo "PBS container not found."
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "Running garbage collection..."
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec $PBS_ID -- proxmox-backup-manager gc run homelab"

  pbs:prune:
    desc: "Trigger prune job on PBS datastore"
    cmds:
      - |
        PBS_ID=$(ssh root@homelab "pct list" | grep -i "proxmox-backup" | awk '{print $1}')
        if [ -z "$PBS_ID" ]; then
          echo "PBS container not found."
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "Running prune job..."
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec $PBS_ID -- proxmox-backup-manager prune run homelab"

  # ===========================================================================
  # PBS Client Backups (per-LXC backups via proxmox-backup-client)
  # ===========================================================================

  pbs:backup:
    desc: "Trigger manual PBS backup for an app (APP=dashboards|immich|etc)"
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    cmds:
      - |
        # Source container registry for ID lookup
        source ./scripts/backup/containers.sh

        if ! app_exists "{{.APP}}"; then
          echo "Unknown app: {{.APP}}"
          echo ""
          print_app_list
          exit 1
        fi

        VMID=$(get_container_id "{{.APP}}")

        # Get IP from tofu state
        IP=$(cd tofu/apps/{{.APP}} && tofu output -raw ip_address 2>/dev/null || echo "")

        if [ -z "$IP" ]; then
          echo "Could not get IP for {{.APP}}. Run 'task tofu:apply APP={{.APP}}' first."
          exit 1
        fi

        echo "Triggering PBS backup for {{.APP}} (LXC $VMID @ $IP)..."
        ssh root@$IP "systemctl start pbs-backup-$VMID.service"

        echo ""
        echo "Backup triggered. Waiting for completion..."
        sleep 3
        echo ""
        echo "=== Backup Log ==="
        ssh root@$IP "tail -30 /var/log/pbs-backups/lxc-$VMID.log"

  pbs:backup:status:
    desc: "Show PBS backup status for an app (APP=dashboards|immich|etc)"
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    cmds:
      - |
        source ./scripts/backup/containers.sh

        if ! app_exists "{{.APP}}"; then
          echo "Unknown app: {{.APP}}"
          echo ""
          print_app_list
          exit 1
        fi

        VMID=$(get_container_id "{{.APP}}")
        IP=$(cd tofu/apps/{{.APP}} && tofu output -raw ip_address 2>/dev/null || echo "")

        if [ -z "$IP" ]; then
          echo "Could not get IP for {{.APP}}."
          exit 1
        fi

        echo "=== PBS Backup Status for {{.APP}} (LXC $VMID) ==="
        echo ""
        ssh root@$IP "systemctl status pbs-backup-$VMID.timer --no-pager" 2>/dev/null || echo "Timer not found"
        echo ""
        echo "=== Next Scheduled Run ==="
        ssh root@$IP "systemctl list-timers pbs-backup-$VMID.timer --no-pager" 2>/dev/null || echo "Timer not found"
        echo ""
        echo "=== Recent Backup Log ==="
        ssh root@$IP "tail -30 /var/log/pbs-backups/lxc-$VMID.log 2>/dev/null || echo 'No backup log found'"

  pbs:backup:all:
    desc: "Trigger PBS backup for all apps"
    cmds:
      - |
        source ./scripts/backup/containers.sh
        FAILED=""
        for app in $(list_apps); do
          echo "========================================"
          echo "Backing up: $app"
          echo "========================================"
          if task pbs:backup APP=$app; then
            echo "✓ $app backup complete"
          else
            echo "✗ $app backup failed"
            FAILED="$FAILED $app"
          fi
          echo ""
        done

        if [ -n "$FAILED" ]; then
          echo "========================================"
          echo "Failed backups:$FAILED"
          echo "========================================"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "All backups completed successfully!"

  pbs:backup:list:
    desc: "List PBS snapshots for an app (APP=dashboards|immich|etc)"
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    cmds:
      - |
        source ./scripts/backup/containers.sh

        if ! app_exists "{{.APP}}"; then
          echo "Unknown app: {{.APP}}"
          print_app_list
          exit 1
        fi

        VMID=$(get_container_id "{{.APP}}")
        echo "=== PBS Snapshots for {{.APP}} (namespace: lxc-$VMID) ==="
        ssh root@10.100.1.102 "ls -la /mnt/datastore/ns/lxc-$VMID/host/lxc-$VMID/ 2>/dev/null" || \
          echo "No snapshots found for lxc-$VMID"

  pbs:backup:restore:
    desc: "Restore app data from PBS backup (APP=n8n|etc, SNAPSHOT=latest or timestamp)"
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    cmds:
      - |
        source ./scripts/backup/containers.sh

        if ! app_exists "{{.APP}}"; then
          echo "Unknown app: {{.APP}}"
          print_app_list
          exit 1
        fi

        VMID=$(get_container_id "{{.APP}}")
        IP=$(cd tofu/apps/{{.APP}} && tofu output -raw ip_address 2>/dev/null || echo "")

        if [ -z "$IP" ]; then
          echo "Could not get IP for {{.APP}}."
          exit 1
        fi

        # Get snapshot to restore (default: latest)
        SNAPSHOT="{{.SNAPSHOT}}"
        if [ -z "$SNAPSHOT" ] || [ "$SNAPSHOT" = "latest" ]; then
          echo "Finding latest snapshot for {{.APP}} (lxc-$VMID)..."
          SNAPSHOT=$(ssh root@$IP "source /root/.pbs-backup-env && export PBS_PASSWORD && export PBS_FINGERPRINT && proxmox-backup-client snapshot list --repository \$PBS_REPOSITORY --ns lxc-$VMID --output-format json" | jq -r '.[-1]["backup-id"] + "/" + .[-1]["backup-time"]')
          if [ -z "$SNAPSHOT" ]; then
            echo "No snapshots found for lxc-$VMID"
            exit 1
          fi
        fi

        echo "=== PBS Restore for {{.APP}} (LXC $VMID) ==="
        echo "Snapshot: $SNAPSHOT"
        echo "Target: $IP"
        echo ""

        # Stop docker services first
        echo "Stopping Docker services..."
        ssh root@$IP "cd /config && docker compose down" || true

        echo ""
        echo "Restoring /config from PBS..."
        ssh root@$IP "source /root/.pbs-backup-env && export PBS_PASSWORD && export PBS_FINGERPRINT && proxmox-backup-client restore host/lxc-$VMID/$SNAPSHOT config.pxar /config --repository \$PBS_REPOSITORY --ns lxc-$VMID --overwrite-files true --allow-existing-dirs true"

        echo ""
        echo "Restoring docker volume data from PBS..."
        # Find the first docker volume that exists (apps use different volume names)
        VOLUME_PATH=$(ssh root@$IP "ls -d /var/lib/docker/volumes/config_*/_data 2>/dev/null | head -1")
        if [ -n "$VOLUME_PATH" ]; then
          ssh root@$IP "source /root/.pbs-backup-env && export PBS_PASSWORD && export PBS_FINGERPRINT && proxmox-backup-client restore host/lxc-$VMID/$SNAPSHOT _data.pxar $VOLUME_PATH --repository \$PBS_REPOSITORY --ns lxc-$VMID --overwrite-files true --allow-existing-dirs true" || echo "Note: Volume restore failed - check if _data.pxar exists in snapshot"
        else
          echo "No docker volume found - skipping volume restore"
        fi

        echo ""
        echo "Starting Docker services..."
        ssh root@$IP "cd /config && docker compose up -d"

        echo ""
        echo "=== Restore Complete ==="
        echo "Verify services at the app URL"

# Proxmox Backup Server Operations
# https://taskfile.dev
#
# PBS provides incremental, deduplicated backups for VMs and containers.
# Uses the community-scripts for installation.

version: '3'

tasks:
  pbs:install:
    desc: "Install PBS LXC container using community script (run on Proxmox)"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "=== Proxmox Backup Server Installation ==="
        echo ""
        echo "Run this command directly on your Proxmox host:"
        echo ""
        echo '  bash -c "$(wget -qLO - https://github.com/community-scripts/ProxmoxVE/raw/main/ct/proxmox-backup-server.sh)"'
        echo ""
        echo "Or SSH and run:"
        echo '  ssh root@homelab '"'"'bash -c "$(wget -qLO - https://github.com/community-scripts/ProxmoxVE/raw/main/ct/proxmox-backup-server.sh)"'"'"
        echo ""
        echo "Default settings: 2 cores, 2GB RAM, 10GB disk, Port 8007"

  pbs:status:
    desc: "Check PBS container status"
    cmds:
      - |
        PBS_ID=$(ssh root@homelab "pct list" | grep -i "proxmox-backup" | awk '{print $1}')
        if [ -z "$PBS_ID" ]; then
          echo "PBS container not found. Run 'task pbs:install' first."
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "PBS Container ID: $PBS_ID"
        ssh root@homelab "pct status $PBS_ID"
        PBS_IP=$(ssh root@homelab "pct exec $PBS_ID -- hostname -I" | awk '{print $1}')
        echo ""
        echo "Web UI: https://$PBS_IP:8007"

  pbs:logs:
    desc: "View PBS service logs"
    cmds:
      - |
        PBS_ID=$(ssh root@homelab "pct list" | grep -i "proxmox-backup" | awk '{print $1}')
        if [ -z "$PBS_ID" ]; then
          echo "PBS container not found."
          exit 1
        fi
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec $PBS_ID -- journalctl -u proxmox-backup-proxy -f"

  pbs:gc:
    desc: "Trigger garbage collection on PBS datastore"
    cmds:
      - |
        PBS_ID=$(ssh root@homelab "pct list" | grep -i "proxmox-backup" | awk '{print $1}')
        if [ -z "$PBS_ID" ]; then
          echo "PBS container not found."
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "Running garbage collection..."
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec $PBS_ID -- proxmox-backup-manager gc run homelab"

  pbs:prune:
    desc: "Trigger prune job on PBS datastore"
    cmds:
      - |
        PBS_ID=$(ssh root@homelab "pct list" | grep -i "proxmox-backup" | awk '{print $1}')
        if [ -z "$PBS_ID" ]; then
          echo "PBS container not found."
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "Running prune job..."
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec $PBS_ID -- proxmox-backup-manager prune run homelab"

  # ===========================================================================
  # PBS Client Backups (per-LXC backups via proxmox-backup-client)
  # ===========================================================================

  pbs:backup:
    desc: "Trigger manual PBS backup for an app (APP=dashboards|immich|etc)"
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    cmds:
      - |
        # Source container registry for ID lookup
        source ./scripts/backup/containers.sh

        if ! app_exists "{{.APP}}"; then
          echo "Unknown app: {{.APP}}"
          echo ""
          print_app_list
          exit 1
        fi

        VMID=$(get_container_id "{{.APP}}")

        # Get IP from tofu state
        IP=$(cd tofu/apps/{{.APP}} && tofu output -raw ip_address 2>/dev/null || echo "")

        if [ -z "$IP" ]; then
          echo "Could not get IP for {{.APP}}. Run 'task tofu:apply APP={{.APP}}' first."
          exit 1
        fi

        echo "Triggering PBS backup for {{.APP}} (LXC $VMID @ $IP)..."
        ssh root@$IP "systemctl start pbs-backup-$VMID.service"

        echo ""
        echo "Backup triggered. Waiting for completion..."
        sleep 3
        echo ""
        echo "=== Backup Log ==="
        ssh root@$IP "tail -30 /var/log/pbs-backups/lxc-$VMID.log"

  pbs:backup:status:
    desc: "Show PBS backup status for an app (APP=dashboards|immich|etc)"
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    cmds:
      - |
        source ./scripts/backup/containers.sh

        if ! app_exists "{{.APP}}"; then
          echo "Unknown app: {{.APP}}"
          echo ""
          print_app_list
          exit 1
        fi

        VMID=$(get_container_id "{{.APP}}")
        IP=$(cd tofu/apps/{{.APP}} && tofu output -raw ip_address 2>/dev/null || echo "")

        if [ -z "$IP" ]; then
          echo "Could not get IP for {{.APP}}."
          exit 1
        fi

        echo "=== PBS Backup Status for {{.APP}} (LXC $VMID) ==="
        echo ""
        ssh root@$IP "systemctl status pbs-backup-$VMID.timer --no-pager" 2>/dev/null || echo "Timer not found"
        echo ""
        echo "=== Next Scheduled Run ==="
        ssh root@$IP "systemctl list-timers pbs-backup-$VMID.timer --no-pager" 2>/dev/null || echo "Timer not found"
        echo ""
        echo "=== Recent Backup Log ==="
        ssh root@$IP "tail -30 /var/log/pbs-backups/lxc-$VMID.log 2>/dev/null || echo 'No backup log found'"

  pbs:backup:all:
    desc: "Trigger PBS backup for all apps"
    cmds:
      - |
        source ./scripts/backup/containers.sh
        FAILED=""
        for app in $(list_apps); do
          echo "========================================"
          echo "Backing up: $app"
          echo "========================================"
          if task pbs:backup APP=$app; then
            echo "✓ $app backup complete"
          else
            echo "✗ $app backup failed"
            FAILED="$FAILED $app"
          fi
          echo ""
        done

        if [ -n "$FAILED" ]; then
          echo "========================================"
          echo "Failed backups:$FAILED"
          echo "========================================"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "All backups completed successfully!"

  pbs:backup:list:
    desc: "List PBS snapshots for an app (APP=dashboards|immich|etc)"
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    cmds:
      - |
        source ./scripts/backup/containers.sh

        if ! app_exists "{{.APP}}"; then
          echo "Unknown app: {{.APP}}"
          print_app_list
          exit 1
        fi

        VMID=$(get_container_id "{{.APP}}")
        echo "=== PBS Snapshots for {{.APP}} (namespace: lxc-$VMID) ==="
        ssh root@10.100.1.102 "ls -la /mnt/datastore/ns/lxc-$VMID/host/lxc-$VMID/ 2>/dev/null" || \
          echo "No snapshots found for lxc-$VMID"

  pbs:backup:restore:
    desc: "Restore app data from PBS backup (APP=n8n|etc, SNAPSHOT=latest or timestamp)"
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    cmds:
      - |
        source ./scripts/backup/containers.sh

        if ! app_exists "{{.APP}}"; then
          echo "Unknown app: {{.APP}}"
          print_app_list
          exit 1
        fi

        VMID=$(get_container_id "{{.APP}}")
        IP=$(cd tofu/apps/{{.APP}} && tofu output -raw ip_address 2>/dev/null || echo "")

        if [ -z "$IP" ]; then
          echo "Could not get IP for {{.APP}}."
          exit 1
        fi

        # Get snapshot to restore (default: latest)
        SNAPSHOT="{{.SNAPSHOT}}"
        if [ -z "$SNAPSHOT" ] || [ "$SNAPSHOT" = "latest" ]; then
          echo "Finding latest snapshot for {{.APP}} (lxc-$VMID)..."
          # Get the latest backup timestamp and convert to ISO8601 format
          LATEST_TS=$(ssh root@$IP "source /root/.pbs-backup-env && export PBS_PASSWORD && export PBS_FINGERPRINT && proxmox-backup-client snapshot list --repository \$PBS_REPOSITORY --ns lxc-$VMID --output-format json" | jq -r '.[-1]["backup-time"]')
          if [ -z "$LATEST_TS" ]; then
            echo "No snapshots found for lxc-$VMID"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Convert Unix timestamp to ISO8601 format (PBS requires this format)
          SNAPSHOT_TIME=$(date -u -r $LATEST_TS +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
          SNAPSHOT="lxc-$VMID/$SNAPSHOT_TIME"
          echo "Latest snapshot timestamp: $LATEST_TS -> $SNAPSHOT_TIME"
        fi

        echo "=== PBS Restore for {{.APP}} (LXC $VMID) ==="
        echo "Snapshot: $SNAPSHOT"
        echo "Target: $IP"
        echo ""

        # Stop docker services first
        echo "Stopping Docker services..."
        ssh root@$IP "cd /config && docker compose down" || true

        echo ""
        echo "Restoring /config from PBS..."
        ssh root@$IP "source /root/.pbs-backup-env && export PBS_PASSWORD && export PBS_FINGERPRINT && proxmox-backup-client restore host/lxc-$VMID/$SNAPSHOT config.pxar /config --repository \$PBS_REPOSITORY --ns lxc-$VMID --overwrite-files true --allow-existing-dirs true"

        echo ""
        echo "Restoring docker volume data from PBS..."
        # Find the first docker volume that exists (apps use different volume names)
        VOLUME_PATH=$(ssh root@$IP "ls -d /var/lib/docker/volumes/config_*/_data 2>/dev/null | head -1")
        if [ -n "$VOLUME_PATH" ]; then
          ssh root@$IP "source /root/.pbs-backup-env && export PBS_PASSWORD && export PBS_FINGERPRINT && proxmox-backup-client restore host/lxc-$VMID/$SNAPSHOT _data.pxar $VOLUME_PATH --repository \$PBS_REPOSITORY --ns lxc-$VMID --overwrite-files true --allow-existing-dirs true" || echo "Note: Volume restore failed - check if _data.pxar exists in snapshot"
        else
          echo "No docker volume found - skipping volume restore"
        fi

        echo ""
        echo "Starting Docker services..."
        ssh root@$IP "cd /config && docker compose up -d"

        echo ""
        echo "=== Restore Complete ==="
        echo "Verify services at the app URL"

tofu:state:compare:
    desc: "Compare current state with .old backup (APP) - for DR validation"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - |
        if [ ! -f terraform.tfstate.old ]; then
          echo "No terraform.tfstate.old found - nothing to compare"
          exit 0
        fi

        echo "=== Comparing state files for {{.APP}} ==="
        echo ""

        # Get current state resources
        tofu state list > /tmp/tofu_new_state.txt

        # Swap to old state, get resources, swap back
        mv terraform.tfstate terraform.tfstate.new
        mv terraform.tfstate.old terraform.tfstate
        tofu state list > /tmp/tofu_old_state.txt
        mv terraform.tfstate terraform.tfstate.old
        mv terraform.tfstate.new terraform.tfstate

        # Compare
        echo "Old state: $(wc -l < /tmp/tofu_old_state.txt | tr -d ' ') resources"
        echo "New state: $(wc -l < /tmp/tofu_new_state.txt | tr -d ' ') resources"
        echo ""

        if diff /tmp/tofu_old_state.txt /tmp/tofu_new_state.txt > /dev/null; then
          echo "✓ IDENTICAL - Same resources tracked in both states"
        else
          echo "✗ DIFFERENT - Resource lists differ:"
          echo ""
          diff /tmp/tofu_old_state.txt /tmp/tofu_new_state.txt || true
        fi

# OpenTofu IaC Commands
# https://taskfile.dev
#
# Each app has its own state file in tofu/apps/<app>/
# Use APP=dashboards|openwebui|etc to specify which app

version: '3'

vars:
  TOFU_DIR: "tofu"

tasks:
  tofu:init:
    desc: "Initialize OpenTofu for an app (APP=dashboards|openwebui)"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu init
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:plan:
    desc: "Plan infrastructure changes for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - pwd
      - tofu plan -out=tfplan
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    preconditions:
      - sh: test -d .terraform
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:init APP={{.APP}}' first"

  tofu:apply:
    desc: "Apply planned infrastructure changes for an app (optional: REPLACE='resource.name')"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu apply {{if .REPLACE}}-replace='{{.REPLACE}}' -auto-approve{{else}}tfplan{{end}}
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    preconditions:
      - sh: '{{if .REPLACE}}true{{else}}test -f tfplan{{end}}'
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:plan APP={{.APP}}' first"

  tofu:destroy:
    desc: "Destroy an app's infrastructure"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - echo "⚠️  This will destroy {{.APP}} infrastructure!"
      - tofu destroy
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    prompt: "Are you sure you want to destroy {{.APP}}?"

  tofu:output:
    desc: "Show infrastructure outputs for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu output
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:state:
    desc: "List all resources in an app's state"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu state list
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:state:rm:
    desc: "Remove a resource from state (APP, RESOURCE)"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu state rm '{{.RESOURCE}}'
    requires:
      vars: [APP, RESOURCE]

  tofu:import:
    desc: "Import existing resource into state (APP, ADDR, ID)"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu import '{{.ADDR}}' '{{.ID}}'
    requires:
      vars: [APP, ADDR, ID]

  tofu:show:
    desc: "Show saved plan details for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu show tfplan
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    preconditions:
      - sh: test -f tfplan
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:plan APP={{.APP}}' first"

  tofu:fmt:
    desc: "Format all Terraform files"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu fmt -recursive

  tofu:validate:
    desc: "Validate an app's configuration"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu validate
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:encryption:setup:
    desc: "Set up state encryption passphrase in 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Creating 1Password item for state encryption..."
        PASSPHRASE=$(openssl rand -base64 32)
        op item create \
          --category=password \
          --title="opentofu" \
          --vault="homelab" \
          "password=$PASSPHRASE" \
          "notes=OpenTofu state encryption passphrase for homelab IaC"
        echo "✅ Created 1Password item 'opentofu'"
        echo "The passphrase will be automatically retrieved when running tofu commands"

  tofu:encryption:test:
    desc: "Test state encryption passphrase retrieval"
    cmds:
      - |
        if [ -n "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase" ]; then
          echo "✅ State encryption passphrase is set (${#TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase} chars)"
        else
          echo "❌ State encryption passphrase not set"
          echo "Run 'task tofu:encryption:setup' or set TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase"
          exit 1
        fi

  tofu:ssh:
    desc: "SSH to a deployed LXC by app name"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/ssh.sh {{.APP}}
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:logs:
    desc: "View Docker logs from a deployed app"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/logs.sh {{.APP}} {{.SERVICE}}
    requires:
      vars: [APP, SERVICE]

  tofu:info:
    desc: "Show OpenTofu IaC status"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/info.sh

    desc: "Run tofu plan for all apps"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu-all.sh plan

    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu-all.sh apply

    cmds:

Based on the search results, here's what I found about OpenTofu state encryption and related topics:

## OpenTofu State Encryption Overview

OpenTofu supports encrypting state and plan files at rest, both for local storage and when using a backend.(no content)OpenTofu 1.7.0 was released with full state encryption, dynamic provider-defined functions, the removed and loopable import blocks, new migration guides, and more.

### Configuration Methods

OpenTofu state encryption is configured through a special "encryption" block that will be part of the "terraform" block.(no content)The encryption settings for state and plan data can be configured in two ways: using an encryption block inside of the terraform block, through the environment variable TF_ENCRYPTION, or a combination of the two.

### Key Components

In the encryption block, you can configure multiple blocks:
- **key_provider** – Specifies the key provider for the encryption, can be PBKDF2, AWS KMS, GCP KMS, or OpenBao. Depending on which key provider you select, you will have different configuration options.
- **method** – The encryption method to be used, currently the option is AES-GCM which permits 16, 24, and 32-byte keys.
- **state and/or plan** – Here you specify the encryption method and a fallback option because OpenTofu lets you automatically roll over your encryption configuration to an old one by having this fallback option.

### Default State File Path

This state is stored by default in a local file named "terraform.tfstate", but it's recommended to store it in TACOS (TF Automation and Collaboration Software) to version, encrypt, and securely share it with your team.

### Key Providers Available

OpenTofu has implemented state file encryption using two different Key Providers:
- **PBKDF2**: Password-Based Key Derivation Function 2. It's a key derivation function that's commonly used to strengthen passwords before they're hashed.
- **AWS KMS**: AWS KMS (Key Management Service) is a managed service offered by Amazon Web Services (AWS) that allows the creation and control of the encryption keys used to encrypt data.

### Important Considerations

Once you enable encryption, OpenTofu cannot read your state file without the correct key. If you have a pre-existing state file and want to enable encryption, simply enabling encryption is not enough as OpenTofu will refuse to read plain text data. This is a protection mechanism to prevent OpenTofu from reading manipulated, unencrypted data.(no content)This feature is not compatible with Terraform and you would have to remove encryption if you wanted to migrate to Terraform or have a third-party tool interact with your state data or plan files directly.

The search results don't specifically address a `-state` flag for specifying a custom state file path in the context of encryption. The standard OpenTofu/Terraform `-state` flag for specifying custom state file locations would still work alongside encryption configuration, but the encryption configuration itself is handled through the `encryption` block in your configuration, not through command-line flags.

This state is stored by default in a local file named "terraform.tfstate", but it's recommended to store it in TACOS (TF Automation and Collaboration Software) to version, encrypt, and securely share it with your team.

### Key Providers Available

OpenTofu has implemented state file encryption using two different Key Providers:
- **PBKDF2**: Password-Based Key Derivation Function 2. It's a key derivation function that's commonly used to strengthen passwords before they're hashed.
- **AWS KMS**: AWS KMS (Key Management Service) is a managed service offered by Amazon Web Services (AWS) that allows the creation and control of the encryption keys used to encrypt data.

### Important Considerations

Once you enable encryption, OpenTofu cannot read your state file without the correct key. If you have a pre-existing state file and want to enable encryption, simply enabling encryption is not enough as OpenTofu will refuse to read plain text data. This is a protection mechanism to prevent OpenTofu from reading manipulated, unencrypted data.(no content)This feature is not compatible with Terraform and you would have to remove encryption if you wanted to migrate to Terraform or have a third-party tool interact with your state data or plan files directly.

# OpenTofu IaC Commands
# https://taskfile.dev
#
# Each app has its own state file in tofu/apps/<app>/
# Use APP=dashboards|openwebui|etc to specify which app

version: '3'

vars:
  TOFU_DIR: "tofu"

tasks:
  tofu:init:
    desc: "Initialize OpenTofu for an app (APP=dashboards|openwebui)"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu init
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:plan:
    desc: "Plan infrastructure changes for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - pwd
      - tofu plan -out=tfplan
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    preconditions:
      - sh: test -d .terraform
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:init APP={{.APP}}' first"

  tofu:apply:
    desc: "Apply planned infrastructure changes for an app (optional: REPLACE='resource.name')"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu apply {{if .REPLACE}}-replace='{{.REPLACE}}' -auto-approve{{else}}tfplan{{end}}
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    preconditions:
      - sh: '{{if .REPLACE}}true{{else}}test -f tfplan{{end}}'
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:plan APP={{.APP}}' first"

  tofu:destroy:
    desc: "Destroy an app's infrastructure"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - echo "⚠️  This will destroy {{.APP}} infrastructure!"
      - tofu destroy
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    prompt: "Are you sure you want to destroy {{.APP}}?"

  tofu:output:
    desc: "Show infrastructure outputs for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu output
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:state:
    desc: "List all resources in an app's state"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu state list
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:state:compare:
    desc: "Compare current state with .old backup (APP) - for DR validation"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - |
        if [ ! -f terraform.tfstate.old ]; then
          echo "No terraform.tfstate.old found - nothing to compare"
          exit 0
        fi

        echo "=== Comparing state files for {{.APP}} ==="
        echo ""

        # Get current state resources
        tofu state list > /tmp/tofu_new_state.txt

        # Swap to old state, get resources, swap back
        mv terraform.tfstate terraform.tfstate.new
        mv terraform.tfstate.old terraform.tfstate
        tofu state list > /tmp/tofu_old_state.txt
        mv terraform.tfstate terraform.tfstate.old
        mv terraform.tfstate.new terraform.tfstate

        # Compare
        echo "Old state: $(wc -l < /tmp/tofu_old_state.txt | tr -d ' ') resources"
        echo "New state: $(wc -l < /tmp/tofu_new_state.txt | tr -d ' ') resources"
        echo ""

        if diff /tmp/tofu_old_state.txt /tmp/tofu_new_state.txt > /dev/null; then
          echo "✓ IDENTICAL - Same resources tracked in both states"
        else
          echo "✗ DIFFERENT - Resource lists differ:"
          echo ""
          diff /tmp/tofu_old_state.txt /tmp/tofu_new_state.txt || true
        fi

        rm -f /tmp/tofu_old_state.txt /tmp/tofu_new_state.txt
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:state:rm:
    desc: "Remove a resource from state (APP, RESOURCE)"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu state rm '{{.RESOURCE}}'

# OpenTofu IaC Commands
# https://taskfile.dev
#
# Each app has its own state file in tofu/apps/<app>/
# Use APP=dashboards|openwebui|etc to specify which app

version: '3'

vars:
  TOFU_DIR: "tofu"

tasks:
  tofu:init:
    desc: "Initialize OpenTofu for an app (APP=dashboards|openwebui)"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu init
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:plan:
    desc: "Plan infrastructure changes for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - pwd
      - tofu plan -out=tfplan
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    preconditions:
      - sh: test -d .terraform
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:init APP={{.APP}}' first"

  tofu:apply:
    desc: "Apply planned infrastructure changes for an app (optional: REPLACE='resource.name')"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu apply {{if .REPLACE}}-replace='{{.REPLACE}}' -auto-approve{{else}}tfplan{{end}}
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    preconditions:
      - sh: '{{if .REPLACE}}true{{else}}test -f tfplan{{end}}'
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:plan APP={{.APP}}' first"

  tofu:destroy:

    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"

# Disaster Recovery Runbook

## Overview

This document outlines procedures for recovering the homelab from various failure scenarios. For detailed backup information, see [backups.md](./backups.md).

## Quick Reference

| Scenario | RTO | RPO | Procedure |
|----------|-----|-----|-----------|
| Single container failure | 15 min | < 24 hrs | [Container Recovery](#single-container-recovery) |
| Proxmox host failure | 2-4 hrs | < 24 hrs | [Full Host Recovery](#full-host-recovery) |
| Database corruption | 30 min | < 24 hrs | [Database Recovery](#database-recovery) |
| Network services down | 5 min | N/A | [Network Recovery](#network-services-recovery) |

## Service Dependencies

### Recovery Order (Critical Path)

Recovery must follow this order due to service dependencies:

```
1. Proxmox VE host
   └── 2. Network Services (LXC 101) - AdGuard DNS
       └── 3. Traefik (LXC 200) - Reverse proxy
           └── 4. Authelia (LXC 202) - SSO/Auth
               └── 5. All other services
```

### Tier 1: Infrastructure (Recover First)

| ID | Service | IP | Dependencies | Critical For |
|----|---------|----|--------------|--------------|
| - | Proxmox VE | 192.168.1.215 | None | Everything |
| 101 | Network Services | 10.100.1.101 / 192.168.1.196 | Proxmox | DNS resolution |
| 200 | Traefik | 10.100.2.200 / 192.168.1.235 | DNS | HTTPS access to all services |
| 202 | Authelia | 10.100.2.202 | Traefik | Protected service access |

### Tier 2: Core Services

| ID | Service | IP | Dependencies |
|----|---------|----|--------------|
| 500 | Monitoring | 10.100.5.100 | Traefik |
| 201 | Dashboards | 10.100.2.201 | Traefik |

### Tier 3: Application Services

| ID | Service | IP | Dependencies |
|----|---------|----|--------------|
| 304 | Immich | 10.100.3.104 / 192.168.1.222 | Traefik, Authelia |
| 401 | Jellyfin | 10.100.4.101 / 192.168.1.226 | Traefik |
| 402 | Media Management | 10.100.4.102 | Traefik, Authelia, VPN (gluetun) |
| 501 | OpenWebUI | 10.100.5.101 | Traefik, Authelia |
| 502 | n8n | 10.100.5.102 | Traefik, Authelia |
| 503 | Obsidian Sync | 10.100.5.103 | Traefik |
| 504 | Documents | 10.100.5.104 | Traefik, Authelia |

## Recovery Procedures

### Single Container Recovery (PBS - Recommended)

**Time estimate: 15-30 minutes**

This uses PBS (Proxmox Backup Server) incremental backups with OpenTofu for infrastructure recreation.

#### Step 1: Rename OpenTofu State

This forces OpenTofu to recreate all resources from scratch.

```bash
cd tofu/apps/<APP>
mv terraform.tfstate terraform.tfstate.old
```

#### Step 2: Recreate Infrastructure

```bash
task tofu:init APP=<APP>
task tofu:apply APP=<APP>
```

This will:
- Create new LXC container with same VMID
- Run Ansible to configure base system
- Deploy docker-compose and config files
- Start Docker containers (with empty/fresh data)
- Configure PBS backup client
- Deploy Pulse/Arcane agents

#### Step 3: Fix SSH Host Key

The new LXC has a different SSH host key. Update your known_hosts:

```bash
# Get IP from tofu output
IP=$(cd tofu/apps/<APP> && tofu output -raw ip_address)

# Remove old key and add new one
ssh-keygen -R $IP
ssh-keyscan -H $IP >> ~/.ssh/known_hosts
```

#### Step 4: Restore Data from PBS

```bash
task pbs:backup:restore APP=<APP>
```

This will:
- Stop Docker containers
- Restore `/config` directory from PBS backup
- Restore Docker volume data from PBS backup
- Start Docker containers

#### Step 5: Verify and Cleanup

1. Check the app is working at its URL
2. Verify data is restored correctly
3. Clean up old state file:

```bash
rm tofu/apps/<APP>/terraform.tfstate.old
```

#### Example: Recovering n8n

```bash
# 1. Rename state
mv tofu/apps/n8n/terraform.tfstate tofu/apps/n8n/terraform.tfstate.old

# 2. Recreate
task tofu:init APP=n8n
task tofu:apply APP=n8n

# 3. Fix SSH (IP: 10.100.5.102)
ssh-keygen -R 10.100.5.102
ssh-keyscan -H 10.100.5.102 >> ~/.ssh/known_hosts

# 4. Restore data
task pbs:backup:restore APP=n8n

# 5. Verify
curl -s http://10.100.5.102:5678/healthz
# Should return: {"status":"ok"}

# 6. Cleanup
rm tofu/apps/n8n/terraform.tfstate.old
```

### Single Container Recovery (vzdump - Legacy)

**Time estimate: 15-30 minutes**

This uses full vzdump container backups (older method).

1. **Identify the failed container**

   ```bash
   ssh root@192.168.1.215 "pct list"
   ```

2. **Check available backups**

   ```bash
   task backup:list APP=<app-name>
   # Example: task backup:list APP=immich
   ```

3. **Restore to a new container ID** (safer - allows verification)

   ```bash
   task backup:restore BACKUP=<backup-file> TARGET_ID=<new-id>

# Disaster Recovery Runbook

## Overview

This document outlines procedures for recovering the homelab from various failure scenarios. For detailed backup information, see [backups.md](./backups.md).

## Quick Reference

| Scenario | RTO | RPO | Procedure |
|----------|-----|-----|-----------|
| Single container failure | 15 min | < 24 hrs | [Container Recovery](#single-container-recovery) |
| Proxmox host failure | 2-4 hrs | < 24 hrs | [Full Host Recovery](#full-host-recovery) |
| Database corruption | 30 min | < 24 hrs | [Database Recovery](#database-recovery) |
| Network services down | 5 min | N/A | [Network Recovery](#network-services-recovery) |

## Service Dependencies

### Recovery Order (Critical Path)

Recovery must follow this order due to service dependencies:

```
1. Proxmox VE host
   └── 2. Network Services (LXC 101) - AdGuard DNS
       └── 3. Traefik (LXC 200) - Reverse proxy
           └── 4. Authelia (LXC 202) - SSO/Auth
               └── 5. All other services
```

### Tier 1: Infrastructure (Recover First)

| ID | Service | IP | Dependencies | Critical For |
|----|---------|----|--------------|--------------|
| - | Proxmox VE | 192.168.1.215 | None | Everything |
| 101 | Network Services | 10.100.1.101 / 192.168.1.196 | Proxmox | DNS resolution |
| 200 | Traefik | 10.100.2.200 / 192.168.1.235 | DNS | HTTPS access to all services |
| 202 | Authelia | 10.100.2.202 | Traefik | Protected service access |

### Tier 2: Core Services

| ID | Service | IP | Dependencies |
|----|---------|----|--------------|
| 500 | Monitoring | 10.100.5.100 | Traefik |
| 201 | Dashboards | 10.100.2.201 | Traefik |

### Tier 3: Application Services

| ID | Service | IP | Dependencies |
|----|---------|----|--------------|
| 304 | Immich | 10.100.3.104 / 192.168.1.222 | Traefik, Authelia |
| 401 | Jellyfin | 10.100.4.101 / 192.168.1.226 | Traefik |
| 402 | Media Management | 10.100.4.102 | Traefik, Authelia, VPN (gluetun) |
| 501 | OpenWebUI | 10.100.5.101 | Traefik, Authelia |
| 502 | n8n | 10.100.5.102 | Traefik, Authelia |
| 503 | Obsidian Sync | 10.100.5.103 | Traefik |
| 504 | Documents | 10.100.5.104 | Traefik, Authelia |

## Recovery Procedures

### Single Container Recovery (PBS - Recommended)

**Time estimate: 15-30 minutes**

This uses PBS (Proxmox Backup Server) incremental backups with OpenTofu for infrastructure recreation.

#### Step 1: Rename OpenTofu State

This forces OpenTofu to recreate all resources from scratch.

```bash
cd tofu/apps/<APP>
mv terraform.tfstate terraform.tfstate.old
```

#### Step 2: Recreate Infrastructure

```bash
task tofu:init APP=<APP>
task tofu:apply APP=<APP>
```

This will:
- Create new LXC container with same VMID
- Run Ansible to configure base system
- Deploy docker-compose and config files
- Start Docker containers (with empty/fresh data)
- Configure PBS backup client
- Deploy Pulse/Arcane agents

#### Step 3: Fix SSH Host Key

The new LXC has a different SSH host key. Update your known_hosts:

```bash
# Get IP from tofu output
IP=$(cd tofu/apps/<APP> && tofu output -raw ip_address)

# Remove old key and add new one
ssh-keygen -R $IP
ssh-keyscan -H $IP >> ~/.ssh/known_hosts
```

#### Step 4: Restore Data from PBS

```bash
task pbs:backup:restore APP=<APP>
```

This will:
- Stop Docker containers
- Restore `/config` directory from PBS backup
- Restore Docker volume data from PBS backup
- Start Docker containers

#### Step 5: Verify and Cleanup

1. Check the app is working at its URL
2. Verify data is restored correctly
3. (Optional) Compare state files to verify same resources are tracked:

```bash
# Compare resource lists between old and new state
task tofu:state APP=<APP> > /tmp/new.txt
task tofu:state APP=<APP> -- -state=terraform.tfstate.old > /tmp/old.txt
diff /tmp/old.txt /tmp/new.txt  # Should show no differences
```

4. Clean up old state file:

```bash
rm tofu/apps/<APP>/terraform.tfstate.old
```

#### Example: Recovering n8n

```bash
# 1. Rename state
mv tofu/apps/n8n/terraform.tfstate tofu/apps/n8n/terraform.tfstate.old

# 2. Recreate
task tofu:init APP=n8n
task tofu:apply APP=n8n

# 3. Fix SSH (IP: 10.100.5.102)
ssh-keygen -R 10.100.5.102
ssh-keyscan -H 10.100.5.102 >> ~/.ssh/known_hosts

# 4. Restore data
task pbs:backup:restore APP=n8n

# 5. Verify
curl -s http://10.100.5.102:5678/healthz
# Should return: {"status":"ok"}

# 6. Cleanup
rm tofu/apps/n8n/terraform.tfstate.old
```

#### Step 2: Recreate Infrastructure

- Run Ansible to configure base system
- Deploy docker-compose and config files

# Disaster Recovery Runbook

| Single container failure | 15 min | < 24 hrs | [Container Recovery](#single-container-recovery) |

| Database corruption | 30 min | < 24 hrs | [Database Recovery](#database-recovery) |
| Network services down | 5 min | N/A | [Network Recovery](#network-services-recovery) |
