# =============================================================================
# Monitoring LXC - OpenTelemetry + Prometheus + Grafana + Uptime Kuma + ntfy
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 500
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# Observability stack for metrics, dashboards, and alerting.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 500
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 4
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 4096
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 32
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Monitoring Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "monitoring" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "monitoring"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 1024

  rootfs_storage = "tank"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Monitoring"
  service_description = "OpenTelemetry-based monitoring stack with Prometheus, Grafana, and alerting"

  service_urls = {
    grafana      = "https://grafana.${var.domain_internal}"
    prometheus   = "https://prometheus.${var.domain_internal}"
    alertmanager = "https://alertmanager.${var.domain_internal}"
    uptime_kuma  = "https://status.${var.domain_internal}"
    ntfy         = "https://ntfy.${var.domain_internal}"
    direct_otel_grpc = "http://${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4317"
    direct_otel_http = "http://${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4318"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "OpenTelemetry Collector", port = 4317, info = "OTLP gRPC receiver" },
    { name = "OpenTelemetry HTTP", port = 4318, info = "OTLP HTTP receiver" },
    { name = "Prometheus", port = 9090, info = "Metrics storage and alerting" },
    { name = "Grafana", port = 3000, info = "Dashboards and visualization" },
    { name = "Alertmanager", port = 9093, info = "Alert routing" },
    { name = "Uptime Kuma", port = 3001, info = "HTTP monitoring and status page" },
    { name = "ntfy", port = 8080, info = "Push notifications" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## OpenTelemetry Endpoints

**OTLP gRPC:** ${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4317
**OTLP HTTP:** ${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4318

Configure Proxmox metrics server:
```bash
pvesh create /cluster/metrics/server \
  --id homelab-otel \
  --type opentelemetry \
  --server ${local.lan_ips.monitoring} \
  --port 4317 \
  --proto grpc
```

## Grafana

Default login: admin / (password in 1Password)

## ntfy Topics

- `homelab-alerts` - Prometheus alerts
- `homelab-status` - Uptime Kuma notifications

Subscribe via mobile app or web UI.

## Quick Commands

```bash
# View OTEL collector logs
docker logs -f otel-collector

# Reload Prometheus config
curl -X POST http://localhost:9090/-/reload

# Test ntfy notification
curl -d "Test notification" http://localhost:8080/homelab-alerts
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=monitoring` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["monitoring", "prometheus", "grafana", "otel"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "monitoring_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    grafana_admin_password = local.op.grafana_admin_password
    uptime_kuma_username   = local.op.uptime_kuma_username
    uptime_kuma_password   = local.op.uptime_kuma_password
    discord_webhook_url    = local.op.discord_webhook_url
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/monitoring.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "monitoring_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.monitoring_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = module.monitoring.ip_address

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Routes - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "grafana_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "grafana"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:3000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "grafana.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "prometheus_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "prometheus"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:9090"

  internal_domain = "prometheus.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "alertmanager_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "alertmanager"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:9093"

}

output "urls" {

    alertmanager = module.alertmanager_route.internal_url

    ntfy         = module.ntfy_route.internal_url
  }
}

output "traefik_config_paths" {
  description = "Paths to Traefik configs on Traefik LXC"
  value = {
    grafana      = module.grafana_route.remote_config_path
    prometheus   = module.prometheus_route.remote_config_path
    alertmanager = module.alertmanager_route.remote_config_path
    uptime_kuma  = module.uptime_kuma_route.remote_config_path
    ntfy         = module.ntfy_route.remote_config_path
  }
}

# Plan: Implement Centralized Logging with Loki + Alloy

## Overview
Replace OTEL Collector with Grafana Alloy for unified telemetry collection (logs, metrics, traces) and add Loki for log aggregation. Alloy will be deployed as a sidecar to all LXCs following the existing sidecar pattern.

## Current State
- OTEL Collector deployed only on monitoring LXC (500)
- Logs pipeline exists but exports to `debug` (stdout only)
- Loki commented out in Grafana datasources (planned but not implemented)
- Existing sidecars: PBS backup, Pulse agent, Arcane agent
- Prometheus scrapes targets directly + receives remote_write from OTEL

## Architecture Decision
**Chosen approach**: Loki + Alloy (replacing OTEL Collector entirely)

Why Alloy over OTEL:
- Promtail is deprecated (EOL March 2026)
- Alloy is Grafana's unified collector (replaces Promtail, can replace OTEL)
- Native Grafana/Loki/Prometheus integration
- Consistent tooling across all LXCs

## Implementation Steps

### Phase 1: Add Loki to Monitoring Stack

**File: `tofu/apps/monitoring/deploy/docker-compose.yml`**

Add Loki service:
```yaml
loki:
  image: grafana/loki:3.3.2
  container_name: loki
  command: -config.file=/etc/loki/local-config.yaml
  ports:
    - "3100:3100"
  volumes:
    - ./loki/config.yaml:/etc/loki/local-config.yaml:ro
    - loki_data:/loki
  deploy:
    resources:
      limits:
        memory: 1024m
        cpus: '1.0'
      reservations:
        memory: 512m
        cpus: '0.5'
  restart: unless-stopped
  healthcheck:
    test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:3100/ready || exit 1"]
    interval: 30s
    timeout: 10s
    retries: 3
    start_period: 30s
```

Add volume:
```yaml
volumes:
  loki_data:
```

**File: `tofu/apps/monitoring/deploy/loki/config.yaml`** (new)

```yaml
auth_enabled: false

server:
  http_listen_port: 3100
  grpc_listen_port: 9096

common:
  instance_addr: 127.0.0.1
  path_prefix: /loki
  storage:
    filesystem:
      chunks_directory: /loki/chunks
      rules_directory: /loki/rules
  replication_factor: 1
  ring:
    kvstore:
      store: inmemory

query_range:
  results_cache:
    cache:
      embedded_cache:
        enabled: true
        max_size_mb: 100

schema_config:
  configs:
    - from: 2024-01-01
      store: tsdb
      object_store: filesystem
      schema: v13
      index:
        prefix: index_
        period: 24h

limits_config:
  retention_period: 30d
  ingestion_rate_mb: 10
  ingestion_burst_size_mb: 20

compactor:
  working_directory: /loki/compactor
  retention_enabled: true
  delete_request_store: filesystem
```

### Phase 2: Replace OTEL Collector with Alloy on Monitoring LXC

**File: `tofu/apps/monitoring/deploy/docker-compose.yml`**

Replace `otel-collector` service with:
```yaml
alloy:
  image: grafana/alloy:v1.5.1
  container_name: alloy
  command:
    - run
    - --server.http.listen-addr=0.0.0.0:12345
    - --storage.path=/var/lib/alloy/data
    - /etc/alloy/config.alloy
  ports:
    - "4317:4317"   # OTLP gRPC receiver (backwards compat)
    - "4318:4318"   # OTLP HTTP receiver (backwards compat)
    - "12345:12345" # Alloy UI
  volumes:
    - ./alloy/config.alloy:/etc/alloy/config.alloy:ro
    - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
    - /var/log:/var/log/host:ro
    - alloy_data:/var/lib/alloy/data
  deploy:
    resources:
      limits:
        memory: 512m
        cpus: '0.5'
      reservations:
        memory: 256m
        cpus: '0.25'
  restart: unless-stopped
  depends_on:
    - prometheus
    - loki
  healthcheck:
    test: ["CMD", "wget", "-qO-", "http://localhost:12345/-/ready"]
    interval: 30s
    timeout: 10s
    retries: 3
    start_period: 10s
```

Add volume:
```yaml
volumes:
  alloy_data:
```

**File: `tofu/apps/monitoring/deploy/alloy/config.alloy`** (new)

```alloy
// =============================================================================
// Grafana Alloy Configuration - Monitoring LXC
// =============================================================================
// Replaces OTEL Collector. Handles:
// - OTLP receiver (backwards compat for Proxmox/Immich)
// - Docker log collection
// - Journal log collection
// - Host metrics
// =============================================================================

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// OTLP Receiver (backwards compatibility with Proxmox/Immich)
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
otelcol.receiver.otlp "default" {
  grpc {
    endpoint = "0.0.0.0:4317"
  }
  http {
    endpoint = "0.0.0.0:4318"
  }

  output {
    metrics = [otelcol.exporter.prometheus.default.input]
    logs    = [otelcol.exporter.loki.default.input]
    traces  = [] // Not storing traces yet
  }
}

otelcol.exporter.prometheus "default" {
  forward_to = [prometheus.remote_write.default.receiver]
}

otelcol.exporter.loki "default" {
  forward_to = [loki.write.default.receiver]
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Docker Log Discovery
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
discovery.docker "containers" {
  host = "unix:///var/run/docker.sock"
}

discovery.relabel "docker_logs" {
  targets = discovery.docker.containers.targets

  // Keep container name as label
  rule {
    source_labels = ["__meta_docker_container_name"]
    regex         = "/(.*)"
    target_label  = "container"
  }

  // Add compose service name if available
  rule {
    source_labels = ["__meta_docker_container_label_com_docker_compose_service"]
    target_label  = "service"
  }

  // Add LXC identifier
  rule {
    target_label = "lxc"
    replacement  = "monitoring"
  }

  rule {
    target_label = "lxc_id"
    replacement  = "500"
  }
}

loki.source.docker "containers" {
  host       = "unix:///var/run/docker.sock"
  targets    = discovery.relabel.docker_logs.output
  forward_to = [loki.write.default.receiver]
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Journal Logs (systemd)
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
loki.source.journal "systemd" {
  forward_to = [loki.process.journal.receiver]
  labels = {
    job    = "journal",
    lxc    = "monitoring",
    lxc_id = "500",
  }
}

loki.process "journal" {
  forward_to = [loki.write.default.receiver]

  stage.static_labels {
    values = {
      source = "journal",
    }
  }
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Loki Write Endpoint
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
loki.write "default" {
  endpoint {
    url = "http://loki:3100/loki/api/v1/push"
  }
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Prometheus Remote Write
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
prometheus.remote_write "default" {
  endpoint {
    url = "http://prometheus:9090/api/v1/write"
  }
}
```

### Phase 3: Enable Loki Datasource in Grafana

**File: `tofu/apps/monitoring/deploy/grafana/provisioning/datasources/datasources.yml`**

Uncomment Loki datasource:
```yaml
- name: Loki
  uid: loki
  type: loki
  access: proxy
  url: http://loki:3100
  editable: false
  jsonData:
    derivedFields:
      - datasourceUid: prometheus
        matcherRegex: "container=\"([^\"]+)\""
        name: container
        url: '$${__value.raw}'
```

### Phase 4: Add Alloy Sidecar to lxc-sidecars Module

**File: `tofu/modules/lxc-sidecars/variables.tf`**

Replace `promtail_enabled` with:
```hcl
variable "alloy_agent" {
  description = "Grafana Alloy agent configuration for log/metric collection"
  type = object({
    enabled       = optional(bool, false)
    loki_url      = optional(string, "http://10.100.5.100:3100")
    prometheus_url = optional(string, "http://10.100.5.100:9090")
  })
  default = {}
}
```

**File: `tofu/modules/lxc-sidecars/main.tf`**

Add Alloy agent deployment (similar pattern to Pulse/Arcane):
```hcl
resource "ansible_navigator_run" "configure_alloy" {
  count = try(var.alloy_agent.enabled, false) ? 1 : 0

  triggers = {
    container_id   = var.container_id
    container_ip   = var.container_ip
    loki_url       = var.alloy_agent.loki_url
    prometheus_url = var.alloy_agent.prometheus_url
  }

  # ... (Ansible playbook template similar to agents)
}
```

**File: `tofu/modules/lxc-sidecars/templates/configure-alloy-playbook.yml.tftpl`** (new)

```yaml
---
- name: Configure Alloy agent sidecar
  hosts: lxc
  become: yes
  tasks:
    - name: Create sidecars directory
      file:
        path: /config/sidecars
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Deploy Alloy config
      copy:
        content: |
          // Alloy config for ${container_name} (LXC ${container_id})

          discovery.docker "containers" {
            host = "unix:///var/run/docker.sock"
          }

          discovery.relabel "docker_logs" {
            targets = discovery.docker.containers.targets

            rule {
              source_labels = ["__meta_docker_container_name"]
              regex         = "/(.*)"
              target_label  = "container"
            }

            rule {
              target_label = "lxc"
              replacement  = "${container_name}"
            }

            rule {
              target_label = "lxc_id"
              replacement  = "${container_id}"
            }
          }

          loki.source.docker "containers" {
            host       = "unix:///var/run/docker.sock"
            targets    = discovery.relabel.docker_logs.output
            forward_to = [loki.write.default.receiver]
          }

          loki.source.journal "systemd" {
            forward_to = [loki.process.journal.receiver]
            labels = {
              job    = "journal",
              lxc    = "${container_name}",
              lxc_id = "${container_id}",
            }
          }

          loki.process "journal" {
            forward_to = [loki.write.default.receiver]
            stage.static_labels {
              values = { source = "journal" }
            }
          }

          loki.write "default" {
            endpoint {
              url = "${loki_url}/loki/api/v1/push"
            }
          }
        dest: /config/sidecars/alloy.river
        mode: '0644'
      notify: Restart sidecars

    - name: Update sidecars docker-compose with Alloy
      blockinfile:
        path: /config/sidecars/docker-compose.yml
        create: yes
        block: |
          services:
            alloy:
              image: grafana/alloy:v1.5.1
              container_name: alloy-${container_name}
              command:
                - run
                - --server.http.listen-addr=0.0.0.0:12345
                - /etc/alloy/config.alloy
              volumes:
                - /config/sidecars/alloy.river:/etc/alloy/config.alloy:ro
                - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
                - /var/log:/var/log/host:ro
              restart: unless-stopped
              deploy:
                resources:
                  limits:

# Plan: Implement Centralized Logging with Loki + Alloy

## Overview
Replace OTEL Collector with Grafana Alloy for unified telemetry collection (logs, metrics, traces) and add Loki for log aggregation. Alloy will be deployed as a sidecar to all LXCs following the existing sidecar pattern.

## Current State
- OTEL Collector deployed only on monitoring LXC (500)
- Logs pipeline exists but exports to `debug` (stdout only)
- Loki commented out in Grafana datasources (planned but not implemented)
- Existing sidecars: PBS backup, Pulse agent, Arcane agent
- Prometheus scrapes targets directly + receives remote_write from OTEL

## Architecture Decision
**Chosen approach**: Loki + Alloy (replacing OTEL Collector entirely)

Why Alloy over OTEL:
- Promtail is deprecated (EOL March 2026)
- Alloy is Grafana's unified collector (replaces Promtail, can replace OTEL)
- Native Grafana/Loki/Prometheus integration
- Consistent tooling across all LXCs

## Implementation Steps

### Phase 1: Add Loki to Monitoring Stack

**File: `tofu/apps/monitoring/deploy/docker-compose.yml`**

Add Loki service:
```yaml
loki:
  image: grafana/loki:3.3.2
  container_name: loki
  command: -config.file=/etc/loki/local-config.yaml
  ports:
    - "3100:3100"
  volumes:
    - ./loki/config.yaml:/etc/loki/local-config.yaml:ro
    - loki_data:/loki
  deploy:
    resources:
      limits:
        memory: 1024m
        cpus: '1.0'
      reservations:
        memory: 512m
        cpus: '0.5'
  restart: unless-stopped
  healthcheck:
    test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:3100/ready || exit 1"]
    interval: 30s
    timeout: 10s
    retries: 3
    start_period: 30s
```

Add volume:
```yaml
volumes:
  loki_data:
```

// =============================================================================
// Grafana Alloy Configuration - Monitoring LXC
// =============================================================================
// Replaces OTEL Collector. Handles:
// - OTLP receiver (backwards compat for Proxmox/Immich)
// - Docker log collection
// - Journal log collection
// - Host metrics
// =============================================================================

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// OTLP Receiver (backwards compatibility with Proxmox/Immich)
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
otelcol.receiver.otlp "default" {
  grpc {
    endpoint = "0.0.0.0:4317"
  }
  http {
    endpoint = "0.0.0.0:4318"
  }

  output {
    metrics = [otelcol.exporter.prometheus.default.input]
    logs    = [otelcol.exporter.loki.default.input]
    traces  = [] // Not storing traces yet
  }
}

otelcol.exporter.prometheus "default" {
  forward_to = [prometheus.remote_write.default.receiver]
}

otelcol.exporter.loki "default" {
  forward_to = [loki.write.default.receiver]
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Docker Log Discovery
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
discovery.docker "containers" {
  host = "unix:///var/run/docker.sock"
}

discovery.relabel "docker_logs" {
  targets = discovery.docker.containers.targets

  // Keep container name as label
  rule {
    source_labels = ["__meta_docker_container_name"]
    regex         = "/(.*)"
    target_label  = "container"
  }

  // Add compose service name if available
  rule {
    source_labels = ["__meta_docker_container_label_com_docker_compose_service"]
    target_label  = "service"
  }

  // Add LXC identifier
  rule {
    target_label = "lxc"
    replacement  = "monitoring"
  }

  rule {
    target_label = "lxc_id"
    replacement  = "500"
  }
}

loki.source.docker "containers" {
  host       = "unix:///var/run/docker.sock"
  targets    = discovery.relabel.docker_logs.output
  forward_to = [loki.write.default.receiver]
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Journal Logs (systemd)
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
loki.source.journal "systemd" {
  forward_to = [loki.process.journal.receiver]
  labels = {
    job    = "journal",
    lxc    = "monitoring",
    lxc_id = "500",
  }
}

loki.process "journal" {
  forward_to = [loki.write.default.receiver]

  stage.static_labels {
    values = {
      source = "journal",
    }
  }
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Loki Write Endpoint
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
loki.write "default" {
  endpoint {
    url = "http://loki:3100/loki/api/v1/push"
  }
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Prometheus Remote Write
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
prometheus.remote_write "default" {
  endpoint {
    url = "http://prometheus:9090/api/v1/write"
  }
}

---
- name: Configure Alloy agent sidecar
  hosts: lxc
  become: yes
  tasks:
    - name: Create sidecars directory
      file:
        path: /config/sidecars
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Deploy Alloy config
      copy:
        content: |
          // Alloy config for ${container_name} (LXC ${container_id})

          discovery.docker "containers" {
            host = "unix:///var/run/docker.sock"
          }

          discovery.relabel "docker_logs" {
            targets = discovery.docker.containers.targets

            rule {
              source_labels = ["__meta_docker_container_name"]
              regex         = "/(.*)"
              target_label  = "container"
            }

            rule {
              target_label = "lxc"
              replacement  = "${container_name}"
            }

            rule {
              target_label = "lxc_id"
              replacement  = "${container_id}"
            }
          }

          loki.source.docker "containers" {
            host       = "unix:///var/run/docker.sock"
            targets    = discovery.relabel.docker_logs.output
            forward_to = [loki.write.default.receiver]
          }

          loki.source.journal "systemd" {
            forward_to = [loki.process.journal.receiver]
            labels = {
              job    = "journal",
              lxc    = "${container_name}",
              lxc_id = "${container_id}",
            }
          }

          loki.process "journal" {
            forward_to = [loki.write.default.receiver]
            stage.static_labels {
              values = { source = "journal" }
            }
          }

          loki.write "default" {
            endpoint {
              url = "${loki_url}/loki/api/v1/push"
            }
          }
        dest: /config/sidecars/alloy.river
        mode: '0644'
      notify: Restart sidecars

    - name: Update sidecars docker-compose with Alloy
      blockinfile:
        path: /config/sidecars/docker-compose.yml
        create: yes
        block: |
          services:
            alloy:
              image: grafana/alloy:v1.5.1
              container_name: alloy-${container_name}
              command:
                - run
                - --server.http.listen-addr=0.0.0.0:12345
                - /etc/alloy/config.alloy
              volumes:
                - /config/sidecars/alloy.river:/etc/alloy/config.alloy:ro
                - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
                - /var/log:/var/log/host:ro
              restart: unless-stopped
              deploy:
                resources:
                  limits:
                    memory: 128m
                    cpus: '0.25'
      notify: Restart sidecars

  handlers:
    - name: Restart sidecars
      command: docker compose -f /config/sidecars/docker-compose.yml up -d
      args:
        chdir: /config/sidecars
```

## Rollout Strategy

## Resource Estimates

# Plan: Add PBS Backup Task Command

## Overview
Add a `pbs:backup` task command that triggers manual PBS client backups for individual apps, similar to how `task tofu:apply APP=dashboards` works.

## Current State
- PBS client backups are configured via lxc-sidecars module on each LXC
- Each LXC has a systemd service: `pbs-backup-<container_id>.service`
- Timer runs weekly (e.g., `Sun 03:00`)
- Existing `backup:now` task uses vzdump (Proxmox full container backups), not PBS client

## Implementation

### 1. Update containers.sh registry
**File:** `scripts/backup/containers.sh`

Add missing apps to the registry:
- container-mgmt (104)
- obsidian-sync (503)
- documents (504)

### 2. Add pbs:backup task
**File:** `tasks/pbs.yml`

```yaml
pbs:backup:
  desc: "Trigger manual PBS backup for an app (APP=dashboards|immich|etc)"
  requires:
    vars: [APP]
  cmds:
    - |
      # Source container registry for ID lookup
      source ./scripts/backup/containers.sh

      if ! app_exists "{{.APP}}"; then
        echo "Unknown app: {{.APP}}"
        print_app_list
        exit 1
      fi

      VMID=$(get_container_id "{{.APP}}")
      IP=$(cd tofu/apps/{{.APP}} && tofu output -raw ip_address 2>/dev/null || echo "")

      if [ -z "$IP" ]; then
        echo "Could not get IP for {{.APP}}. Run 'task tofu:apply APP={{.APP}}' first."
        exit 1
      fi

      echo "Triggering PBS backup for {{.APP}} (LXC $VMID @ $IP)..."
      ssh root@$IP "systemctl start pbs-backup-$VMID.service"

      echo ""
      echo "Backup triggered. Checking status..."
      sleep 2
      ssh root@$IP "tail -20 /var/log/pbs-backups/lxc-$VMID.log"
```

### 3. Add pbs:backup:status task
```yaml
pbs:backup:status:
  desc: "Show PBS backup status for an app"
  requires:
    vars: [APP]
  cmds:
    - |
      source ./scripts/backup/containers.sh
      VMID=$(get_container_id "{{.APP}}")
      IP=$(cd tofu/apps/{{.APP}} && tofu output -raw ip_address 2>/dev/null)

      echo "=== PBS Backup Status for {{.APP}} (LXC $VMID) ==="
      ssh root@$IP "systemctl status pbs-backup-$VMID.timer --no-pager"
      echo ""
      echo "=== Recent Backup Log ==="
      ssh root@$IP "tail -30 /var/log/pbs-backups/lxc-$VMID.log 2>/dev/null || echo 'No backup log found'"
```

### 4. Add pbs:backup:all task
```yaml
pbs:backup:all:
  desc: "Trigger PBS backup for all apps"
  cmds:
    - |
      source ./scripts/backup/containers.sh
      for app in $(list_apps); do
        echo "=== Backing up $app ==="
        task pbs:backup APP=$app || echo "Failed: $app"
        echo ""
      done
```

## Files to Modify

1. **scripts/backup/containers.sh** - Add missing apps (104, 503, 504)
2. **tasks/pbs.yml** - Add pbs:backup, pbs:backup:status, pbs:backup:all tasks

## Usage Examples

```bash
# Trigger manual backup for container-mgmt
task pbs:backup APP=container-mgmt

# Check backup status
task pbs:backup:status APP=dashboards

# Backup all apps
task pbs:backup:all
```

# Plan: Implement Centralized Logging with Loki + Alloy

## Overview
Replace OTEL Collector with Grafana Alloy for unified telemetry collection (logs, metrics, traces) and add Loki for log aggregation. Alloy will be deployed as a sidecar to all LXCs following the existing sidecar pattern.

## Current State
- OTEL Collector deployed only on monitoring LXC (500)
- Logs pipeline exists but exports to `debug` (stdout only)
- Loki commented out in Grafana datasources (planned but not implemented)
- Existing sidecars: PBS backup, Pulse agent, Arcane agent
- Prometheus scrapes targets directly + receives remote_write from OTEL

## Architecture Decision
**Chosen approach**: Loki + Alloy (replacing OTEL Collector entirely)

Why Alloy over OTEL:
- Promtail is deprecated (EOL March 2026)
- Alloy is Grafana's unified collector (replaces Promtail, can replace OTEL)
- Native Grafana/Loki/Prometheus integration

# Plan: Implement Centralized Logging with Loki + Alloy

## Overview
Replace OTEL Collector with Grafana Alloy for unified telemetry collection (logs, metrics, traces) and add Loki for log aggregation. Alloy will be deployed as a sidecar to all LXCs following the existing sidecar pattern.

## Current State
- OTEL Collector deployed only on monitoring LXC (500)
- Logs pipeline exists but exports to `debug` (stdout only)
- Loki commented out in Grafana datasources (planned but not implemented)
- Existing sidecars: PBS backup, Pulse agent, Arcane agent
- Prometheus scrapes targets directly + receives remote_write from OTEL

## Architecture Decision
**Chosen approach**: Loki + Alloy (replacing OTEL Collector entirely)

Why Alloy over OTEL:
- Promtail is deprecated (EOL March 2026)
- Alloy is Grafana's unified collector (replaces Promtail, can replace OTEL)
- Native Grafana/Loki/Prometheus integration
- Consistent tooling across all LXCs

```alloy
// =============================================================================
// Grafana Alloy Configuration - Monitoring LXC
// =============================================================================
// Replaces OTEL Collector. Handles:
// - OTLP receiver (backwards compat for Proxmox/Immich)
// - Docker log collection
// - Journal log collection
// - Host metrics
// =============================================================================

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// OTLP Receiver (backwards compatibility with Proxmox/Immich)
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
otelcol.receiver.otlp "default" {
  grpc {
    endpoint = "0.0.0.0:4317"
  }
  http {
    endpoint = "0.0.0.0:4318"
  }

  output {
    metrics = [otelcol.exporter.prometheus.default.input]
    logs    = [otelcol.exporter.loki.default.input]
    traces  = [] // Not storing traces yet
  }
}

otelcol.exporter.prometheus "default" {
  forward_to = [prometheus.remote_write.default.receiver]
}

otelcol.exporter.loki "default" {
  forward_to = [loki.write.default.receiver]
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Docker Log Discovery
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
discovery.docker "containers" {
  host = "unix:///var/run/docker.sock"
}

discovery.relabel "docker_logs" {
  targets = discovery.docker.containers.targets

  // Keep container name as label
  rule {
    source_labels = ["__meta_docker_container_name"]
    regex         = "/(.*)"
    target_label  = "container"
  }

  // Add compose service name if available
  rule {
    source_labels = ["__meta_docker_container_label_com_docker_compose_service"]
    target_label  = "service"
  }

  // Add LXC identifier
  rule {
    target_label = "lxc"
    replacement  = "monitoring"
  }

  rule {
    target_label = "lxc_id"
    replacement  = "500"
  }
}

loki.source.docker "containers" {
  host       = "unix:///var/run/docker.sock"
  targets    = discovery.relabel.docker_logs.output
  forward_to = [loki.write.default.receiver]
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Journal Logs (systemd)
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
loki.source.journal "systemd" {
  forward_to = [loki.process.journal.receiver]
  labels = {
    job    = "journal",
    lxc    = "monitoring",
    lxc_id = "500",
  }
}

loki.process "journal" {
  forward_to = [loki.write.default.receiver]

  stage.static_labels {
    values = {
      source = "journal",
    }
  }
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Loki Write Endpoint
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
loki.write "default" {
  endpoint {
    url = "http://loki:3100/loki/api/v1/push"
  }
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Prometheus Remote Write
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
prometheus.remote_write "default" {
  endpoint {
    url = "http://prometheus:9090/api/v1/write"
  }
}
```

```yaml
---
- name: Configure Alloy agent sidecar
  hosts: lxc
  become: yes
  tasks:
    - name: Create sidecars directory
      file:
        path: /config/sidecars
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Deploy Alloy config
      copy:
        content: |
          // Alloy config for ${container_name} (LXC ${container_id})

          discovery.docker "containers" {
            host = "unix:///var/run/docker.sock"
          }

          discovery.relabel "docker_logs" {
            targets = discovery.docker.containers.targets

            rule {
              source_labels = ["__meta_docker_container_name"]
              regex         = "/(.*)"
              target_label  = "container"
            }

            rule {
              target_label = "lxc"
              replacement  = "${container_name}"
            }

            rule {
              target_label = "lxc_id"
              replacement  = "${container_id}"
            }
          }

          loki.source.docker "containers" {
            host       = "unix:///var/run/docker.sock"
            targets    = discovery.relabel.docker_logs.output
            forward_to = [loki.write.default.receiver]
          }

          loki.source.journal "systemd" {
            forward_to = [loki.process.journal.receiver]
            labels = {
              job    = "journal",
              lxc    = "${container_name}",
              lxc_id = "${container_id}",
            }
          }

          loki.process "journal" {
            forward_to = [loki.write.default.receiver]
            stage.static_labels {
              values = { source = "journal" }
            }
          }

          loki.write "default" {
            endpoint {
              url = "${loki_url}/loki/api/v1/push"
            }
          }
        dest: /config/sidecars/alloy.river
        mode: '0644'
      notify: Restart sidecars

    - name: Update sidecars docker-compose with Alloy
      blockinfile:
        path: /config/sidecars/docker-compose.yml
        create: yes
        block: |
          services:
            alloy:
              image: grafana/alloy:v1.5.1
              container_name: alloy-${container_name}
              command:
                - run
                - --server.http.listen-addr=0.0.0.0:12345
                - /etc/alloy/config.alloy
              volumes:
                - /config/sidecars/alloy.river:/etc/alloy/config.alloy:ro
                - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
                - /var/log:/var/log/host:ro
              restart: unless-stopped
              deploy:
                resources:
                  limits:
                    memory: 128m
                    cpus: '0.25'
      notify: Restart sidecars

  handlers:
    - name: Restart sidecars
      command: docker compose -f /config/sidecars/docker-compose.yml up -d
      args:
        chdir: /config/sidecars
```

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # OpenTelemetry Collector - Central telemetry receiver and router
  # ==========================================================================
  otel-collector:
    image: otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib:0.115.1
    container_name: otel-collector
    command: ["--config=/etc/otelcol/config.yaml"]
    ports:
      - "4317:4317"   # OTLP gRPC receiver
      - "4318:4318"   # OTLP HTTP receiver
      - "8888:8888"   # Prometheus metrics (collector self-metrics)
      - "8889:8889"   # Prometheus exporter (for scraped metrics)
    volumes:
      - ./otel-collector/config.yaml:/etc/otelcol/config.yaml:ro
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "/otelcol-contrib", "components"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Prometheus - Metrics storage and alerting
  # ==========================================================================
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:v3.1.0
    container_name: prometheus
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml'
      - '--storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus'
      - '--storage.tsdb.retention.time=30d'
      - '--web.enable-lifecycle'
      - '--web.enable-remote-write-receiver'
      - '--web.external-url=https://prometheus.homelab.rambtech.dev'
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./prometheus/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro
      - ./prometheus/alerts:/etc/prometheus/alerts:ro
      - prometheus_data:/prometheus
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 4096m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '1.0'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:9090/-/healthy || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Alertmanager - Alert routing and notifications
  # ==========================================================================
  alertmanager:
    image: prom/alertmanager:v0.28.1
    container_name: alertmanager
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml'
      - '--storage.path=/alertmanager'
      - '--web.external-url=https://alertmanager.homelab.rambtech.dev'
    ports:
      - "9093:9093"
    volumes:
      - ./alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:ro
      - ./alertmanager/templates:/etc/alertmanager/templates:ro
      - alertmanager_data:/alertmanager
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:9093/-/healthy || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Grafana - Visualization and dashboards
  # ==========================================================================
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:11.4.0
    container_name: grafana
    environment:
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER=admin
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-admin}
      - GF_USERS_ALLOW_SIGN_UP=false
      - GF_SERVER_ROOT_URL=https://grafana.homelab.rambtech.dev
      - GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_ENABLED=false
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    volumes:
      - ./grafana/provisioning:/etc/grafana/provisioning:ro
      - ./grafana/dashboards:/var/lib/grafana/dashboards:ro
      - grafana_data:/var/lib/grafana
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:3000/api/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Uptime Kuma - HTTP endpoint monitoring and status page
  # ==========================================================================
  uptime-kuma:
    image: louislam/uptime-kuma:1
    container_name: uptime-kuma
    ports:
      - "3001:3001"
    volumes:
      - uptime_kuma_data:/app/data
    dns:
      - 192.168.1.196  # AdGuard DNS for local domain resolution
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -sf http://localhost:3001/ > /dev/null || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s

  # ==========================================================================
  # AutoKuma - Declarative monitor management for Uptime Kuma
  # Monitors defined in ./autokuma/monitors.json
  # ==========================================================================
  autokuma:
    image: ghcr.io/bigboot/autokuma:1.0.0
    container_name: autokuma
    environment:
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__URL=http://uptime-kuma:3001
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__USERNAME=${UPTIME_KUMA_USERNAME:-admin}
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__PASSWORD=${UPTIME_KUMA_PASSWORD}
      - AUTOKUMA__STATIC_MONITORS=/monitors/monitors.json
      - AUTOKUMA__DOCKER__ENABLED=false
    volumes:
      - ./autokuma/monitors.json:/monitors/monitors.json:ro
    depends_on:
      - uptime-kuma
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    # Healthcheck removed: AutoKuma is distroless Rust binary with no health endpoint
    # Container health monitored via Docker restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy - Push notifications
  # ==========================================================================
  ntfy:
    image: binwiederhier/ntfy:v2.11.0
    container_name: ntfy
    command:
      - serve
      - --cache-file=/var/cache/ntfy/cache.db
      - --attachment-cache-dir=/var/cache/ntfy/attachments
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    volumes:
      - ./ntfy/server.yml:/etc/ntfy/server.yml:ro
      - ntfy_cache:/var/cache/ntfy
      - ntfy_data:/var/lib/ntfy
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:80/v1/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy-discord-forwarder - Forward ntfy notifications to Discord
  # ==========================================================================
  ntfy-discord-forwarder:
    image: python:3.12-alpine
    container_name: ntfy-discord-forwarder
    command:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      - |
        pip install --no-cache-dir requests &&
        python3 -u << 'ENDSCRIPT'
        import requests
        import json
        import os

        NTFY_URL = "http://ntfy:80/homelab-alerts/json"
        DISCORD_WEBHOOK = os.environ["DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL"]

        print(f"Starting ntfy->Discord forwarder. Listening to {NTFY_URL}")
        for line in requests.get(NTFY_URL, stream=True).iter_lines():
            if line:
                data = json.loads(line)
                msg = data.get("message", "")
                if msg:
                    print(f"Forwarding: {msg}")
                    requests.post(DISCORD_WEBHOOK, json={"content": msg})
        ENDSCRIPT
    environment:
      - DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL=${DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL}
    depends_on:
      - ntfy
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 128m
          cpus: '0.25'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pgrep -f python3 || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  prometheus_data:
  alertmanager_data:
  grafana_data:
  uptime_kuma_data:
  ntfy_cache:
  ntfy_data:

    editable: false
    jsonData:

# Prometheus Configuration
# Receives metrics from OpenTelemetry Collector and scrapes additional targets

global:
  scrape_interval: 30s
  evaluation_interval: 30s
  external_labels:
    monitor: 'homelab'

# Alerting configuration
alerting:
  alertmanagers:
    - static_configs:
        - targets:
            - alertmanager:9093

# Rule files for alerts
rule_files:
  - /etc/prometheus/alerts/*.yml

# Scrape configurations
scrape_configs:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Monitoring Stack Self-Monitoring
  # ==========================================================================

  # Prometheus self-monitoring
  - job_name: 'prometheus'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['localhost:9090']

  # OpenTelemetry Collector metrics
  - job_name: 'otel-collector'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['otel-collector:8888']

  # Alertmanager metrics
  - job_name: 'alertmanager'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['alertmanager:9093']

  # Grafana metrics
  - job_name: 'grafana'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['grafana:3000']

  # ==========================================================================
  # Traefik Reverse Proxy Metrics
  # ==========================================================================
  - job_name: 'traefik'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['10.100.2.200:8082']
        labels:
          instance: 'traefik'
          lxc_id: '200'

  # ==========================================================================
  # AdGuard Home - DNS Metrics
  # Native Prometheus metrics not yet available in v0.107.70
  # TODO: Enable when PR #7937 is merged, or deploy adguard-exporter sidecar
  # https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdGuardHome/pull/7937
  # ==========================================================================
  # - job_name: 'adguard'
  #   static_configs:
  #     - targets: ['192.168.1.196:9618']
  #       labels:
  #         instance: 'adguard'
  #         lxc_id: '101'

  # ==========================================================================
  # Immich - Photo Management Metrics
  # Metrics pushed via OTEL to otel-collector (no scrape needed)
  # ==========================================================================

  # ==========================================================================
  # Jellyfin - Media Server Metrics
  # Requires: Prometheus plugin installed in Jellyfin
  # ==========================================================================
  # - job_name: 'jellyfin'
  #   static_configs:
  #     - targets: ['10.100.4.101:8096']
  #       labels:
  #         instance: 'jellyfin'
  #         lxc_id: '226'

  # ==========================================================================
  # Uptime Kuma - Status Page Metrics
  # API key stored in 1Password: homelab/Uptime Kuma/cli key
  # ==========================================================================
  - job_name: 'uptime-kuma'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['uptime-kuma:3001']
        labels:
          instance: 'uptime-kuma'
    metrics_path: /metrics
    basic_auth:
      username: ''
      password: uk1_w3iNK0lQANt8O70jzqHDaebGH0mPorB9bCVTOa-2

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy - Push Notification Metrics
  # NOTE: Disabled - Docker DNS resolves 'ntfy' to external DNS (ntfy.homelab.rambtech.dev)
  # instead of container name due to search domain. Low-value metrics anyway.
  # ==========================================================================
  # - job_name: 'ntfy'
  #   static_configs:
  #     - targets: ['ntfy:9090']
  #       labels:
  #         instance: 'ntfy'
  #   metrics_path: /metrics

# ==========================================================================
# Metrics Coverage Summary
# ==========================================================================
#
# SCRAPED (Pull):
#   - prometheus, alertmanager, grafana, otel-collector (self-monitoring)
#   - traefik (reverse proxy metrics)
#   - uptime-kuma (status page metrics)
#
# PUSHED (via OTEL):
#   - Proxmox VE (node, VM, storage metrics)
#   - Immich (photo library metrics) - enable in Settings > Telemetry
#
# NOT YET AVAILABLE:
#   - AdGuard: No native support, PR #7937 pending
#   - Jellyfin: Requires plugin installation
#   - OpenWebUI: No metrics endpoint
#   - n8n: Requires N8N_METRICS=true env var
#

# Remote write receiver enabled via --web.enable-remote-write-receiver flag
# This allows OTEL collector to push metrics

# Receives metrics from Grafana Alloy and scrapes additional targets

global:
  scrape_interval: 30s
  evaluation_interval: 30s
  external_labels:
    monitor: 'homelab'

# Alerting configuration
alerting:
  alertmanagers:
    - static_configs:
        - targets:
            - alertmanager:9093

# Rule files for alerts
rule_files:
  - /etc/prometheus/alerts/*.yml

# Scrape configurations
scrape_configs:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Monitoring Stack Self-Monitoring
  # ==========================================================================

  # Prometheus self-monitoring
  - job_name: 'prometheus'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['localhost:9090']

  # Grafana Alloy metrics (replaces OTEL Collector)
  - job_name: 'alloy'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['alloy:12345']

  # Loki metrics
  - job_name: 'loki'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['loki:3100']

  # Alertmanager metrics
  - job_name: 'alertmanager'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['alertmanager:9093']

  # Grafana metrics
  - job_name: 'grafana'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['grafana:3000']

  # ==========================================================================
  # Traefik Reverse Proxy Metrics
  # ==========================================================================
  - job_name: 'traefik'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['10.100.2.200:8082']
        labels:
          instance: 'traefik'
          lxc_id: '200'

  # ==========================================================================
  # AdGuard Home - DNS Metrics
  # Native Prometheus metrics not yet available in v0.107.70
  # TODO: Enable when PR #7937 is merged, or deploy adguard-exporter sidecar
  # https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdGuardHome/pull/7937

  #   static_configs:
  #     - targets: ['192.168.1.196:9618']
  #       labels:
  #         instance: 'adguard'
  #         lxc_id: '101'

  # ==========================================================================
  # Immich - Photo Management Metrics
  # Metrics pushed via OTEL to otel-collector (no scrape needed)
  # ==========================================================================

  # ==========================================================================
  # Jellyfin - Media Server Metrics
  # Requires: Prometheus plugin installed in Jellyfin
  # ==========================================================================
  # - job_name: 'jellyfin'
  #   static_configs:
  #     - targets: ['10.100.4.101:8096']
  #       labels:
  #         instance: 'jellyfin'
  #         lxc_id: '226'

  # ==========================================================================
  # Uptime Kuma - Status Page Metrics
  # API key stored in 1Password: homelab/Uptime Kuma/cli key
  # ==========================================================================
  - job_name: 'uptime-kuma'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['uptime-kuma:3001']
        labels:
          instance: 'uptime-kuma'
    metrics_path: /metrics
    basic_auth:
      username: ''
      password: uk1_w3iNK0lQANt8O70jzqHDaebGH0mPorB9bCVTOa-2

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy - Push Notification Metrics
  # NOTE: Disabled - Docker DNS resolves 'ntfy' to external DNS (ntfy.homelab.rambtech.dev)

---
# =============================================================================
# Configure Container Management Agents in LXC Container
# =============================================================================
# This playbook is generated by the lxc-sidecars OpenTofu module.
# It deploys all enabled agents in a single docker-compose file to avoid
# conflicts from separate compose projects removing each other's containers.
#
# Agents:
#   - Pulse Docker Agent: Container monitoring (pushes metrics to Pulse server)
#   - Arcane Agent: Remote container management (manager initiates pairing)
# =============================================================================

- name: Configure container agents for ${container_name}
  hosts: ${container_name}
  gather_facts: true

  vars:
    container_id: "${container_id}"
    container_name: "${container_name}"

    # Pulse agent config
    pulse_enabled: ${pulse_enabled}
    pulse_url: "${pulse_url}"
    pulse_token: "${pulse_token}"

    # Arcane agent config
    arcane_enabled: ${arcane_enabled}
    manager_url: "${manager_url}"
    bootstrap_token: "${bootstrap_token}"

    # Shared paths
    sidecars_dir: /config/sidecars
    compose_file: /config/sidecars/docker-compose.yml

  tasks:
    # =========================================================================
    # Create Sidecar Directory
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create sidecars directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ sidecars_dir }}"
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'

    # =========================================================================
    # Deploy Unified Docker Compose
    # =========================================================================
    # Single compose file with all enabled agents to prevent --remove-orphans
    # from removing the "other" agent when updating just one.

    - name: Deploy unified agents docker-compose
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          # =============================================================================
          # Container Management Agents - ${container_name}
          # =============================================================================
          # Generated by OpenTofu lxc-sidecars module
          # DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY - changes will be overwritten
          # =============================================================================

          services:
%{ if pulse_enabled ~}
            # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
            # Pulse Docker Agent - Container Monitoring
            # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
            # NOTE: pulse-docker-agent is deprecated. Pulse v5.0+ introduces a unified
            # agent (binary install). Until v5.0 is stable, continue using this image.
            pulse-agent:
              image: ghcr.io/rcourtman/pulse-docker-agent:latest
              container_name: pulse-agent
              pid: host
              uts: host
              environment:

---
# =============================================================================
# Configure Container Management Agents in LXC Container
# =============================================================================
# This playbook is generated by the lxc-sidecars OpenTofu module.
# It deploys all enabled agents in a single docker-compose file to avoid
# conflicts from separate compose projects removing each other's containers.
#
# Agents:
#   - Pulse Docker Agent: Container monitoring (pushes metrics to Pulse server)
#   - Arcane Agent: Remote container management (manager initiates pairing)
# =============================================================================

- name: Configure container agents for ${container_name}
  hosts: ${container_name}
  gather_facts: true

  vars:
    container_id: "${container_id}"
    container_name: "${container_name}"

    # Pulse agent config
    pulse_enabled: ${pulse_enabled}
    pulse_url: "${pulse_url}"
    pulse_token: "${pulse_token}"

    # Arcane agent config
    arcane_enabled: ${arcane_enabled}
    manager_url: "${manager_url}"
    bootstrap_token: "${bootstrap_token}"

    # Shared paths
    sidecars_dir: /config/sidecars
    compose_file: /config/sidecars/docker-compose.yml

  tasks:
    # =========================================================================
    # Create Sidecar Directory
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create sidecars directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ sidecars_dir }}"
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'

    # =========================================================================
    # Deploy Unified Docker Compose
    # =========================================================================
    # Single compose file with all enabled agents to prevent --remove-orphans
    # from removing the "other" agent when updating just one.

    - name: Deploy unified agents docker-compose
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          # =============================================================================
          # Container Management Agents - ${container_name}
          # =============================================================================
          # Generated by OpenTofu lxc-sidecars module
          # DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY - changes will be overwritten
          # =============================================================================

          services:
%{ if pulse_enabled ~}
            # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
            # Pulse Docker Agent - Container Monitoring
            # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
            # NOTE: pulse-docker-agent is deprecated. Pulse v5.0+ introduces a unified
            # agent (binary install). Until v5.0 is stable, continue using this image.
            pulse-agent:
              image: ghcr.io/rcourtman/pulse-docker-agent:latest
              container_name: pulse-agent
              pid: host
              uts: host
              environment:
                - PULSE_URL=${pulse_url}
                - PULSE_TOKEN=${pulse_token}
              volumes:
                - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
              deploy:
                resources:
                  limits:
                    memory: 128m
                    cpus: '0.25'
                  reservations:
                    memory: 64m
                    cpus: '0.1'
              restart: unless-stopped
              healthcheck:
                test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pgrep pulse-docker-agent || exit 1"]
                interval: 30s
                timeout: 10s
                retries: 3
                start_period: 30s

%{ endif ~}
%{ if arcane_enabled ~}
            # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
            # Arcane Agent - Remote Container Management
            # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
            arcane-agent:
              image: ghcr.io/getarcaneapp/arcane-headless:latest
              container_name: arcane-agent
              ports:
                - "3553:3553"
              environment:
                - AGENT_MODE=true
                - AGENT_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN=${bootstrap_token}
              volumes:
                - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
                - arcane_agent_data:/app/data
              deploy:
                resources:
                  limits:
                    memory: 256m
                    cpus: '0.5'
                  reservations:
                    memory: 128m
                    cpus: '0.1'
              restart: unless-stopped
              healthcheck:
                test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -sf http://localhost:3553/api/health || exit 1"]
                interval: 30s
                timeout: 10s
                retries: 3
                start_period: 30s

%{ endif ~}
%{ if arcane_enabled ~}
          volumes:
            arcane_agent_data:
%{ endif ~}
        dest: "{{ compose_file }}"
        mode: '0644'
      register: compose_file_result

    # =========================================================================
    # Pull Latest Images
    # =========================================================================
%{ if pulse_enabled ~}
    - name: Pull Pulse agent image
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker pull ghcr.io/rcourtman/pulse-docker-agent:latest
      changed_when: true
%{ endif ~}

%{ if arcane_enabled ~}
    - name: Pull Arcane agent image
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker pull ghcr.io/getarcaneapp/arcane-headless:latest
      changed_when: true
%{ endif ~}

    # =========================================================================
    # Deploy Agent Containers
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Deploy agent containers
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker compose -f {{ compose_file }} up -d --remove-orphans
      register: deploy_result
      changed_when: "'Started' in deploy_result.stderr or 'Creating' in deploy_result.stderr"

    # =========================================================================
    # Verify Deployment

    - name: Wait for agents to start

%{ if pulse_enabled ~}
    - name: Check Pulse agent status

%{ endif ~}

      changed_when: false
%{ endif ~}

%{ if pulse_enabled ~}

---
# =============================================================================
# Configure Container Management Agents in LXC Container
# =============================================================================
# This playbook is generated by the lxc-sidecars OpenTofu module.
# It deploys all enabled agents in a single docker-compose file to avoid
# conflicts from separate compose projects removing each other's containers.
#
# Agents:
#   - Pulse Docker Agent: Container monitoring (pushes metrics to Pulse server)
#   - Arcane Agent: Remote container management (manager initiates pairing)
#   - Alloy Agent: Grafana Alloy for log collection to Loki
# =============================================================================

- name: Configure container agents for ${container_name}
  hosts: ${container_name}
  gather_facts: true

  vars:
    container_id: "${container_id}"
    container_name: "${container_name}"

    # Pulse agent config
    pulse_enabled: ${pulse_enabled}
    pulse_url: "${pulse_url}"
    pulse_token: "${pulse_token}"

    # Arcane agent config
    arcane_enabled: ${arcane_enabled}
    manager_url: "${manager_url}"
    bootstrap_token: "${bootstrap_token}"

    # Alloy agent config
    alloy_enabled: ${alloy_enabled}
    loki_url: "${loki_url}"

    # Shared paths
    sidecars_dir: /config/sidecars
    compose_file: /config/sidecars/docker-compose.yml

  tasks:
    # =========================================================================
    # Create Sidecar Directory
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create sidecars directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ sidecars_dir }}"
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'

    # =========================================================================
    # Deploy Unified Docker Compose
    # =========================================================================
    # Single compose file with all enabled agents to prevent --remove-orphans
    # from removing the "other" agent when updating just one.

    - name: Deploy unified agents docker-compose
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          # =============================================================================
          # Container Management Agents - ${container_name}
          # =============================================================================
          # Generated by OpenTofu lxc-sidecars module
          # DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY - changes will be overwritten
          # =============================================================================

          services:
%{ if pulse_enabled ~}
            # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
            # Pulse Docker Agent - Container Monitoring
            # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
            # NOTE: pulse-docker-agent is deprecated. Pulse v5.0+ introduces a unified
            # agent (binary install). Until v5.0 is stable, continue using this image.
            pulse-agent:
              image: ghcr.io/rcourtman/pulse-docker-agent:latest
              container_name: pulse-agent
              pid: host
              uts: host
              environment:
                - PULSE_URL=${pulse_url}
                - PULSE_TOKEN=${pulse_token}
              volumes:
                - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
              deploy:
                resources:
                  limits:
                    memory: 128m
                    cpus: '0.25'
                  reservations:
                    memory: 64m
                    cpus: '0.1'
              restart: unless-stopped
              healthcheck:
                test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pgrep pulse-docker-agent || exit 1"]
                interval: 30s
                timeout: 10s
                retries: 3
                start_period: 30s

%{ endif ~}
%{ if arcane_enabled ~}
            # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
            # Arcane Agent - Remote Container Management
            # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
            arcane-agent:
              image: ghcr.io/getarcaneapp/arcane-headless:latest
              container_name: arcane-agent
              ports:
                - "3553:3553"
              environment:
                - AGENT_MODE=true
                - AGENT_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN=${bootstrap_token}
              volumes:
                - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
                - arcane_agent_data:/app/data
              deploy:
                resources:
                  limits:
                    memory: 256m
                    cpus: '0.5'
                  reservations:
                    memory: 128m
                    cpus: '0.1'
              restart: unless-stopped
              healthcheck:
                test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -sf http://localhost:3553/api/health || exit 1"]
                interval: 30s
                timeout: 10s
                retries: 3
                start_period: 30s

%{ endif ~}
%{ if arcane_enabled ~}
          volumes:
            arcane_agent_data:
%{ endif ~}
        dest: "{{ compose_file }}"
        mode: '0644'
      register: compose_file_result

    # =========================================================================
    # Pull Latest Images
    # =========================================================================
%{ if pulse_enabled ~}
    - name: Pull Pulse agent image
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker pull ghcr.io/rcourtman/pulse-docker-agent:latest
      changed_when: true
%{ endif ~}

%{ if arcane_enabled ~}
    - name: Pull Arcane agent image
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker pull ghcr.io/getarcaneapp/arcane-headless:latest
      changed_when: true
%{ endif ~}

    # =========================================================================
    # Deploy Agent Containers
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Deploy agent containers
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker compose -f {{ compose_file }} up -d --remove-orphans
      register: deploy_result
      changed_when: "'Started' in deploy_result.stderr or 'Creating' in deploy_result.stderr"

    # =========================================================================
    # Verify Deployment
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Wait for agents to start
      ansible.builtin.pause:
        seconds: 10

%{ if pulse_enabled ~}
    - name: Check Pulse agent status
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker ps --filter name=pulse-agent --format "{{ '{{' }}.Status{{ '}}' }}"
      register: pulse_status
      changed_when: false
%{ endif ~}

%{ if arcane_enabled ~}
    - name: Check Arcane agent status
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker ps --filter name=arcane-agent --format "{{ '{{' }}.Status{{ '}}' }}"
      register: arcane_status
      changed_when: false
%{ endif ~}

    - name: Display deployment summary
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "=== Container Agents Deployed for ${container_name} ==="
          - ""
          - "Container ID: ${container_id}"
%{ if pulse_enabled ~}
          - "Pulse Agent: {{ pulse_status.stdout | default('not running') }}"
          - "  → Pulse URL: ${pulse_url}"
%{ endif ~}
%{ if arcane_enabled ~}
          - "Arcane Agent: {{ arcane_status.stdout | default('not running') }}"
          - "  → Agent Port: 3553"
          - "  → Pair in Arcane UI: http://{{ ansible_host }}:3553"
%{ endif ~}
          - ""
          - "Compose file: {{ compose_file }}"
          - ""
          - "Commands:"
          - "  View logs:  docker compose -f {{ compose_file }} logs -f"
          - "  Restart:    docker compose -f {{ compose_file }} restart"
          - "  Status:     docker compose -f {{ compose_file }} ps"
