services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Loki - Log aggregation
  # ==========================================================================
  loki:
    image: grafana/loki:3.3.2
    container_name: loki
    command: -config.file=/etc/loki/local-config.yaml
    ports:
      - "3100:3100"
    volumes:
      - ./loki/config.yaml:/etc/loki/local-config.yaml:ro
      - loki_data:/loki
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:3100/ready || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Grafana Alloy - Unified telemetry collector (replaces OTEL Collector)
  # ==========================================================================
  alloy:
    image: grafana/alloy:v1.5.1
    container_name: alloy
    command:
      - run
      - --server.http.listen-addr=0.0.0.0:12345
      - --storage.path=/var/lib/alloy/data
      - /etc/alloy/config.alloy
    ports:
      - "4317:4317"   # OTLP gRPC receiver (backwards compat)
      - "4318:4318"   # OTLP HTTP receiver (backwards compat)
      - "12345:12345" # Alloy UI
    volumes:
      - ./alloy/config.alloy:/etc/alloy/config.alloy:ro
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
      - /var/log:/var/log/host:ro
      - alloy_data:/var/lib/alloy/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
      - loki
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "-qO-", "http://localhost:12345/-/ready"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Prometheus - Metrics storage and alerting
  # ==========================================================================
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:v3.1.0
    container_name: prometheus
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml'
      - '--storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus'
      - '--storage.tsdb.retention.time=30d'
      - '--web.enable-lifecycle'
      - '--web.enable-remote-write-receiver'
      - '--web.external-url=https://prometheus.homelab.rambtech.dev'
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./prometheus/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro
      - ./prometheus/alerts:/etc/prometheus/alerts:ro
      - prometheus_data:/prometheus
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 4096m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '1.0'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:9090/-/healthy || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Alertmanager - Alert routing and notifications
  # ==========================================================================
  alertmanager:
    image: prom/alertmanager:v0.28.1
    container_name: alertmanager
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml'
      - '--storage.path=/alertmanager'
      - '--web.external-url=https://alertmanager.homelab.rambtech.dev'
    ports:
      - "9093:9093"
    volumes:
      - ./alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:ro
      - ./alertmanager/templates:/etc/alertmanager/templates:ro
      - alertmanager_data:/alertmanager
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:9093/-/healthy || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Grafana - Visualization and dashboards
  # ==========================================================================
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:11.4.0
    container_name: grafana
    environment:
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER=admin
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-admin}
      - GF_USERS_ALLOW_SIGN_UP=false
      - GF_SERVER_ROOT_URL=https://grafana.homelab.rambtech.dev
      - GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_ENABLED=false
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    volumes:
      - ./grafana/provisioning:/etc/grafana/provisioning:ro
      - ./grafana/dashboards:/var/lib/grafana/dashboards:ro
      - grafana_data:/var/lib/grafana
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:3000/api/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Uptime Kuma - HTTP endpoint monitoring and status page
  # ==========================================================================
  uptime-kuma:
    image: louislam/uptime-kuma:1
    container_name: uptime-kuma
    ports:
      - "3001:3001"
    volumes:
      - uptime_kuma_data:/app/data
    dns:
      - 192.168.1.196  # AdGuard DNS for local domain resolution
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -sf http://localhost:3001/ > /dev/null || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s

  # ==========================================================================
  # AutoKuma - Declarative monitor management for Uptime Kuma
  # Monitors defined in ./autokuma/monitors.json
  # ==========================================================================
  autokuma:
    image: ghcr.io/bigboot/autokuma:1.0.0
    container_name: autokuma
    environment:
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__URL=http://uptime-kuma:3001
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__USERNAME=${UPTIME_KUMA_USERNAME:-admin}
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__PASSWORD=${UPTIME_KUMA_PASSWORD}
      - AUTOKUMA__STATIC_MONITORS=/monitors/monitors.json
      - AUTOKUMA__DOCKER__ENABLED=false
    volumes:
      - ./autokuma/monitors.json:/monitors/monitors.json:ro
    depends_on:
      - uptime-kuma
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    # Healthcheck removed: AutoKuma is distroless Rust binary with no health endpoint
    # Container health monitored via Docker restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy - Push notifications
  # ==========================================================================
  ntfy:
    image: binwiederhier/ntfy:v2.11.0
    container_name: ntfy
    command:
      - serve
      - --cache-file=/var/cache/ntfy/cache.db
      - --attachment-cache-dir=/var/cache/ntfy/attachments
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    volumes:
      - ./ntfy/server.yml:/etc/ntfy/server.yml:ro
      - ntfy_cache:/var/cache/ntfy
      - ntfy_data:/var/lib/ntfy
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:80/v1/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy-discord-forwarder - Forward ntfy notifications to Discord
  # ==========================================================================
  ntfy-discord-forwarder:
    image: python:3.12-alpine
    container_name: ntfy-discord-forwarder
    command:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      - |
        pip install --no-cache-dir requests &&
        python3 -u << 'ENDSCRIPT'
        import requests
        import json
        import os

        NTFY_URL = "http://ntfy:80/homelab-alerts/json"
        DISCORD_WEBHOOK = os.environ["DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL"]

        print(f"Starting ntfy->Discord forwarder. Listening to {NTFY_URL}")
        for line in requests.get(NTFY_URL, stream=True).iter_lines():
            if line:
                data = json.loads(line)
                msg = data.get("message", "")
                if msg:
                    print(f"Forwarding: {msg}")
                    requests.post(DISCORD_WEBHOOK, json={"content": msg})
        ENDSCRIPT
    environment:
      - DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL=${DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL}
    depends_on:
      - ntfy
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 128m
          cpus: '0.25'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pgrep -f python3 || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  loki_data:
  alloy_data:
  prometheus_data:
  alertmanager_data:
  grafana_data:
  uptime_kuma_data:
  ntfy_cache:
  ntfy_data:

Now I understand the pattern. Let me think about the best approach for Loki + Prometheus auth:

**Options for authentication:**

1. **Loki multi-tenancy** - Loki has built-in `X-Scope-OrgID` header auth when `auth_enabled: true`, but that's for tenant isolation, not authentication.

2. **Basic Auth via reverse proxy** - Put nginx/caddy in front of Loki with basic auth. Adds complexity.

3. **Loki with custom header auth** - Not natively supported.

4. **Bearer token via custom middleware** - Loki doesn't have native bearer token support.

For a homelab, the most practical approach that matches your existing pattern would be to use **Basic Auth** which both Loki (via a proxy) and Prometheus remote write support natively. Let me ask you to clarify the preferred approach.

questions.question: For Loki/Prometheus auth, which approach would you prefer?

options.label: Basic Auth (Recommended)
options.description: Use HTTP Basic Auth for both Loki push and Prometheus remote_write. Simple, well-supported by Alloy. Requires adding a reverse proxy (nginx) in front of Loki.

options.label: Token in Header
options.description: Use a custom header (X-Auth-Token) validated by a proxy. More similar to Pulse/Arcane pattern but requires custom nginx config.

options.label: mTLS (Certificates)
options.description: Use mutual TLS with client certificates. Most secure but complex to manage certificates across all LXCs.

questions.question: For Loki/Prometheus auth, which approach would you prefer?

options.label: Basic Auth (Recommended)
options.description: Use HTTP Basic Auth for both Loki push and Prometheus remote_write. Simple, well-supported by Alloy. Requires adding a reverse proxy (nginx) in front of Loki.

options.label: Token in Header
options.description: Use a custom header (X-Auth-Token) validated by a proxy. More similar to Pulse/Arcane pattern but requires custom nginx config.

options.label: mTLS (Certificates)
options.description: Use mutual TLS with client certificates. Most secure but complex to manage certificates across all LXCs.

answers.For Loki/Prometheus auth, which approach: we already have traefik for reverse proxy and authelia for auth if they help

content.text:
Good point. However, using Traefik + Authelia for Alloy → Loki communication has a few considerations:

1. **Authelia is designed for user authentication** (OIDC/SAML/LDAP) with browser-based flows - it's not ideal for machine-to-machine (M2M) service auth
2. **Alloy sidecars need to push logs constantly** - they can't do interactive auth flows
3. **Traefik routes are external-facing** - Alloy connections are internal (LXC to LXC)

For machine-to-machine auth like Alloy → Loki, the best options are:

1. **Basic Auth middleware in Traefik** - Alloy supports this natively
2. **API Key header via Traefik ForwardAuth** - Custom validation
3. **Separate internal auth** - Don't route through Traefik, use nginx sidecar with Basic Auth directly on the monitoring LXC

Let me check if there's an internal Loki endpoint already set up.

---
# =============================================================================
# Configure Container Management Agents in LXC Container
# =============================================================================
# This playbook is generated by the lxc-sidecars OpenTofu module.
# It deploys all enabled agents in a single docker-compose file to avoid
# conflicts from separate compose projects removing each other's containers.
#
# Agents:
#   - Pulse Docker Agent: Container monitoring (pushes metrics to Pulse server)
#   - Arcane Agent: Remote container management (manager initiates pairing)
#   - Alloy Agent: Grafana Alloy for log collection to Loki
# =============================================================================

- name: Configure container agents for ${container_name}
  hosts: ${container_name}
  gather_facts: true

  vars:
    container_id: "${container_id}"
    container_name: "${container_name}"

    # Pulse agent config
    pulse_enabled: ${pulse_enabled}
    pulse_url: "${pulse_url}"
    pulse_token: "${pulse_token}"

    # Arcane agent config
    arcane_enabled: ${arcane_enabled}
    manager_url: "${manager_url}"
    bootstrap_token: "${bootstrap_token}"

    # Alloy agent config
    alloy_enabled: ${alloy_enabled}
    loki_url: "${loki_url}"

    # Shared paths
    sidecars_dir: /config/sidecars
    compose_file: /config/sidecars/docker-compose.yml

  tasks:
    # =========================================================================
    # Create Sidecar Directory
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create sidecars directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ sidecars_dir }}"
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'

    # =========================================================================
    # Deploy Unified Docker Compose
    # =========================================================================
    # Single compose file with all enabled agents to prevent --remove-orphans
    # from removing the "other" agent when updating just one.

    - name: Deploy unified agents docker-compose
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          # =============================================================================
          # Container Management Agents - ${container_name}
          # =============================================================================
          # Generated by OpenTofu lxc-sidecars module
          # DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY - changes will be overwritten
          # =============================================================================

          services:
%{ if pulse_enabled ~}
            # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
            # Pulse Docker Agent - Container Monitoring
            # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
            # NOTE: pulse-docker-agent is deprecated. Pulse v5.0+ introduces a unified
            # agent (binary install). Until v5.0 is stable, continue using this image.
            pulse-agent:
              image: ghcr.io/rcourtman/pulse-docker-agent:latest
              container_name: pulse-agent
              pid: host
              uts: host
              environment:
                - PULSE_URL=${pulse_url}
                - PULSE_TOKEN=${pulse_token}
              volumes:
                - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
              deploy:
                resources:
                  limits:
                    memory: 128m
                    cpus: '0.25'
                  reservations:
                    memory: 64m
                    cpus: '0.1'
              restart: unless-stopped
              healthcheck:
                test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pgrep pulse-docker-agent || exit 1"]
                interval: 30s
                timeout: 10s
                retries: 3
                start_period: 30s

%{ endif ~}
%{ if arcane_enabled ~}
            # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
            # Arcane Agent - Remote Container Management
            # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
            arcane-agent:
              image: ghcr.io/getarcaneapp/arcane-headless:latest
              container_name: arcane-agent
              ports:
                - "3553:3553"
              environment:
                - AGENT_MODE=true
                - AGENT_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN=${bootstrap_token}
              volumes:
                - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
                - arcane_agent_data:/app/data
              deploy:
                resources:
                  limits:
                    memory: 256m
                    cpus: '0.5'
                  reservations:
                    memory: 128m
                    cpus: '0.1'
              restart: unless-stopped
              healthcheck:
                test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -sf http://localhost:3553/api/health || exit 1"]
                interval: 30s
                timeout: 10s
                retries: 3
                start_period: 30s

%{ endif ~}
%{ if alloy_enabled ~}
            # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
            # Alloy Agent - Log Collection to Loki
            # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
            alloy:
              image: grafana/alloy:v1.5.1
              container_name: alloy
              command:
                - run
                - --server.http.listen-addr=0.0.0.0:12345
                - /etc/alloy/config.alloy
              volumes:
                - /config/sidecars/alloy.river:/etc/alloy/config.alloy:ro
                - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
                - /var/log:/var/log/host:ro
              deploy:
                resources:
                  limits:
                    memory: 128m
                    cpus: '0.25'
                  reservations:
                    memory: 64m
                    cpus: '0.1'
              restart: unless-stopped
              healthcheck:
                test: ["CMD", "wget", "-qO-", "http://localhost:12345/-/ready"]
                interval: 30s
                timeout: 10s
                retries: 3
                start_period: 30s

%{ endif ~}
%{ if arcane_enabled ~}
          volumes:
            arcane_agent_data:
%{ endif ~}
        dest: "{{ compose_file }}"
        mode: '0644'
      register: compose_file_result

    # =========================================================================
    # Deploy Alloy Configuration
    # =========================================================================
%{ if alloy_enabled ~}
    - name: Deploy Alloy River configuration
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          // =============================================================================
          // Grafana Alloy Configuration - ${container_name} (LXC ${container_id})
          // =============================================================================
          // Generated by OpenTofu lxc-sidecars module
          // DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY - changes will be overwritten
          // =============================================================================

          // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
          // Docker Log Discovery
          // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
          discovery.docker "containers" {
            host = "unix:///var/run/docker.sock"
          }

          discovery.relabel "docker_logs" {
            targets = discovery.docker.containers.targets

            // Keep container name as label
            rule {
              source_labels = ["__meta_docker_container_name"]
              regex         = "/(.*)"
              target_label  = "container"
            }

            // Add compose service name if available
            rule {
              source_labels = ["__meta_docker_container_label_com_docker_compose_service"]
              target_label  = "service"
            }

            // Add LXC identifier
            rule {
              target_label = "lxc"
              replacement  = "${container_name}"
            }

            rule {
              target_label = "lxc_id"
              replacement  = "${container_id}"
            }
          }

          loki.source.docker "containers" {
            host       = "unix:///var/run/docker.sock"
            targets    = discovery.relabel.docker_logs.output
            forward_to = [loki.write.default.receiver]
          }

          // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
          // Journal Logs (systemd)
          // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
          loki.source.journal "systemd" {
            forward_to = [loki.process.journal.receiver]
            labels = {
              job    = "journal",
              lxc    = "${container_name}",
              lxc_id = "${container_id}",
            }
          }

          loki.process "journal" {
            forward_to = [loki.write.default.receiver]

            stage.static_labels {
              values = {
                source = "journal",
              }
            }
          }

          // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
          // Loki Write Endpoint
          // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
          loki.write "default" {
            endpoint {
              url = "${loki_url}/loki/api/v1/push"
            }
          }
        dest: "{{ sidecars_dir }}/alloy.river"
        mode: '0644'
%{ endif ~}

    # =========================================================================
    # Pull Latest Images
    # =========================================================================
%{ if pulse_enabled ~}
    - name: Pull Pulse agent image
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker pull ghcr.io/rcourtman/pulse-docker-agent:latest
      changed_when: true
%{ endif ~}

%{ if arcane_enabled ~}
    - name: Pull Arcane agent image
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker pull ghcr.io/getarcaneapp/arcane-headless:latest
      changed_when: true
%{ endif ~}

%{ if alloy_enabled ~}
    - name: Pull Alloy image
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker pull grafana/alloy:v1.5.1
      changed_when: true
%{ endif ~}

    # =========================================================================
    # Deploy Agent Containers
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Deploy agent containers
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker compose -f {{ compose_file }} up -d --remove-orphans
      register: deploy_result
      changed_when: "'Started' in deploy_result.stderr or 'Creating' in deploy_result.stderr"

    # =========================================================================
    # Verify Deployment
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Wait for agents to start
      ansible.builtin.pause:
        seconds: 10

%{ if pulse_enabled ~}
    - name: Check Pulse agent status
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker ps --filter name=pulse-agent --format "{{ '{{' }}.Status{{ '}}' }}"
      register: pulse_status
      changed_when: false
%{ endif ~}

%{ if arcane_enabled ~}
    - name: Check Arcane agent status
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker ps --filter name=arcane-agent --format "{{ '{{' }}.Status{{ '}}' }}"
      register: arcane_status
      changed_when: false
%{ endif ~}

%{ if alloy_enabled ~}
    - name: Check Alloy agent status
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker ps --filter name=alloy --format "{{ '{{' }}.Status{{ '}}' }}"
      register: alloy_status
      changed_when: false
%{ endif ~}

    - name: Display deployment summary
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "=== Container Agents Deployed for ${container_name} ==="
          - ""
          - "Container ID: ${container_id}"
%{ if pulse_enabled ~}
          - "Pulse Agent: {{ pulse_status.stdout | default('not running') }}"
          - "  → Pulse URL: ${pulse_url}"

I see the current setup. Let me propose a practical approach:

**Recommended: Basic Auth with nginx sidecar on monitoring LXC**

The cleanest approach for machine-to-machine auth is:
1. Add an **nginx sidecar** on the monitoring LXC that sits in front of Loki and Prometheus
2. Configure **Basic Auth** with credentials stored in 1Password
3. Alloy sidecars connect via Basic Auth

This is similar to how many production setups work (Grafana Cloud uses this pattern for Loki push).

**Why not Traefik?**
- Traefik is for external access, not internal service-to-service
- Adding internal routes to Traefik adds complexity and couples internal services to the reverse proxy
- Basic Auth on a local nginx sidecar is simpler and more isolated

Let me outline what needs to change:

1. **Create 1Password item** `alloy-agents` with tokens per LXC (like pulse-agents/arcane-agents)
2. **Add nginx sidecar** to monitoring docker-compose with Basic Auth
3. **Update lxc-sidecars module** to pass auth credentials to Alloy config
4. **Update Alloy configs** to include Basic Auth in Loki write endpoint

content.text:
Good question. Using Traefik with Basic Auth middleware (without Authelia) would work. Let me think through the tradeoffs:

**Using Traefik:**
- ✅ Already deployed and managing all routes
- ✅ Has built-in `basicauth` middleware
- ✅ TLS termination already configured
- ❌ Routes through Traefik LXC (10.100.1.100) → adds network hop
- ❌ External exposure risk if misconfigured
- ❌ Couples internal services to external proxy

**Using nginx sidecar:**
- ✅ Local to monitoring LXC (no network hop)
- ✅ Isolated - only handles internal traffic
- ✅ Simpler to reason about
- ❌ Another container to manage

Actually, you make a fair point - if we're already using Traefik for everything, adding internal routes with Basic Auth is consistent with the existing pattern. The key is to:
1. Use **internal routes only** (no external exposure)
2. Apply **basicauth middleware** (not Authelia)

# Common Traefik middlewares and transports for homelab
http:
  # ServersTransport for backends with self-signed certificates
  serversTransports:
    insecure:
      insecureSkipVerify: true

  middlewares:
    security-headers:
      headers:
        browserXssFilter: true
        contentTypeNosniff: true
        forceSTSHeader: true
        stsIncludeSubdomains: true
        stsPreload: true
        stsSeconds: 31536000
        customFrameOptionsValue: "SAMEORIGIN"
        referrerPolicy: "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"

    public-security:
      headers:
        browserXssFilter: true
        contentTypeNosniff: true
        customFrameOptionsValue: "SAMEORIGIN"
        referrerPolicy: "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"

    # Internal-only: Allow only local network and Tailscale
    internal-only:
      ipAllowList:
        sourceRange:
          - "192.168.1.0/24"    # Local LAN
          - "100.64.0.0/10"     # Tailscale CGNAT range
          - "127.0.0.1/32"      # Localhost

    # Authelia forward auth middleware
    authelia:
      forwardAuth:
        address: "http://10.100.2.202:9091/api/authz/forward-auth"
        trustForwardHeader: true
        authResponseHeaders:
          - "Remote-User"
          - "Remote-Groups"
          - "Remote-Email"
          - "Remote-Name"

Now I understand the setup better. Here's the plan for using Traefik with Basic Auth:

**Implementation Plan:**

1. **Create new routes for Loki push and Prometheus remote write** with Basic Auth middleware
   - `loki-push.homelab.rambtech.dev` → Loki :3100 (internal only + basicauth)
   - `prometheus-push.homelab.rambtech.dev` → Prometheus :9090 (internal only + basicauth)

4. **Store credentials** in 1Password (similar to pulse-agents/arcane-agents pattern)

However, there's one consideration: **Traefik Basic Auth uses htpasswd format**, which requires hashed passwords. We'd need to either:
- Generate htpasswd hashes at deploy time

Let me propose a simpler alternative that's actually more consistent with your existing auth pattern:

**Alternative: Use Traefik's ForwardAuth with a simple token validation service**

I see. The current setup uses direct IP access (`http://10.100.5.100:3100`), not going through Traefik. This is actually the right pattern for internal service-to-service communication.

Here's my recommendation:

**Option A: Route through Traefik (your suggestion)**
- Create internal routes: `loki-push.homelab.rambtech.dev`, `prometheus-push.homelab.rambtech.dev`
- Add `basicauth-alloy` middleware
- Pro: Centralized auth, consistent with other services
- Con: Adds network hop, more moving parts

**Option B: Add nginx auth proxy on monitoring LXC**
- Add nginx container on monitoring LXC that fronts Loki:3100
- Alloy connects to nginx:3101 (or similar) with Basic Auth
- Pro: Local to monitoring, simpler
- Con: Another container to manage

**Option C: Use Loki's built-in tenant ID header**
- Enable `auth_enabled: true` in Loki
- Each Alloy sets `X-Scope-OrgID` header with its LXC name
- Pro: Native Loki feature, no proxy needed
- Con: Not real auth (just tenant isolation), anyone can claim any tenant

Given you want consistency with existing patterns and already have Traefik, let's go with **Option A - Traefik routes with Basic Auth**.

# Traefik v3 static configuration for homelab
global:
  checkNewVersion: false
  sendAnonymousUsage: false

api:
  dashboard: true
  debug: false
  insecure: false

# Prometheus metrics endpoint
metrics:
  prometheus:
    entryPoint: metrics
    addEntryPointsLabels: true
    addRoutersLabels: true
    addServicesLabels: true

ping:
  entryPoint: ping

entryPoints:
  ping:
    address: ":8081"
  web:
    address: ":80"
  websecure:
    address: ":443"
    http:
      tls:
        certResolver: letsencrypt
  metrics:
    address: ":8082"

providers:
  file:
    directory: "/config/dynamic"
    watch: true

# Traefik v3 syntax for certificate resolvers
certificatesResolvers:
  letsencrypt:
    acme:
      email: ${CF_API_EMAIL}
      storage: /config/certs/acme.json
      dnsChallenge:
        provider: cloudflare
        resolvers:
          - "1.1.1.1:53"
          - "1.0.0.1:53"
        delayBeforeCheck: 60s

log:
  level: INFO
  filePath: "/config/logs/traefik.log"

accessLog:
  filePath: "/config/logs/access.log"

# Default serversTransport validates TLS certificates
# For backends with self-signed certs, use @insecure-transport in dynamic config
serversTransport:
  insecureSkipVerify: false

# =============================================================================
# Traefik LXC - Reverse Proxy & Ingress Controller
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 200
#
# This deployment uses the docker-lxc module which handles:
#   1. LXC container creation with Docker pre-installed
#   2. File sync via rsync (file-sync module)
#   3. Docker Compose deployment
#   4. Proxmox notes generation
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# App-specific Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Traefik LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 200
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 2048
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 8
}

variable "rootfs_storage" {
  description = "Storage pool for root filesystem"
  type        = string
  default     = "nvme-containers"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "traefik" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "traefik"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (dual-NIC: container network + LAN for external access)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.dashboards.traefik}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  lan_ip       = "${local.lan_ips.traefik}${local.network.lan_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # MUST be privileged for binding to ports 80/443
  unprivileged = false

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Exclude migrated routes (managed by traefik-route module) and env templates (env is generated)
  exclude_patterns = ["^migrated-dynamic/", "^\\.env"]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Traefik"
  service_description = "Reverse proxy and ingress controller for all homelab services"

  service_urls = {
    dashboard_internal = "https://traefik.${var.domain_internal}/dashboard/"
    direct             = "http://${local.traefik_ip}:8080/dashboard/"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "HTTP", port = 80, info = "HTTP entrypoint (redirects to HTTPS)" },
    { name = "HTTPS", port = 443, info = "HTTPS entrypoint with Let's Encrypt" },
    { name = "Metrics", port = 8082, info = "Prometheus metrics endpoint" }
  ]

  custom_notes = file("${path.module}/notes.md")

  tags = ["traefik", "ingress", "reverse-proxy"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "traefik_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    cf_api_token = local.op.cloudflare_api_token
    cf_api_email = local.op.cloudflare_email
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/traefik.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "traefik_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.traefik_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = local.traefik_ip

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.traefik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "traefik_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.traefik.container_id
  container_ip   = module.traefik.ip_address
  container_name = "traefik"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-200"

    pre_backup_commands = []  # No database - config only

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/config/acme.json", "/config/logs/**"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,traefik"
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["traefik"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["traefik"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  alloy_agent = {
    enabled = true
  }

  depends_on = [module.traefik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.traefik.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.traefik.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.traefik.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    dashboard_internal = "https://traefik.${var.domain_internal}/dashboard/"
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# Traefik LXC - Reverse Proxy & Ingress Controller
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 200
#
# This deployment uses the docker-lxc module which handles:
#   1. LXC container creation with Docker pre-installed
#   2. File sync via rsync (file-sync module)
#   3. Docker Compose deployment
#   4. Proxmox notes generation
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# App-specific Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Traefik LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 200
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 2048
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 8
}

variable "rootfs_storage" {
  description = "Storage pool for root filesystem"
  type        = string
  default     = "nvme-containers"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "traefik" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "traefik"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (dual-NIC: container network + LAN for external access)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.dashboards.traefik}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  lan_ip       = "${local.lan_ips.traefik}${local.network.lan_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # MUST be privileged for binding to ports 80/443
  unprivileged = false

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Exclude migrated routes (managed by traefik-route module) and env templates (env is generated)
  exclude_patterns = ["^migrated-dynamic/", "^\\.env"]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Traefik"
  service_description = "Reverse proxy and ingress controller for all homelab services"

  service_urls = {
    dashboard_internal = "https://traefik.${var.domain_internal}/dashboard/"
    direct             = "http://${local.traefik_ip}:8080/dashboard/"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "HTTP", port = 80, info = "HTTP entrypoint (redirects to HTTPS)" },
    { name = "HTTPS", port = 443, info = "HTTPS entrypoint with Let's Encrypt" },
    { name = "Metrics", port = 8082, info = "Prometheus metrics endpoint" }
  ]

  custom_notes = file("${path.module}/notes.md")

  tags = ["traefik", "ingress", "reverse-proxy"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "traefik_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    cf_api_token = local.op.cloudflare_api_token
    cf_api_email = local.op.cloudflare_email
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/traefik.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "traefik_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.traefik_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = local.traefik_ip

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.traefik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "traefik_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.traefik.container_id
  container_ip   = module.traefik.ip_address
  container_name = "traefik"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-200"

    pre_backup_commands = []  # No database - config only

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/config/acme.json", "/config/logs/**"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,traefik"
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["traefik"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["traefik"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  alloy_agent = {
    enabled = true
  }

  depends_on = [module.traefik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.traefik.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.traefik.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.traefik.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    dashboard_internal = "https://traefik.${var.domain_internal}/dashboard/"
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# Traefik LXC - Reverse Proxy & Ingress Controller
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 200
#
# This deployment uses the docker-lxc module which handles:
#   1. LXC container creation with Docker pre-installed
#   2. File sync via rsync (file-sync module)
#   3. Docker Compose deployment
#   4. Proxmox notes generation
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# App-specific Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Traefik LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 200
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 2048
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 8
}

variable "rootfs_storage" {
  description = "Storage pool for root filesystem"
  type        = string
  default     = "nvme-containers"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "traefik" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "traefik"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (dual-NIC: container network + LAN for external access)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.dashboards.traefik}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  lan_ip       = "${local.lan_ips.traefik}${local.network.lan_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # MUST be privileged for binding to ports 80/443
  unprivileged = false

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Exclude migrated routes (managed by traefik-route module) and env templates (env is generated)
  exclude_patterns = ["^migrated-dynamic/", "^\\.env"]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Traefik"
  service_description = "Reverse proxy and ingress controller for all homelab services"

  service_urls = {
    dashboard_internal = "https://traefik.${var.domain_internal}/dashboard/"
    direct             = "http://${local.traefik_ip}:8080/dashboard/"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "HTTP", port = 80, info = "HTTP entrypoint (redirects to HTTPS)" },
    { name = "HTTPS", port = 443, info = "HTTPS entrypoint with Let's Encrypt" },
    { name = "Metrics", port = 8082, info = "Prometheus metrics endpoint" }
  ]

  custom_notes = file("${path.module}/notes.md")

  tags = ["traefik", "ingress", "reverse-proxy"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "traefik_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    cf_api_token = local.op.cloudflare_api_token
    cf_api_email = local.op.cloudflare_email
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/traefik.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "traefik_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.traefik_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = local.traefik_ip

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.traefik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Alloy Auth Middleware (for Loki/Prometheus push endpoints)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Creates authenticated endpoints for Alloy agents to push logs and metrics

resource "local_sensitive_file" "alloy_auth_config" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/dynamic/alloy-auth.yml.tpl", {
    htpasswd      = local.op.alloy_telemetry_htpasswd
    domain        = var.domain_internal
    monitoring_ip = local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/alloy-auth.yml"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "alloy_auth_config" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.alloy_auth_config.filename
  destination = "/config/dynamic/alloy-auth.yml"
  host        = local.traefik_ip

  mode = "0644"

  depends_on = [module.traefik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "traefik_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.traefik.container_id
  container_ip   = module.traefik.ip_address
  container_name = "traefik"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-200"

    pre_backup_commands = []  # No database - config only

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/config/acme.json", "/config/logs/**"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,traefik"
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["traefik"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["traefik"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  alloy_agent = {
    enabled = true
  }

  depends_on = [module.traefik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.traefik.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.traefik.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.traefik.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    dashboard_internal = "https://traefik.${var.domain_internal}/dashboard/"
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# Configure Container Management Agents in LXC Container
# =============================================================================
# This playbook is generated by the lxc-sidecars OpenTofu module.
# It deploys all enabled agents in a single docker-compose file to avoid
# conflicts from separate compose projects removing each other's containers.

# Agents:
#   - Pulse Docker Agent: Container monitoring (pushes metrics to Pulse server)
#   - Arcane Agent: Remote container management (manager initiates pairing)
#   - Alloy Agent: Grafana Alloy for log collection to Loki
# =============================================================================

- name: Configure container agents for ${container_name}
  hosts: ${container_name}
  gather_facts: true

  vars:
    container_id: "${container_id}"
    container_name: "${container_name}"

    # Pulse agent config
    pulse_enabled: ${pulse_enabled}
    pulse_url: "${pulse_url}"
    pulse_token: "${pulse_token}"

    # Arcane agent config
    arcane_enabled: ${arcane_enabled}
    manager_url: "${manager_url}"
    bootstrap_token: "${bootstrap_token}"

    # Alloy agent config
    alloy_enabled: ${alloy_enabled}
    loki_url: "${loki_url}"

    # Shared paths
    sidecars_dir: /config/sidecars
    compose_file: /config/sidecars/docker-compose.yml

  tasks:
    # =========================================================================
    # Create Sidecar Directory
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create sidecars directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ sidecars_dir }}"
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'

    # =========================================================================
    # Deploy Unified Docker Compose
    # =========================================================================
    # Single compose file with all enabled agents to prevent --remove-orphans
    # from removing the "other" agent when updating just one.

    - name: Deploy unified agents docker-compose
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          # =============================================================================
          # Container Management Agents - ${container_name}
          # =============================================================================
          # Generated by OpenTofu lxc-sidecars module
          # DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY - changes will be overwritten
          # =============================================================================

          services:
%{ if pulse_enabled ~}
            # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
            # Pulse Docker Agent - Container Monitoring
            # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
            # NOTE: pulse-docker-agent is deprecated. Pulse v5.0+ introduces a unified
            # agent (binary install). Until v5.0 is stable, continue using this image.
            pulse-agent:
              image: ghcr.io/rcourtman/pulse-docker-agent:latest
              container_name: pulse-agent
              pid: host
              uts: host
              environment:
                - PULSE_URL=${pulse_url}
                - PULSE_TOKEN=${pulse_token}
              volumes:
                - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
              deploy:
                resources:
                  limits:
                    memory: 128m
                    cpus: '0.25'
                  reservations:
                    memory: 64m
                    cpus: '0.1'
              restart: unless-stopped
              healthcheck:
                test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pgrep pulse-docker-agent || exit 1"]
                interval: 30s
                timeout: 10s
                retries: 3
                start_period: 30s

%{ endif ~}
%{ if arcane_enabled ~}
            # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
            # Arcane Agent - Remote Container Management
            # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
            arcane-agent:
              image: ghcr.io/getarcaneapp/arcane-headless:latest
              container_name: arcane-agent
              ports:
                - "3553:3553"
              environment:
                - AGENT_MODE=true
                - AGENT_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN=${bootstrap_token}
              volumes:
                - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
                - arcane_agent_data:/app/data
              deploy:
                resources:
                  limits:
                    memory: 256m
                    cpus: '0.5'
                  reservations:
                    memory: 128m
                    cpus: '0.1'
              restart: unless-stopped
              healthcheck:
                test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -sf http://localhost:3553/api/health || exit 1"]
                interval: 30s
                timeout: 10s
                retries: 3
                start_period: 30s

%{ endif ~}
%{ if alloy_enabled ~}
            # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
            # Alloy Agent - Log Collection to Loki
            # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
            alloy:
              image: grafana/alloy:v1.5.1
              container_name: alloy
              command:
                - run
                - --server.http.listen-addr=0.0.0.0:12345
                - /etc/alloy/config.alloy
              volumes:
                - /config/sidecars/alloy.river:/etc/alloy/config.alloy:ro
                - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
                - /var/log:/var/log/host:ro
              deploy:
                resources:
                  limits:
                    memory: 128m
                    cpus: '0.25'
                  reservations:
                    memory: 64m
                    cpus: '0.1'
              restart: unless-stopped
              healthcheck:
                test: ["CMD", "wget", "-qO-", "http://localhost:12345/-/ready"]
                interval: 30s
                timeout: 10s
                retries: 3
                start_period: 30s

%{ endif ~}
%{ if arcane_enabled ~}
          volumes:
            arcane_agent_data:
%{ endif ~}
        dest: "{{ compose_file }}"
        mode: '0644'
      register: compose_file_result

    # Deploy Alloy Configuration
    # =========================================================================
%{ if alloy_enabled ~}

      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          // =============================================================================
          // Grafana Alloy Configuration - ${container_name} (LXC ${container_id})
          // =============================================================================
          // Generated by OpenTofu lxc-sidecars module
          // DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY - changes will be overwritten
          // =============================================================================

          // Docker Log Discovery

            host = "unix:///var/run/docker.sock"
          }

            targets = discovery.docker.containers.targets

            // Keep container name as label
            rule {
              source_labels = ["__meta_docker_container_name"]
              regex         = "/(.*)"
              target_label  = "container"
            }

            // Add compose service name if available
            rule {
              source_labels = ["__meta_docker_container_label_com_docker_compose_service"]
              target_label  = "service"
            }

            // Add LXC identifier
            rule {
              target_label = "lxc"
              replacement  = "${container_name}"
            }

            rule {
              target_label = "lxc_id"
              replacement  = "${container_id}"
            }
          }

          loki.source.docker "containers" {
            host       = "unix:///var/run/docker.sock"
            targets    = discovery.relabel.docker_logs.output
            forward_to = [loki.write.default.receiver]
          }

          // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
          // Journal Logs (systemd)
          // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
          loki.source.journal "systemd" {
            forward_to = [loki.process.journal.receiver]
            labels = {
              job    = "journal",
              lxc    = "${container_name}",
              lxc_id = "${container_id}",
            }
          }

          loki.process "journal" {
            forward_to = [loki.write.default.receiver]

            stage.static_labels {
              values = {
                source = "journal",
              }
            }
          }

          // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
          // Loki Write Endpoint
          // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
          loki.write "default" {
            endpoint {
              url = "${loki_url}/loki/api/v1/push"
            }
          }
        dest: "{{ sidecars_dir }}/alloy.river"
        mode: '0644'
%{ endif ~}

    # =========================================================================
    # Pull Latest Images
    # =========================================================================
%{ if pulse_enabled ~}
    - name: Pull Pulse agent image
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker pull ghcr.io/rcourtman/pulse-docker-agent:latest
      changed_when: true
%{ endif ~}

%{ if arcane_enabled ~}
    - name: Pull Arcane agent image
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker pull ghcr.io/getarcaneapp/arcane-headless:latest
      changed_when: true
%{ endif ~}

%{ if alloy_enabled ~}
    - name: Pull Alloy image
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker pull grafana/alloy:v1.5.1
      changed_when: true
%{ endif ~}

    # =========================================================================
    # Deploy Agent Containers
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Deploy agent containers
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker compose -f {{ compose_file }} up -d --remove-orphans
      register: deploy_result
      changed_when: "'Started' in deploy_result.stderr or 'Creating' in deploy_result.stderr"

    # =========================================================================

              environment:
                - AGENT_MODE=true
                - AGENT_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN=${bootstrap_token}
              volumes:
                - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
                - arcane_agent_data:/app/data
              deploy:
                resources:
                  limits:
                    memory: 256m
                    cpus: '0.5'
                  reservations:
                    memory: 128m
                    cpus: '0.1'
              restart: unless-stopped
              healthcheck:
                test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -sf http://localhost:3553/api/health || exit 1"]
                interval: 30s
                timeout: 10s
                retries: 3
                start_period: 30s

%{ endif ~}
%{ if alloy_enabled ~}
            # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
            # Alloy Agent - Log Collection to Loki
            # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
            alloy:
              image: grafana/alloy:v1.5.1
              container_name: alloy
              command:
                - run
                - --server.http.listen-addr=0.0.0.0:12345
                - /etc/alloy/config.alloy
              volumes:
                - /config/sidecars/alloy.river:/etc/alloy/config.alloy:ro
                - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
                - /var/log:/var/log/host:ro
              deploy:
                resources:
                  limits:
                    memory: 128m
                    cpus: '0.25'
                  reservations:
                    memory: 64m
                    cpus: '0.1'
              restart: unless-stopped
              healthcheck:
                test: ["CMD", "wget", "-qO-", "http://localhost:12345/-/ready"]
                interval: 30s
                timeout: 10s
                retries: 3
                start_period: 30s

%{ endif ~}
%{ if arcane_enabled ~}
          volumes:
            arcane_agent_data:
%{ endif ~}
        dest: "{{ compose_file }}"
        mode: '0644'
      register: compose_file_result

    # =========================================================================
    # Deploy Alloy Configuration
    # =========================================================================
%{ if alloy_enabled ~}
    - name: Deploy Alloy River configuration
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          // =============================================================================
          // Grafana Alloy Configuration - ${container_name} (LXC ${container_id})
          // =============================================================================
          // Generated by OpenTofu lxc-sidecars module
          // DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY - changes will be overwritten
          // =============================================================================

          // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
          // Docker Log Discovery
          // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
          discovery.docker "containers" {
            host = "unix:///var/run/docker.sock"
          }

          discovery.relabel "docker_logs" {
            targets = discovery.docker.containers.targets

            // Keep container name as label
            rule {
              source_labels = ["__meta_docker_container_name"]
              regex         = "/(.*)"
              target_label  = "container"
            }

            // Add compose service name if available
            rule {
              source_labels = ["__meta_docker_container_label_com_docker_compose_service"]
              target_label  = "service"
            }

            // Add LXC identifier
            rule {
              target_label = "lxc"
              replacement  = "${container_name}"
            }

            rule {
              target_label = "lxc_id"
              replacement  = "${container_id}"
            }
          }

          loki.source.docker "containers" {
            host       = "unix:///var/run/docker.sock"
            targets    = discovery.relabel.docker_logs.output
            forward_to = [loki.write.default.receiver]
          }

          // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
          // Journal Logs (systemd)
          // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
          loki.source.journal "systemd" {
            forward_to = [loki.process.journal.receiver]
            labels = {
              job    = "journal",
              lxc    = "${container_name}",
              lxc_id = "${container_id}",
            }
          }

          loki.process "journal" {
            forward_to = [loki.write.default.receiver]

            stage.static_labels {
              values = {
                source = "journal",
              }
            }
          }

          // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
          // Loki Write Endpoint
          // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
          loki.write "default" {
            endpoint {
              url = "${loki_url}/loki/api/v1/push"
            }
          }
        dest: "{{ sidecars_dir }}/alloy.river"
        mode: '0644'
%{ endif ~}

    # =========================================================================
    # Pull Latest Images
    # =========================================================================
%{ if pulse_enabled ~}
    - name: Pull Pulse agent image
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker pull ghcr.io/rcourtman/pulse-docker-agent:latest
      changed_when: true
%{ endif ~}

%{ if arcane_enabled ~}
    - name: Pull Arcane agent image
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker pull ghcr.io/getarcaneapp/arcane-headless:latest
      changed_when: true
%{ endif ~}

%{ if alloy_enabled ~}
    - name: Pull Alloy image
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker pull grafana/alloy:v1.5.1
      changed_when: true
%{ endif ~}

    # =========================================================================
    # Deploy Agent Containers
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Deploy agent containers
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker compose -f {{ compose_file }} up -d --remove-orphans
      register: deploy_result
      changed_when: "'Started' in deploy_result.stderr or 'Creating' in deploy_result.stderr"

    # =========================================================================
    # Verify Deployment
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Wait for agents to start
      ansible.builtin.pause:
        seconds: 10

%{ if pulse_enabled ~}
    - name: Check Pulse agent status
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker ps --filter name=pulse-agent --format "{{ '{{' }}.Status{{ '}}' }}"
      register: pulse_status
      changed_when: false
%{ endif ~}

%{ if arcane_enabled ~}
    - name: Check Arcane agent status
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker ps --filter name=arcane-agent --format "{{ '{{' }}.Status{{ '}}' }}"
      register: arcane_status
      changed_when: false
%{ endif ~}

%{ if alloy_enabled ~}
    - name: Check Alloy agent status
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker ps --filter name=alloy --format "{{ '{{' }}.Status{{ '}}' }}"
      register: alloy_status
      changed_when: false
%{ endif ~}

    - name: Display deployment summary
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "=== Container Agents Deployed for ${container_name} ==="
          - ""
          - "Container ID: ${container_id}"
%{ if pulse_enabled ~}
          - "Pulse Agent: {{ pulse_status.stdout | default('not running') }}"
          - "  → Pulse URL: ${pulse_url}"
%{ endif ~}
%{ if arcane_enabled ~}
          - "Arcane Agent: {{ arcane_status.stdout | default('not running') }}"
          - "  → Agent Port: 3553"
          - "  → Pair in Arcane UI: http://{{ ansible_host }}:3553"
%{ endif ~}
%{ if alloy_enabled ~}
          - "Alloy Agent: {{ alloy_status.stdout | default('not running') }}"
          - "  → Loki URL: ${loki_url}"
          - "  → Alloy UI: http://{{ ansible_host }}:12345"
%{ endif ~}
          - ""
          - "Compose file: {{ compose_file }}"
          - ""
          - "Commands:"
          - "  View logs:  docker compose -f {{ compose_file }} logs -f"
          - "  Restart:    docker compose -f {{ compose_file }} restart"
          - "  Status:     docker compose -f {{ compose_file }} ps"

module "n8n" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  # Identity
  name         = "n8n"
  container_id = 502

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.n8n}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores          = 2

# =============================================================================
# Traefik LXC - Reverse Proxy & Ingress Controller
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 200
#
# This deployment uses the docker-lxc module which handles:
#   1. LXC container creation with Docker pre-installed
#   2. File sync via rsync (file-sync module)
#   3. Docker Compose deployment
#   4. Proxmox notes generation
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# App-specific Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Traefik LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 200
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 2048
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 8
}

variable "rootfs_storage" {
  description = "Storage pool for root filesystem"
  type        = string
  default     = "nvme-containers"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "traefik" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "traefik"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (dual-NIC: container network + LAN for external access)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.dashboards.traefik}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  lan_ip       = "${local.lan_ips.traefik}${local.network.lan_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # MUST be privileged for binding to ports 80/443
  unprivileged = false

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Exclude migrated routes (managed by traefik-route module), env templates, and .tpl files
  exclude_patterns = ["^migrated-dynamic/", "^\\.env", "\\.tpl$"]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Traefik"
  service_description = "Reverse proxy and ingress controller for all homelab services"

  service_urls = {
    dashboard_internal = "https://traefik.${var.domain_internal}/dashboard/"
    direct             = "http://${local.traefik_ip}:8080/dashboard/"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "HTTP", port = 80, info = "HTTP entrypoint (redirects to HTTPS)" },
    { name = "HTTPS", port = 443, info = "HTTPS entrypoint with Let's Encrypt" },
    { name = "Metrics", port = 8082, info = "Prometheus metrics endpoint" }
  ]

  custom_notes = file("${path.module}/notes.md")

  tags = ["traefik", "ingress", "reverse-proxy"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "traefik_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    cf_api_token = local.op.cloudflare_api_token
    cf_api_email = local.op.cloudflare_email
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/traefik.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "traefik_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.traefik_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = local.traefik_ip

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.traefik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Alloy Auth Middleware (for Loki/Prometheus push endpoints)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Creates authenticated endpoints for Alloy agents to push logs and metrics

resource "local_sensitive_file" "alloy_auth_config" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/dynamic/alloy-auth.yml.tpl", {
    htpasswd      = local.op.alloy_telemetry_htpasswd
    domain        = var.domain_internal
    monitoring_ip = local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/alloy-auth.yml"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "alloy_auth_config" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.alloy_auth_config.filename
  destination = "/config/dynamic/alloy-auth.yml"
  host        = local.traefik_ip

  mode = "0644"

  depends_on = [module.traefik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "traefik_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.traefik.container_id
  container_ip   = module.traefik.ip_address
  container_name = "traefik"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
