# =============================================================================
# Container Management LXC - Pulse + Arcane
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 104
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# Container monitoring (Pulse) and management (Arcane).
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 104
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 2048
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 16
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Container Management LXC
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "container_mgmt" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "container-mgmt"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only - no LAN access needed)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.core.container_mgmt}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 512

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Container Management"
  service_description = "Pulse monitoring + Arcane container management"

  service_urls = {
    pulse  = "https://pulse.${var.domain_internal}"
    arcane = "https://arcane.${var.domain_internal}"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Pulse", port = 7655, info = "Proxmox + Docker monitoring" },
    { name = "Arcane", port = 3552, info = "Docker container management" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Pulse - Container Monitoring

Real-time monitoring for Proxmox VE and Docker containers.
- Dashboard: https://pulse.${var.domain_internal}
- Proxmox metrics via PVE API
- Docker metrics via socket

## Arcane - Container Management

Docker container management with update detection.
- Dashboard: https://arcane.${var.domain_internal}
- Remote agents connect from other LXCs

## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f pulse
cd /config && docker compose logs -f arcane
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=container-mgmt` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["pulse", "arcane", "management"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "local_sensitive_file" "container_mgmt_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    pulse_admin_user      = local.op.pulse_admin_user
    pulse_admin_password  = local.op.pulse_admin_password
    arcane_encryption_key = local.op.arcane_encryption_key
    arcane_jwt_secret     = local.op.arcane_jwt_secret
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/container-mgmt.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "container_mgmt_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.container_mgmt_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = module.container_mgmt.ip_address

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.container_mgmt]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Routes - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "pulse_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "pulse"
  backend_url = "http://${module.container_mgmt.ip_address}:7655"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "pulse.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.container_mgmt]
}

module "arcane_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "arcane"
  backend_url = "http://${module.container_mgmt.ip_address}:3552"

  internal_domain = "arcane.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.container_mgmt]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "container_mgmt_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.container_mgmt.container_id
  container_ip   = module.container_mgmt.ip_address
  container_name = "container-mgmt"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00" # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"         # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-104"

    pre_backup_commands = [] # No database - config only

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,container-mgmt"
  }

  alloy_agent = {
    enabled = true
  }

  depends_on = [module.container_mgmt]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.container_mgmt.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.container_mgmt.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.container_mgmt.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    pulse  = module.pulse_route.internal_url
    arcane = module.arcane_route.internal_url
  }
}

output "traefik_config_paths" {
  description = "Paths to Traefik configs on Traefik LXC"
  value = {
    pulse  = module.pulse_route.remote_config_path
    arcane = module.arcane_route.remote_config_path
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# Dashboards LXC - Homepage + Dashy + Glances
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 201
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1Password - Homepage API Keys
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "homepage" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "homepage"
}

locals {
  # Flatten all section fields from homepage item
  _homepage_fields = merge([
    for s in data.onepassword_item.homepage.section : {
      for f in s.field : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)

  # Homepage widget API keys
  homepage_env = {
    adguard_user   = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "adguard_user", "admin")
    adguard_pass   = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "adguard_pass", "")
    immich_key     = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "immich_key", "")
    jellyfin_key   = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "jellyfin_key", "")
    jellyseerr_key = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "jellyseerr_key", "")
    sonarr_key     = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "sonarr_key", "")
    radarr_key     = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "radarr_key", "")
    sabnzbd_key    = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "sabnzbd_key", "")
    qbit_user      = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "qbit_user", "admin")
    qbit_pass      = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "qbit_pass", "")
  }
}

# Generate the homepage.env file from 1Password secrets
resource "local_sensitive_file" "homepage_env" {
  filename = "${path.module}/deploy/homepage.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# Homepage Widget API Keys
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password
# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten

# AdGuard Home: Web UI credentials
HOMEPAGE_VAR_ADGUARD_USER=${local.homepage_env.adguard_user}
HOMEPAGE_VAR_ADGUARD_PASS=${local.homepage_env.adguard_pass}

# Immich: Account Settings > API Keys
HOMEPAGE_VAR_IMMICH_KEY=${local.homepage_env.immich_key}

# Jellyfin: Dashboard > API Keys
HOMEPAGE_VAR_JELLYFIN_KEY=${local.homepage_env.jellyfin_key}

# Jellyseerr: Settings > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_JELLYSEERR_KEY=${local.homepage_env.jellyseerr_key}

# Sonarr: Settings > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_SONARR_KEY=${local.homepage_env.sonarr_key}

# Radarr: Settings > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_RADARR_KEY=${local.homepage_env.radarr_key}

# SABnzbd: Config > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_SABNZBD_KEY=${local.homepage_env.sabnzbd_key}

# qBittorrent: Web UI credentials
HOMEPAGE_VAR_QBIT_USER=${local.homepage_env.qbit_user}
HOMEPAGE_VAR_QBIT_PASS=${local.homepage_env.qbit_pass}

}

  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "dashboards_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.dashboards.container_id
  container_ip   = module.dashboards.ip_address

  }

    enabled = true
  }

  depends_on = [module.dashboards]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.dashboards.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.dashboards.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.dashboards.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {

# =============================================================================

# Container ID: 101

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "network_services" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "network-services"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (dual-NIC: container network + LAN for DNS service)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.core.network_services}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  lan_ip       = "${local.lan_ips.network_services}${local.network.lan_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 1024

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Privileged for Tailscale kernel access
  unprivileged = false

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Network Services"
  service_description = "Core network infrastructure: DNS, tunnels, and VPN"

  service_urls = {
    adguard_internal = "https://dns.${var.domain_internal}"
    adguard_direct   = "http://${local.lan_ips.network_services}:3000"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "AdGuard Home", port = 53, info = "DNS server with ad blocking" },
    { name = "AdGuard UI", port = 3000, info = "Web management interface" },
    { name = "Cloudflared", port = 0, info = "Cloudflare tunnel (outbound only)" },
    { name = "Tailscale", port = 41641, info = "Mesh VPN (systemd service)" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Tailscale Management

Tailscale runs as a systemd service (not Docker) because it requires kernel-level network access.

**Check status:**
```bash
systemctl status tailscaled
tailscale status
```

**Restart if needed:**
```bash
systemctl restart tailscaled
```

## Docker Services

**View logs:**
```bash
cd /config && docker compose logs -f <service>
```

**Restart all services:**
```bash
cd /config && docker compose restart
```

## DNS Testing

**Test AdGuard (port 53):**
```bash
dig @${local.lan_ips.network_services} google.com
```

**Test internal DNS rewrites:**
```bash
dig @${local.lan_ips.network_services} traefik.homelab.rambtech.dev
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=network-services` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["network-services", "dns", "adguard", "cloudflare"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "network_services_env" {
  content = <<-EOT
# Network Services Environment Variables
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password
# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten

# Cloudflare Tunnel Token
CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_TOKEN=${local.op.cloudflare_tunnel_token}

# Cloudflare API Token for DDNS
CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN=${local.op.cloudflare_api_token}

# Domains to update with DDNS

EOT

}

}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Tailscale Service Management via Ansible
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Ensures Tailscale daemon is running and connected after deployment

resource "ansible_navigator_run" "manage_tailscale" {
  depends_on = [module.network_services]

  # Re-run when container is rebuilt or network config changes
  triggers = {
    container_id = var.container_id
    lan_ip       = local.lan_ips.network_services
  }

  execution_environment = {
    enabled = false  # Run ansible directly on host
  }

  ansible_options = {
    private_keys = [{
      name = "homelab"
      data = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    }]
  }

  playbook = <<-EOT
    - name: Manage Tailscale service on network-services
      hosts: lxc
      gather_facts: no
      vars:
        app_name: network-services

      tasks:
        # =====================================================================
        # Tailscale Service Management
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Ensure Tailscale daemon is running
          ansible.builtin.systemd:
            name: tailscaled
            state: started
            enabled: true
          register: tailscale_service

        - name: Wait for Tailscale to initialize
          ansible.builtin.pause:
            seconds: 3
          when: tailscale_service.changed

        # =====================================================================
        # Verify Tailscale Status
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Check Tailscale connection status
          ansible.builtin.command:
            cmd: tailscale status --json
          register: tailscale_status
          changed_when: false
          failed_when: false

        - name: Parse Tailscale status
          ansible.builtin.set_fact:
            tailscale_info: "{{ tailscale_status.stdout | from_json }}"
          when: tailscale_status.rc == 0

        - name: Display Tailscale connection info
          ansible.builtin.debug:
            msg: |
              Tailscale Status: {{ 'Connected' if (tailscale_info.BackendState | default('')) == 'Running' else 'Not Connected' }}
              Tailnet IP: {{ tailscale_info.Self.TailscaleIPs[0] | default('N/A') }}
              Hostname: {{ tailscale_info.Self.HostName | default('N/A') }}
          when: tailscale_status.rc == 0

        - name: Warn if Tailscale not connected
          ansible.builtin.debug:
            msg: "WARNING: Tailscale is not connected. Check authentication status with 'tailscale status'"
          when: tailscale_status.rc != 0 or (tailscale_info.BackendState | default('')) != 'Running'
  EOT

  inventory = yamlencode({
    lxc = {
      hosts = {
        "network-services" = {
          ansible_host = module.network_services.ip_address
          ansible_user = "root"
        }
      }
    }
  })
}

  # Container monitoring agents

  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true

  }

  }

content.text:
Now I need to update the monitoring LXC's Alloy config. The monitoring LXC is special - its Alloy is deployed via docker-compose, not as a sidecar. But it can still use the authenticated endpoints for consistency, or it can use direct localhost access since Loki and Prometheus are on the same container.

Actually, for the monitoring LXC, since Alloy, Loki, and Prometheus are all in the same docker-compose network, it should use direct `http://loki:3100` and `http://prometheus:9090` - no auth needed for localhost connections. This is the current setup and is correct.

Let me verify the monitoring Alloy config doesn't need changes:

The monitoring LXC's Alloy config uses `http://loki:3100` and `http://prometheus:9090` which are direct Docker network connections. No auth is needed here because:
1. They're on the same Docker network (internal to the monitoring LXC)
2. No external access to these ports is required

This is correct and should stay as-is. The auth is only for external Alloy sidecars connecting via Traefik.

# Prometheus Configuration
# Receives metrics from Grafana Alloy and scrapes additional targets

global:
  scrape_interval: 30s
  evaluation_interval: 30s
  external_labels:
    monitor: 'homelab'

# Alerting configuration
alerting:
  alertmanagers:
    - static_configs:
        - targets:
            - alertmanager:9093

# Rule files for alerts
rule_files:
  - /etc/prometheus/alerts/*.yml

# Scrape configurations
scrape_configs:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Monitoring Stack Self-Monitoring
  # ==========================================================================

  # Prometheus self-monitoring
  - job_name: 'prometheus'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['localhost:9090']

  # Grafana Alloy metrics (replaces OTEL Collector)
  - job_name: 'alloy'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['alloy:12345']

  # Loki metrics
  - job_name: 'loki'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['loki:3100']

  # Alertmanager metrics
  - job_name: 'alertmanager'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['alertmanager:9093']

  # Grafana metrics
  - job_name: 'grafana'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['grafana:3000']

  # ==========================================================================
  # Traefik Reverse Proxy Metrics
  # ==========================================================================
  - job_name: 'traefik'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['10.100.2.200:8082']
        labels:
          instance: 'traefik'
          lxc_id: '200'

  # ==========================================================================
  # AdGuard Home - DNS Metrics
  # Native Prometheus metrics not yet available in v0.107.70
  # TODO: Enable when PR #7937 is merged, or deploy adguard-exporter sidecar
  # https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdGuardHome/pull/7937
  # ==========================================================================
  # - job_name: 'adguard'
  #   static_configs:
  #     - targets: ['192.168.1.196:9618']
  #       labels:
  #         instance: 'adguard'
  #         lxc_id: '101'

  # ==========================================================================
  # Immich - Photo Management Metrics
  # Metrics pushed via OTLP to Alloy (no scrape needed)
  # ==========================================================================

  # ==========================================================================
  # Jellyfin - Media Server Metrics
  # Requires: Prometheus plugin installed in Jellyfin
  # ==========================================================================
  # - job_name: 'jellyfin'
  #   static_configs:
  #     - targets: ['10.100.4.101:8096']
  #       labels:
  #         instance: 'jellyfin'
  #         lxc_id: '226'

  # ==========================================================================
  # Uptime Kuma - Status Page Metrics
  # API key stored in 1Password: homelab/Uptime Kuma/cli key
  # ==========================================================================
  - job_name: 'uptime-kuma'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['uptime-kuma:3001']
        labels:
          instance: 'uptime-kuma'
    metrics_path: /metrics
    basic_auth:
      username: ''
      password: uk1_w3iNK0lQANt8O70jzqHDaebGH0mPorB9bCVTOa-2

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy - Push Notification Metrics
  # NOTE: Disabled - Docker DNS resolves 'ntfy' to external DNS (ntfy.homelab.rambtech.dev)
  # instead of container name due to search domain. Low-value metrics anyway.
  # ==========================================================================
  # - job_name: 'ntfy'
  #   static_configs:
  #     - targets: ['ntfy:9090']
  #       labels:
  #         instance: 'ntfy'
  #   metrics_path: /metrics

# ==========================================================================
# Metrics Coverage Summary
# ==========================================================================
#
# SCRAPED (Pull):
#   - prometheus, alertmanager, grafana, alloy, loki (self-monitoring)
#   - traefik (reverse proxy metrics)
#   - uptime-kuma (status page metrics)
#
# PUSHED (via OTLP to Alloy):
#   - Proxmox VE (node, VM, storage metrics)
#   - Immich (photo library metrics) - enable in Settings > Telemetry
#
# NOT YET AVAILABLE:
#   - AdGuard: No native support, PR #7937 pending
#   - Jellyfin: Requires plugin installation
#   - OpenWebUI: No metrics endpoint
#   - n8n: Requires N8N_METRICS=true env var

# Prometheus Configuration
# Receives metrics from Grafana Alloy and scrapes additional targets

global:
  scrape_interval: 30s
  evaluation_interval: 30s
  external_labels:
    monitor: 'homelab'

# Alerting configuration
alerting:
  alertmanagers:
    - static_configs:
        - targets:
            - alertmanager:9093

# Rule files for alerts
rule_files:
  - /etc/prometheus/alerts/*.yml

# Scrape configurations
scrape_configs:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Monitoring Stack Self-Monitoring
  # ==========================================================================

  # Prometheus self-monitoring
  - job_name: 'prometheus'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['localhost:9090']

  # Grafana Alloy metrics (replaces OTEL Collector)
  - job_name: 'alloy'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['alloy:12345']

  # Loki metrics
  - job_name: 'loki'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['loki:3100']

  # Alertmanager metrics
  - job_name: 'alertmanager'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['alertmanager:9093']

  # Grafana metrics
  - job_name: 'grafana'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['grafana:3000']

  # ==========================================================================
  # Traefik Reverse Proxy Metrics
  # ==========================================================================
  - job_name: 'traefik'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['10.100.2.200:8082']
        labels:
          instance: 'traefik'
          lxc_id: '200'

  # ==========================================================================
  # AdGuard Home - DNS Metrics
  # Native Prometheus metrics not yet available in v0.107.70
  # TODO: Enable when PR #7937 is merged, or deploy adguard-exporter sidecar
  # https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdGuardHome/pull/7937
  # ==========================================================================
  # - job_name: 'adguard'
  #   static_configs:
  #     - targets: ['192.168.1.196:9618']
  #       labels:
  #         instance: 'adguard'
  #         lxc_id: '101'

  # ==========================================================================
  # Immich - Photo Management Metrics
  # Metrics pushed via OTLP to Alloy (no scrape needed)
  # ==========================================================================

  # ==========================================================================
  # Jellyfin - Media Server Metrics
  # Requires: Prometheus plugin installed in Jellyfin
  # ==========================================================================
  # - job_name: 'jellyfin'
  #   static_configs:
  #     - targets: ['10.100.4.101:8096']
  #       labels:
  #         instance: 'jellyfin'
  #         lxc_id: '226'

  # ==========================================================================
  # Uptime Kuma - Status Page Metrics
  # API key stored in 1Password: homelab/Uptime Kuma/cli key
  # ==========================================================================
  - job_name: 'uptime-kuma'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['uptime-kuma:3001']
        labels:
          instance: 'uptime-kuma'
    metrics_path: /metrics
    basic_auth:
      username: ''
      password: uk1_w3iNK0lQANt8O70jzqHDaebGH0mPorB9bCVTOa-2

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy - Push Notification Metrics
  # NOTE: Disabled - Docker DNS resolves 'ntfy' to external DNS (ntfy.homelab.rambtech.dev)
  # instead of container name due to search domain. Low-value metrics anyway.
  # ==========================================================================
  # - job_name: 'ntfy'
  #   static_configs:
  #     - targets: ['ntfy:9090']
  #       labels:
  #         instance: 'ntfy'
  #   metrics_path: /metrics

# ==========================================================================
# Metrics Coverage Summary
# ==========================================================================
#
# SCRAPED (Pull):
#   - prometheus, alertmanager, grafana, alloy, loki (self-monitoring)
#   - traefik (reverse proxy metrics)
#   - uptime-kuma (status page metrics)
#
# PUSHED (via OTLP to Alloy):
#   - Proxmox VE (node, VM, storage metrics)
#   - Immich (photo library metrics) - enable in Settings > Telemetry
#
# NOT YET AVAILABLE:
#   - AdGuard: No native support, PR #7937 pending
#   - Jellyfin: Requires plugin installation
#   - OpenWebUI: No metrics endpoint
#   - n8n: Requires N8N_METRICS=true env var
#

# Remote write receiver enabled via --web.enable-remote-write-receiver flag
# This allows Alloy to push metrics

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Loki - Log aggregation
  # ==========================================================================
  loki:
    image: grafana/loki:3.3.2
    container_name: loki
    command: -config.file=/etc/loki/local-config.yaml
    ports:
      - "3100:3100"
    volumes:
      - ./loki/config.yaml:/etc/loki/local-config.yaml:ro
      - loki_data:/loki
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:3100/ready || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Grafana Alloy - Unified telemetry collector (replaces OTEL Collector)
  # ==========================================================================
  alloy:
    image: grafana/alloy:v1.5.1
    container_name: alloy
    command:
      - run
      - --server.http.listen-addr=0.0.0.0:12345
      - --storage.path=/var/lib/alloy/data
      - /etc/alloy/config.alloy
    ports:
      - "4317:4317"   # OTLP gRPC receiver (backwards compat)
      - "4318:4318"   # OTLP HTTP receiver (backwards compat)
      - "12345:12345" # Alloy UI
    volumes:
      - ./alloy/config.alloy:/etc/alloy/config.alloy:ro
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
      - /var/log:/var/log/host:ro
      - alloy_data:/var/lib/alloy/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
      - loki
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "-qO-", "http://localhost:12345/-/ready"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Prometheus - Metrics storage and alerting
  # ==========================================================================
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:v3.1.0
    container_name: prometheus
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml'
      - '--storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus'
      - '--storage.tsdb.retention.time=30d'
      - '--web.enable-lifecycle'
      - '--web.enable-remote-write-receiver'
      - '--web.external-url=https://prometheus.homelab.rambtech.dev'
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./prometheus/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro
      - ./prometheus/alerts:/etc/prometheus/alerts:ro
      - prometheus_data:/prometheus
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 4096m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '1.0'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:9090/-/healthy || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Alertmanager - Alert routing and notifications
  # ==========================================================================
  alertmanager:
    image: prom/alertmanager:v0.28.1
    container_name: alertmanager
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml'
      - '--storage.path=/alertmanager'
      - '--web.external-url=https://alertmanager.homelab.rambtech.dev'
    ports:
      - "9093:9093"
    volumes:
      - ./alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:ro
      - ./alertmanager/templates:/etc/alertmanager/templates:ro
      - alertmanager_data:/alertmanager
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:9093/-/healthy || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Grafana - Visualization and dashboards
  # ==========================================================================
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:11.4.0
    container_name: grafana
    environment:
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER=admin
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-admin}
      - GF_USERS_ALLOW_SIGN_UP=false
      - GF_SERVER_ROOT_URL=https://grafana.homelab.rambtech.dev
      - GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_ENABLED=false
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    volumes:
      - ./grafana/provisioning:/etc/grafana/provisioning:ro
      - ./grafana/dashboards:/var/lib/grafana/dashboards:ro
      - grafana_data:/var/lib/grafana
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:3000/api/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Uptime Kuma - HTTP endpoint monitoring and status page
  # ==========================================================================
  uptime-kuma:
    image: louislam/uptime-kuma:1
    container_name: uptime-kuma
    ports:
      - "3001:3001"
    volumes:
      - uptime_kuma_data:/app/data
    dns:
      - 192.168.1.196  # AdGuard DNS for local domain resolution
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -sf http://localhost:3001/ > /dev/null || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s

  # ==========================================================================
  # AutoKuma - Declarative monitor management for Uptime Kuma
  # Monitors defined in ./autokuma/monitors.json
  # ==========================================================================
  autokuma:
    image: ghcr.io/bigboot/autokuma:1.0.0
    container_name: autokuma
    environment:
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__URL=http://uptime-kuma:3001
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__USERNAME=${UPTIME_KUMA_USERNAME:-admin}
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__PASSWORD=${UPTIME_KUMA_PASSWORD}
      - AUTOKUMA__STATIC_MONITORS=/monitors/monitors.json
      - AUTOKUMA__DOCKER__ENABLED=false
    volumes:
      - ./autokuma/monitors.json:/monitors/monitors.json:ro
    depends_on:
      - uptime-kuma
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    # Healthcheck removed: AutoKuma is distroless Rust binary with no health endpoint
    # Container health monitored via Docker restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy - Push notifications
  # ==========================================================================
  ntfy:
    image: binwiederhier/ntfy:v2.11.0
    container_name: ntfy
    command:
      - serve
      - --cache-file=/var/cache/ntfy/cache.db
      - --attachment-cache-dir=/var/cache/ntfy/attachments
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    volumes:
      - ./ntfy/server.yml:/etc/ntfy/server.yml:ro
      - ntfy_cache:/var/cache/ntfy
      - ntfy_data:/var/lib/ntfy
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:80/v1/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy-discord-forwarder - Forward ntfy notifications to Discord
  # ==========================================================================
  ntfy-discord-forwarder:
    image: python:3.12-alpine
    container_name: ntfy-discord-forwarder
    command:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      - |
        pip install --no-cache-dir requests &&
        python3 -u << 'ENDSCRIPT'
        import requests
        import json
        import os

        NTFY_URL = "http://ntfy:80/homelab-alerts/json"
        DISCORD_WEBHOOK = os.environ["DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL"]

        print(f"Starting ntfy->Discord forwarder. Listening to {NTFY_URL}")
        for line in requests.get(NTFY_URL, stream=True).iter_lines():
            if line:
                data = json.loads(line)
                msg = data.get("message", "")
                if msg:
                    print(f"Forwarding: {msg}")
                    requests.post(DISCORD_WEBHOOK, json={"content": msg})
        ENDSCRIPT
    environment:
      - DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL=${DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL}
    depends_on:
      - ntfy
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 128m
          cpus: '0.25'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pgrep -f python3 || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  loki_data:
  alloy_data:
  prometheus_data:
  alertmanager_data:
  grafana_data:
  uptime_kuma_data:
  ntfy_cache:
  ntfy_data:

---
# =============================================================================
# Configure Container Management Agents in LXC Container
# =============================================================================
# This playbook is generated by the lxc-sidecars OpenTofu module.
# It deploys all enabled agents in a single docker-compose file to avoid
# conflicts from separate compose projects removing each other's containers.
#
# Agents:
#   - Pulse Docker Agent: Container monitoring (pushes metrics to Pulse server)
#   - Arcane Agent: Remote container management (manager initiates pairing)
#   - Alloy Agent: Grafana Alloy for log collection to Loki
# =============================================================================

- name: Configure container agents for ${container_name}
  hosts: ${container_name}
  gather_facts: true

  vars:
    container_id: "${container_id}"
    container_name: "${container_name}"

    # Pulse agent config
    pulse_enabled: ${pulse_enabled}
    pulse_url: "${pulse_url}"
    pulse_token: "${pulse_token}"

    # Arcane agent config
    arcane_enabled: ${arcane_enabled}
    manager_url: "${manager_url}"
    bootstrap_token: "${bootstrap_token}"

    # Alloy agent config
    alloy_enabled: ${alloy_enabled}
    loki_url: "${loki_url}"
    prometheus_url: "${prometheus_url}"
    alloy_username: "${alloy_username}"
    alloy_password: "${alloy_password}"

    # Shared paths
    sidecars_dir: /config/sidecars
    compose_file: /config/sidecars/docker-compose.yml

  tasks:
    # =========================================================================
    # Create Sidecar Directory
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create sidecars directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ sidecars_dir }}"
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'

    # =========================================================================
    # Deploy Unified Docker Compose
    # =========================================================================
    # Single compose file with all enabled agents to prevent --remove-orphans
    # from removing the "other" agent when updating just one.

    - name: Deploy unified agents docker-compose
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          # =============================================================================
          # Container Management Agents - ${container_name}
          # =============================================================================
          # Generated by OpenTofu lxc-sidecars module
          # DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY - changes will be overwritten
          # =============================================================================

          services:
%{ if pulse_enabled ~}
            # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
            # Pulse Docker Agent - Container Monitoring
            # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
            # NOTE: pulse-docker-agent is deprecated. Pulse v5.0+ introduces a unified
            # agent (binary install). Until v5.0 is stable, continue using this image.
            pulse-agent:
              image: ghcr.io/rcourtman/pulse-docker-agent:latest
              container_name: pulse-agent
              pid: host
              uts: host
              environment:
                - PULSE_URL=${pulse_url}
                - PULSE_TOKEN=${pulse_token}
              volumes:
                - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
              deploy:
                resources:
                  limits:
                    memory: 128m
                    cpus: '0.25'
                  reservations:
                    memory: 64m
                    cpus: '0.1'
              restart: unless-stopped
              healthcheck:
                test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pgrep pulse-docker-agent || exit 1"]
                interval: 30s
                timeout: 10s
                retries: 3
                start_period: 30s

%{ endif ~}
%{ if arcane_enabled ~}
            # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
            # Arcane Agent - Remote Container Management
            # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
            arcane-agent:
              image: ghcr.io/getarcaneapp/arcane-headless:latest
              container_name: arcane-agent
              ports:
                - "3553:3553"
              environment:
                - AGENT_MODE=true
                - AGENT_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN=${bootstrap_token}

I see the issue. The playbook uses:

- name: Deploy agent containers
  ansible.builtin.command:
    cmd: docker compose -f {{ compose_file }} up -d --remove-orphans

The `docker compose up -d` command will only restart containers if the compose file itself changed (registered at line 174), but it does **not** restart containers when only the mounted config file (`alloy.river`) changes. 

The Alloy container mounts the config as a volume (`/config/sidecars/alloy.river:/etc/alloy/config.alloy:ro`), so even if the `alloy.river` file is updated, Docker doesn't know to restart the container.

We need to add a task that restarts Alloy when its config changes. Let me fix this:

                resources:
                  limits:
                    memory: 128m
                    cpus: '0.25'
                  reservations:
                    memory: 64m
                    cpus: '0.1'
              restart: unless-stopped
              healthcheck:
                test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pgrep pulse-docker-agent || exit 1"]
                interval: 30s
                timeout: 10s
                retries: 3
                start_period: 30s

%{ endif ~}
%{ if arcane_enabled ~}
            # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
            # Arcane Agent - Remote Container Management
            # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
            arcane-agent:
              image: ghcr.io/getarcaneapp/arcane-headless:latest
              container_name: arcane-agent
              ports:
                - "3553:3553"
              environment:
                - AGENT_MODE=true
                - AGENT_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN=${bootstrap_token}
              volumes:
                - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
                - arcane_agent_data:/app/data
              deploy:
                resources:
                  limits:
                    memory: 256m
                    cpus: '0.5'
                  reservations:
                    memory: 128m
                    cpus: '0.1'
              restart: unless-stopped
              healthcheck:
                test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -sf http://localhost:3553/api/health || exit 1"]
                interval: 30s
                timeout: 10s
                retries: 3
                start_period: 30s

%{ endif ~}
%{ if alloy_enabled ~}
            # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
            # Alloy Agent - Log Collection to Loki
            # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
            alloy:
              image: grafana/alloy:v1.5.1
              container_name: alloy
              command:
                - run
                - --server.http.listen-addr=0.0.0.0:12345
                - /etc/alloy/config.alloy
              volumes:
                - /config/sidecars/alloy.river:/etc/alloy/config.alloy:ro
                - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
                - /var/log:/var/log/host:ro
              deploy:
                resources:
                  limits:
                    memory: 128m
                    cpus: '0.25'
                  reservations:
                    memory: 64m
                    cpus: '0.1'
              restart: unless-stopped
              healthcheck:
                test: ["CMD", "wget", "-qO-", "http://localhost:12345/-/ready"]
                interval: 30s
                timeout: 10s
                retries: 3
                start_period: 30s

%{ endif ~}
%{ if arcane_enabled ~}
          volumes:
            arcane_agent_data:
%{ endif ~}
        dest: "{{ compose_file }}"
        mode: '0644'
      register: compose_file_result

    # =========================================================================
    # Deploy Alloy Configuration
    # =========================================================================
%{ if alloy_enabled ~}
    - name: Deploy Alloy River configuration
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          // =============================================================================
          // Grafana Alloy Configuration - ${container_name} (LXC ${container_id})
          // =============================================================================
          // Generated by OpenTofu lxc-sidecars module
          // DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY - changes will be overwritten
          // =============================================================================

          // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
          // Docker Log Discovery
          // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
          discovery.docker "containers" {
            host = "unix:///var/run/docker.sock"
          }

          discovery.relabel "docker_logs" {
            targets = discovery.docker.containers.targets

            // Keep container name as label
            rule {
              source_labels = ["__meta_docker_container_name"]
              regex         = "/(.*)"
              target_label  = "container"
            }

            // Add compose service name if available
            rule {
              source_labels = ["__meta_docker_container_label_com_docker_compose_service"]
              target_label  = "service"
            }

            // Add LXC identifier
            rule {
              target_label = "lxc"
              replacement  = "${container_name}"
            }

            rule {
              target_label = "lxc_id"
              replacement  = "${container_id}"
            }
          }

          loki.source.docker "containers" {
            host       = "unix:///var/run/docker.sock"
            targets    = discovery.relabel.docker_logs.output
            forward_to = [loki.write.default.receiver]
          }

          // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
          // Journal Logs (systemd)
          // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
          loki.source.journal "systemd" {
            forward_to = [loki.process.journal.receiver]
            labels = {
              job    = "journal",
              lxc    = "${container_name}",
              lxc_id = "${container_id}",
            }
          }

          loki.process "journal" {
            forward_to = [loki.write.default.receiver]

            stage.static_labels {
              values = {
                source = "journal",
              }
            }
          }

          // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
          // Loki Write Endpoint (with Basic Auth)
          // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
          loki.write "default" {
            endpoint {
              url = "${loki_url}/loki/api/v1/push"

              basic_auth {
                username = "${alloy_username}"
                password = "${alloy_password}"
              }
            }
          }

          // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
          // Prometheus Remote Write (with Basic Auth)
          // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
          // Collect host metrics and forward to Prometheus
          prometheus.exporter.unix "node" {
            disable_collectors = ["arp", "bonding", "btrfs", "infiniband", "ipvs", "mdadm", "nfs", "nfsd", "nvme", "rapl", "tapestats", "zfs"]
          }

          prometheus.scrape "node" {
            targets    = prometheus.exporter.unix.node.targets
            forward_to = [prometheus.relabel.add_labels.receiver]
            job_name   = "node"
          }

          prometheus.relabel "add_labels" {
            forward_to = [prometheus.remote_write.default.receiver]

            rule {
              target_label = "lxc"
              replacement  = "${container_name}"
            }

            rule {
              target_label = "lxc_id"
              replacement  = "${container_id}"
            }
          }

          prometheus.remote_write "default" {
            endpoint {
              url = "${prometheus_url}/api/v1/write"

              basic_auth {
                username = "${alloy_username}"
                password = "${alloy_password}"
              }
            }
          }
        dest: "{{ sidecars_dir }}/alloy.river"
        mode: '0644'
      register: alloy_config_result

    - name: Restart Alloy if config changed
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker restart alloy
      when: alloy_config_result.changed
      register: alloy_restart_result
      failed_when: false
%{ endif ~}

    # =========================================================================
    # Pull Latest Images
    # =========================================================================
%{ if pulse_enabled ~}
    - name: Pull Pulse agent image
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker pull ghcr.io/rcourtman/pulse-docker-agent:latest
      changed_when: true
%{ endif ~}

%{ if arcane_enabled ~}
    - name: Pull Arcane agent image
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker pull ghcr.io/getarcaneapp/arcane-headless:latest
      changed_when: true
%{ endif ~}

%{ if alloy_enabled ~}
    - name: Pull Alloy image
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker pull grafana/alloy:v1.5.1
      changed_when: true
%{ endif ~}

    # =========================================================================
    # Deploy Agent Containers
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Deploy agent containers
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker compose -f {{ compose_file }} up -d --remove-orphans
      register: deploy_result
      changed_when: "'Started' in deploy_result.stderr or 'Creating' in deploy_result.stderr"

    # =========================================================================
    # Verify Deployment
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Wait for agents to start
      ansible.builtin.pause:
        seconds: 10

%{ if pulse_enabled ~}
    - name: Check Pulse agent status
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker ps --filter name=pulse-agent --format "{{ '{{' }}.Status{{ '}}' }}"
      register: pulse_status
      changed_when: false
%{ endif ~}

%{ if arcane_enabled ~}
    - name: Check Arcane agent status
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker ps --filter name=arcane-agent --format "{{ '{{' }}.Status{{ '}}' }}"
      register: arcane_status
      changed_when: false
%{ endif ~}

%{ if alloy_enabled ~}
    - name: Check Alloy agent status
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker ps --filter name=alloy --format "{{ '{{' }}.Status{{ '}}' }}"
      register: alloy_status
      changed_when: false
%{ endif ~}

    - name: Display deployment summary
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "=== Container Agents Deployed for ${container_name} ==="
          - ""
          - "Container ID: ${container_id}"
%{ if pulse_enabled ~}
          - "Pulse Agent: {{ pulse_status.stdout | default('not running') }}"
          - "  → Pulse URL: ${pulse_url}"
%{ endif ~}
%{ if arcane_enabled ~}
          - "Arcane Agent: {{ arcane_status.stdout | default('not running') }}"
          - "  → Agent Port: 3553"
          - "  → Pair in Arcane UI: http://{{ ansible_host }}:3553"
%{ endif ~}
%{ if alloy_enabled ~}
          - "Alloy Agent: {{ alloy_status.stdout | default('not running') }}"
          - "  → Loki URL: ${loki_url}"
          - "  → Alloy UI: http://{{ ansible_host }}:12345"
%{ endif ~}
          - ""
          - "Compose file: {{ compose_file }}"
          - ""
          - "Commands:"
          - "  View logs:  docker compose -f {{ compose_file }} logs -f"
          - "  Restart:    docker compose -f {{ compose_file }} restart"
          - "  Status:     docker compose -f {{ compose_file }} ps"

@startuml homelab-network-architecture
!theme plain
title Homelab Network & Service Architecture

' ============================================================================
' Style Configuration
' ============================================================================
skinparam {
    BackgroundColor white
    ComponentStyle rectangle
    PackageStyle frame
    DefaultFontName Monospace
    DefaultFontSize 11
    NoteFontSize 10
    ArrowColor #666666
    ComponentBorderColor #333333
    PackageBorderColor #555555
    DatabaseBorderColor #555555
    CloudBorderColor #555555
}

' Colors by category
!$CORE_COLOR = "#E8F5E9"
!$DASHBOARD_COLOR = "#E3F2FD"
!$PHOTOS_COLOR = "#FFF3E0"
!$MEDIA_COLOR = "#FCE4EC"
!$MONITORING_COLOR = "#F3E5F5"
!$INFRA_COLOR = "#ECEFF1"

' ============================================================================
' External Networks
' ============================================================================
cloud "Internet" as internet {
    [Cloudflare Tunnel] as cf_tunnel
    note right of cf_tunnel : Public domains\n*.rambtech.dev
}

' ============================================================================
' Home LAN (192.168.1.0/24 - vmbr0)
' ============================================================================
package "Home LAN\n192.168.1.0/24 (vmbr0)" as lan #FFFDE7 {
    node "FIOS Router\n192.168.1.1" as router

    rectangle "LAN Clients" as lan_clients {
        [Desktop/Laptop]
        [Mobile Devices]
        [Smart TVs]
    }
}

' ============================================================================
' Proxmox Host
' ============================================================================
node "Proxmox VE (homelab)\n192.168.1.215 (vmbr0)\n10.100.0.1 (vmbr1)" as proxmox #ECEFF1 {

    ' ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    ' Container Network (10.100.0.0/16 - vmbr1)
    ' ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    package "Container Network\n10.100.0.0/16 (vmbr1)" as container_net {

        ' ====================================================================
        ' Core Services (100-149) -> 10.100.1.x
        ' ====================================================================
        package "Core Services (10.100.1.x)" as core $CORE_COLOR {

            component "LXC 101: Network Services\n10.100.1.101\nLAN: 192.168.1.196" as network_svc {
                [AdGuard Home :80/:53]
                [Tailscale Exit Node]
            }

            component "LXC 102: PBS\n10.100.1.102" as pbs {
                [Proxmox Backup :8007]
            }
        }

        ' ====================================================================
        ' Dashboards & Auth (200-249) -> 10.100.2.x
        ' ====================================================================
        package "Dashboards & Auth (10.100.2.x)" as dashboards $DASHBOARD_COLOR {
            component "LXC 200: Traefik\n10.100.2.200\nLAN: 192.168.1.235" as traefik {
                [Traefik :443 (websecure)]
                [Traefik :80 (web/tunnel)]
                [Dashboard :8080]
            }

            component "LXC 201: Dashboards\n10.100.2.201" as dashboard_apps {
                [Homepage :3000]
                [Dashy :4001]
                [Glances :61208]
            }

            component "LXC 202: Authelia\n10.100.2.202" as authelia {
                [Authelia :9091]
                [Redis :6379]
            }
        }

        ' ====================================================================
        ' Photos (300-349) -> 10.100.3.x
        ' ====================================================================
        package "Photos (10.100.3.x)" as photos $PHOTOS_COLOR {
            component "LXC 303: Immich Importer\n10.100.3.103" as importer {
                [Photo Import Scripts]
            }

            component "LXC 304: Immich\n10.100.3.104\nLAN: 192.168.1.222" as immich {
                [Immich Server :2283]
                [Machine Learning :3003]
                [PostgreSQL :5432]
                [Redis :6379]
            }
        }

        ' ====================================================================
        ' Media - Streaming (400-449) -> 10.100.4.x
        ' ====================================================================
        package "Media Streaming (10.100.4.x)" as media $MEDIA_COLOR {
            component "LXC 401: Jellyfin\n10.100.4.101\nLAN: 192.168.1.226" as jellyfin {
                [Jellyfin :8096]
                [Jellystat :3000]
                [Jellyseerr :5055]
            }

            component "LXC 402: Media Management\n10.100.4.102" as arr_stack {
                [Sonarr :8989]
                [Radarr :7878]
                [Lidarr :8686]
                [Prowlarr :9696]
                [Bazarr :6767]
                [qBittorrent :8080]
                [SABnzbd :8085]
            }
        }

        ' ====================================================================
        ' Monitoring & AI (500-549) -> 10.100.5.x
        ' ====================================================================
        package "Monitoring & AI (10.100.5.x)" as monitoring $MONITORING_COLOR {
            component "LXC 500: Monitoring\n10.100.5.100" as mon_stack {
                [Prometheus :9090]
                [Grafana :3000]
                [Alertmanager :9093]
                [Uptime Kuma :3001]
                [ntfy :8080]
                [Loki :3100]
                [Alloy :4317/:4318/:12345]
            }

            component "LXC 501: OpenWebUI\n10.100.5.101" as openwebui {
                [OpenWebUI :3000]
                [Ollama :11434]
            }

            component "LXC 502: n8n\n10.100.5.102" as n8n {
                [n8n :5678]
            }
        }
    }

    ' ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    ' Storage
    ' ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    database "ZFS Storage" as storage {
        [tank/data/library]
        [tank/backups]
        [nvme-containers]
    }
}

' ============================================================================
' Traffic Flow Connections
' ============================================================================

' Internet -> Cloudflare -> Traefik
internet --> cf_tunnel
cf_tunnel --> traefik : "Public traffic\n(web entrypoint :80)"

' LAN -> Router -> Traefik (via LAN IP)
router --> traefik : "LAN traffic\n192.168.1.235:443"
lan_clients --> router

' DNS Resolution
lan_clients ..> network_svc : "DNS queries\n192.168.1.196:53"

' Traefik reverse proxy to services
traefik --> dashboard_apps : "homepage/dashy"
traefik --> authelia : "auth forwarding"
traefik --> jellyfin : "jellyfin/requests"
traefik --> immich : "photos"
traefik --> mon_stack : "grafana/prometheus"
traefik --> openwebui : "ai"
traefik --> n8n : "n8n"
traefik --> arr_stack : "sonarr/radarr/etc"
traefik --> pbs : "pbs"

' Authelia protects services
authelia ..> dashboard_apps : "ForwardAuth"
authelia ..> mon_stack : "ForwardAuth"

' Media flow
arr_stack --> jellyfin : "Media files"
jellyfin --> storage : "/data/library"
immich --> storage : "Photo storage"
pbs --> storage : "Backups"

' Monitoring
mon_stack ..> proxmox : "OTLP metrics"

' DLNA/Casting (via LAN IP)
lan_clients ..> jellyfin : "DLNA\n192.168.1.226"
lan_clients ..> immich : "Mobile sync\n192.168.1.222"

' ============================================================================
' Legend
' ============================================================================
legend bottom right
|= Network |= Range |= Purpose |
| vmbr0 | 192.168.1.0/24 | Home LAN |
| vmbr1 | 10.100.0.0/16 | Container network |
|= IP Scheme |= LXC Range |= Category |
| 10.100.1.x | 100-149 | Core services |
| 10.100.2.x | 200-249 | Dashboards & Auth |
| 10.100.3.x | 300-349 | Photos |
| 10.100.4.x | 400-449 | Media Streaming |
| 10.100.5.x | 500-549 | Monitoring & AI |
endlegend

@enduml

Good! I can see the architecture diagram. The key issue I found is on **line 207**:

```
mon_stack ..> proxmox : "OTLP metrics"
```

This shows monitoring collecting OTLP metrics from Proxmox, but it doesn't show the **new architecture** with:
- Alloy sidecars on each LXC collecting logs/metrics
- Traefik auth endpoints for telemetry
- Flow from sidecars → Traefik → Loki/Prometheus

Let me check the service map next:

@startuml homelab-network-architecture
!theme plain
title Homelab Network & Service Architecture

' ============================================================================
' Style Configuration
' ============================================================================
skinparam {
    BackgroundColor white
    ComponentStyle rectangle
    PackageStyle frame
    DefaultFontName Monospace
    DefaultFontSize 11
    NoteFontSize 10
    ArrowColor #666666
    ComponentBorderColor #333333
    PackageBorderColor #555555
    DatabaseBorderColor #555555
    CloudBorderColor #555555
}

' Colors by category
!$CORE_COLOR = "#E8F5E9"
!$DASHBOARD_COLOR = "#E3F2FD"
!$PHOTOS_COLOR = "#FFF3E0"
!$MEDIA_COLOR = "#FCE4EC"
!$MONITORING_COLOR = "#F3E5F5"
!$INFRA_COLOR = "#ECEFF1"

' ============================================================================
' External Networks
' ============================================================================
cloud "Internet" as internet {
    [Cloudflare Tunnel] as cf_tunnel
    note right of cf_tunnel : Public domains\n*.rambtech.dev
}

' ============================================================================
' Home LAN (192.168.1.0/24 - vmbr0)
' ============================================================================
package "Home LAN\n192.168.1.0/24 (vmbr0)" as lan #FFFDE7 {
    node "FIOS Router\n192.168.1.1" as router

    rectangle "LAN Clients" as lan_clients {
        [Desktop/Laptop]
        [Mobile Devices]
        [Smart TVs]
    }
}

' ============================================================================
' Proxmox Host
' ============================================================================
node "Proxmox VE (homelab)\n192.168.1.215 (vmbr0)\n10.100.0.1 (vmbr1)" as proxmox #ECEFF1 {

    ' ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    ' Container Network (10.100.0.0/16 - vmbr1)
    ' ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    package "Container Network\n10.100.0.0/16 (vmbr1)" as container_net {

        ' ====================================================================
        ' Core Services (100-149) -> 10.100.1.x
        ' ====================================================================
        package "Core Services (10.100.1.x)" as core $CORE_COLOR {

            component "LXC 101: Network Services\n10.100.1.101\nLAN: 192.168.1.196" as network_svc {
                [AdGuard Home :80/:53]
                [Tailscale Exit Node]
            }

            component "LXC 102: PBS\n10.100.1.102" as pbs {
                [Proxmox Backup :8007]
            }
        }

        ' ====================================================================
        ' Dashboards & Auth (200-249) -> 10.100.2.x
        ' ====================================================================
        package "Dashboards & Auth (10.100.2.x)" as dashboards $DASHBOARD_COLOR {
            component "LXC 200: Traefik\n10.100.2.200\nLAN: 192.168.1.235" as traefik {
                [Traefik :443 (websecure)]
                [Traefik :80 (web/tunnel)]
                [Dashboard :8080]
            }

            component "LXC 201: Dashboards\n10.100.2.201" as dashboard_apps {
                [Homepage :3000]
                [Dashy :4001]
                [Glances :61208]
            }

            component "LXC 202: Authelia\n10.100.2.202" as authelia {
                [Authelia :9091]
                [Redis :6379]
            }
        }

        ' ====================================================================
        ' Photos (300-349) -> 10.100.3.x
        ' ====================================================================
        package "Photos (10.100.3.x)" as photos $PHOTOS_COLOR {
            component "LXC 303: Immich Importer\n10.100.3.103" as importer {
                [Photo Import Scripts]
            }

            component "LXC 304: Immich\n10.100.3.104\nLAN: 192.168.1.222" as immich {
                [Immich Server :2283]
                [Machine Learning :3003]
                [PostgreSQL :5432]
                [Redis :6379]
            }
        }

        ' ====================================================================
        ' Media - Streaming (400-449) -> 10.100.4.x
        ' ====================================================================
        package "Media Streaming (10.100.4.x)" as media $MEDIA_COLOR {
            component "LXC 401: Jellyfin\n10.100.4.101\nLAN: 192.168.1.226" as jellyfin {
                [Jellyfin :8096]
                [Jellystat :3000]
                [Jellyseerr :5055]
            }

            component "LXC 402: Media Management\n10.100.4.102" as arr_stack {
                [Sonarr :8989]
                [Radarr :7878]
                [Lidarr :8686]
                [Prowlarr :9696]
                [Bazarr :6767]
                [qBittorrent :8080]
                [SABnzbd :8085]
            }
        }

        ' ====================================================================
        ' Monitoring & AI (500-549) -> 10.100.5.x
        ' ====================================================================
        package "Monitoring & AI (10.100.5.x)" as monitoring $MONITORING_COLOR {
            component "LXC 500: Monitoring\n10.100.5.100" as mon_stack {
                [Prometheus :9090]
                [Grafana :3000]
                [Alertmanager :9093]
                [Uptime Kuma :3001]
                [ntfy :8080]
                [Loki :3100]
                [Alloy :4317/:4318/:12345]
            }

            component "LXC 501: OpenWebUI\n10.100.5.101" as openwebui {
                [OpenWebUI :3000]
                [Ollama :11434]
            }

            component "LXC 502: n8n\n10.100.5.102" as n8n {
                [n8n :5678]
            }
        }
    }

    ' ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    ' Storage
    ' ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    database "ZFS Storage" as storage {
        [tank/data/library]
        [tank/backups]
        [nvme-containers]
    }
}

' ============================================================================
' Traffic Flow Connections
' ============================================================================

' Internet -> Cloudflare -> Traefik
internet --> cf_tunnel
cf_tunnel --> traefik : "Public traffic\n(web entrypoint :80)"

' LAN -> Router -> Traefik (via LAN IP)
router --> traefik : "LAN traffic\n192.168.1.235:443"
lan_clients --> router

' DNS Resolution
lan_clients ..> network_svc : "DNS queries\n192.168.1.196:53"

' Traefik reverse proxy to services
traefik --> dashboard_apps : "homepage/dashy"
traefik --> authelia : "auth forwarding"
traefik --> jellyfin : "jellyfin/requests"
traefik --> immich : "photos"
traefik --> mon_stack : "grafana/prometheus"
traefik --> openwebui : "ai"
traefik --> n8n : "n8n"
traefik --> arr_stack : "sonarr/radarr/etc"
traefik --> pbs : "pbs"

' Authelia protects services
authelia ..> dashboard_apps : "ForwardAuth"
authelia ..> mon_stack : "ForwardAuth"

' Media flow
arr_stack --> jellyfin : "Media files"
jellyfin --> storage : "/data/library"
immich --> storage : "Photo storage"
pbs --> storage : "Backups"

' Monitoring
mon_stack ..> proxmox : "OTLP metrics"

' DLNA/Casting (via LAN IP)
lan_clients ..> jellyfin : "DLNA\n192.168.1.226"
lan_clients ..> immich : "Mobile sync\n192.168.1.222"

' ============================================================================
' Legend
' ============================================================================
legend bottom right
|= Network |= Range |= Purpose |
| vmbr0 | 192.168.1.0/24 | Home LAN |
| vmbr1 | 10.100.0.0/16 | Container network |
|= IP Scheme |= LXC Range |= Category |
| 10.100.1.x | 100-149 | Core services |
| 10.100.2.x | 200-249 | Dashboards & Auth |
| 10.100.3.x | 300-349 | Photos |
| 10.100.4.x | 400-449 | Media Streaming |
| 10.100.5.x | 500-549 | Monitoring & AI |
endlegend

@enduml

@startuml homelab-telemetry-architecture
!theme plain
title Homelab Telemetry & Observability Architecture

skinparam {
    BackgroundColor white
    ComponentStyle rectangle
    PackageStyle frame
    DefaultFontName Monospace
    DefaultFontSize 10
    NoteFontSize 9
    ArrowColor #666666
    ComponentBorderColor #333333
    PackageBorderColor #555555
}

' ============================================================================
' LXC Containers with Alloy Sidecars
' ============================================================================
package "LXC Containers (10.100.x.x)" as lxc_containers #E8F5E9 {

    package "Each LXC has Alloy Sidecar" as sidecar_pattern #C8E6C9 {
        rectangle "Application Containers" as app {
            [App Service 1]
            [App Service 2]
            [App Service N]
        }

        rectangle "Alloy Sidecar\n(Docker container)" as alloy_sidecar #FFECB3 {
            component "Log Collection" as log_col {
                [Docker logs\n(loki.source.docker)]
                [Journal logs\n(loki.source.journal)]
            }

            component "Metrics Collection" as metric_col {
                [Node exporter\n(prometheus.exporter.unix)]
                [CPU, Memory, Disk, Network]
            }

            component "Exporters" as exporters {
                [loki.write "default"]
                [prometheus.remote_write "default"]
            }
        }
    }

    note right of sidecar_pattern
        **11 LXC containers with Alloy sidecars:**
        - n8n (501)
        - openwebui (501)
        - dashboards (201)
        - authelia (202)
        - traefik (200)
        - network-services (101)
        - immich (304)
        - jellyfin (401)
        - media-management (402)
        - container-mgmt (TBD)
        - documents (TBD)
    end note
}

' ============================================================================
' Traefik Reverse Proxy with Auth Middleware
' ============================================================================
package "LXC 200: Traefik\n10.100.2.200 | 192.168.1.235" as traefik_lxc #E3F2FD {
    component "Traefik Routes" as traefik {
        rectangle "loki-push.homelab.rambtech.dev" as loki_route {
            [Router: loki-push]
            [Middleware: internal-only]
            [Middleware: basicauth-alloy]
            [Backend: 10.100.5.100:3100]
        }

        rectangle "prometheus-push.homelab.rambtech.dev" as prom_route {
            [Router: prometheus-push]
            [Middleware: internal-only]
            [Middleware: basicauth-alloy]
            [Backend: 10.100.5.100:9090]
        }
    }

    note bottom of traefik
        **Basic Auth:**
        - Username: alloy
        - Password: stored in 1Password
        - htpasswd hash in Traefik config

        **IP Allow List (internal-only):**
        - 192.168.1.0/24 (LAN)
        - 10.100.0.0/16 (Container network)
        - 172.16.0.0/12 (Docker bridge networks)
        - 100.64.0.0/10 (Tailscale CGNAT)
        - 127.0.0.1/32 (Localhost)
    end note
}

' ============================================================================
' Monitoring Stack (Loki + Prometheus + Grafana)
' ============================================================================
package "LXC 500: Monitoring\n10.100.5.100" as monitoring_lxc #F3E5F5 {
    component "Loki :3100" as loki {
        [Log aggregation]
        [30-day retention]
        [TSDB storage]
    }

    component "Prometheus :9090" as prometheus {
        [Metrics storage]
        [30-day retention]
        [Remote write receiver]
        [PromQL queries]
    }

    component "Grafana :3000" as grafana {
        [Dashboards]
        [Datasource: Loki]
        [Datasource: Prometheus]
    }

    component "Alloy (Monitoring LXC)\n:4317/:4318/:12345" as alloy_mon #FFECB3 {
        [OTLP receiver\n(Proxmox/Immich)]
        [Docker log collection]
        [Journal log collection]
    }

    component "Alertmanager :9093" as alertmanager {
        [Alert routing]
        [ntfy notifications]
    }
}

' ============================================================================
' Data Flow
' ============================================================================

' Alloy sidecars collect logs and metrics
app --> alloy_sidecar : "Docker logs,\nJournal logs,\nNode metrics"

' Alloy sidecars push to Traefik auth endpoints
alloy_sidecar --> loki_route : "HTTPS POST\n/loki/api/v1/push\n(Basic Auth)"
alloy_sidecar --> prom_route : "HTTPS POST\n/api/v1/write\n(Basic Auth)"

' Traefik routes to Loki/Prometheus
loki_route --> loki : "Authenticated\nlog push"
prom_route --> prometheus : "Authenticated\nremote_write"

' Monitoring LXC's own Alloy
alloy_mon --> loki : "Local logs"
alloy_mon --> prometheus : "Local metrics"

' Grafana queries
grafana --> loki : "LogQL queries"
grafana --> prometheus : "PromQL queries"

' Alerting
prometheus --> alertmanager : "Alert rules"

' ============================================================================
' External Telemetry Sources
' ============================================================================
cloud "External Sources" as external {
    [Proxmox VE\nOTLP :4317]
    [Immich\nOTLP :4318]
}

external --> alloy_mon : "OTLP gRPC/HTTP\n(backwards compat)"

' ============================================================================
' Legend
' ============================================================================
legend bottom right
|= Component |= Purpose |
| Alloy Sidecar | Log/metric collection per LXC |
| Traefik Auth | Basic Auth + IP allowlist |
| Loki | Centralized log aggregation |
| Prometheus | Centralized metric storage |
| Grafana | Visualization dashboards |

|= Metrics Collected |
| CPU, Memory, Disk, Network (node exporter) |
| Docker container logs |
| Systemd journal logs |

|= Authentication |
| Basic Auth (alloy:password) |
| Credentials in 1Password |
| htpasswd format for Traefik |
endlegend

@enduml

## 1. Primary Request and Intent

The user requested adding authentication to Loki and Prometheus for Alloy agent connections, following the same pattern as existing sidecars (Pulse, Arcane) which use token auth. Key requirements:

- Store credentials in 1Password
- Collect both logs AND metrics from Alloy sidecars
- Use authenticated endpoints for all telemetry push operations

After completing the auth implementation, the user then requested updating architecture documentation to reflect the new Alloy/Loki setup (bead `proxmox-homelab-dn9`).

## 2. Key Technical Concepts

- **Grafana Alloy**: Unified telemetry collector replacing OTEL Collector
- **Loki**: Log aggregation system (port 3100)
- **Prometheus remote_write**: Metrics push protocol with auth
- **Traefik Basic Auth middleware**: HTTP Basic Authentication using htpasswd format
- **Traefik internal-only middleware**: IP allowlist for network access control
- **Docker bridge networks**: 172.16.0.0/12 range for container networking
- **LXC container networks**: 10.100.0.0/16 range
- **Ansible playbook templating**: Using Terraform templatefile for dynamic playbooks
- **1Password CLI integration**: Retrieving secrets via OpenTofu provider
- **PlantUML**: Architecture diagram source format
- **prometheus.exporter.unix**: Node exporter for system metrics (CPU, memory, disk, network)
- **loki.source.docker**: Docker container log collection
