@startuml homelab-service-map
!theme plain
title Homelab Service Map

skinparam {
    BackgroundColor white
    DefaultFontName Monospace
    DefaultFontSize 10
    NoteFontSize 9
    RectangleBorderColor #666666
    ComponentBorderColor #666666
}

' ============================================================================
' Access Domains
' ============================================================================
rectangle "Public Access (*.rambtech.dev)" as public #FFE0B2 {
    rectangle "dashy.rambtech.dev" as pub_dashy
    rectangle "jellyfin.rambtech.dev" as pub_jellyfin
    rectangle "photos.rambtech.dev" as pub_photos
    rectangle "requests.rambtech.dev" as pub_requests
}

rectangle "Internal Access (*.homelab.rambtech.dev)" as internal #C8E6C9 {
    rectangle "**Dashboards**" as dash_grp {
        rectangle "homepage" as int_homepage
        rectangle "dashy" as int_dashy
    }
    rectangle "**Authentication**" as auth_grp {
        rectangle "auth (Authelia)" as int_auth
    }
    rectangle "**Media**" as media_grp {
        rectangle "jellyfin" as int_jellyfin
        rectangle "jellystat" as int_jellystat
        rectangle "requests (Jellyseerr)" as int_requests
        rectangle "sonarr / radarr / lidarr" as int_arr
        rectangle "prowlarr / bazarr" as int_arr2
        rectangle "qbittorrent / sabnzbd" as int_dl
    }
    rectangle "**Photos**" as photos_grp {
        rectangle "photos (Immich)" as int_photos
    }
    rectangle "**Monitoring**" as mon_grp {
        rectangle "grafana" as int_grafana
        rectangle "prometheus" as int_prometheus
        rectangle "alertmanager" as int_alertmanager
        rectangle "status (Uptime Kuma)" as int_status
        rectangle "ntfy" as int_ntfy
    }
    rectangle "**AI & Automation**" as ai_grp {
        rectangle "ai (OpenWebUI)" as int_ai
        rectangle "n8n" as int_n8n
    }
    rectangle "**Infrastructure**" as infra_grp {
        rectangle "traefik" as int_traefik
        rectangle "pbs" as int_pbs
        rectangle "pve" as int_pve
        rectangle "dns (AdGuard)" as int_dns
    }
}

' ============================================================================
' Containers & IPs
' ============================================================================
rectangle "LXC Containers" as containers #E3F2FD {
    rectangle "**LXC 101: Network Services**\n10.100.1.101 | LAN: 192.168.1.196\nAdGuard + Tailscale" as lxc101
    rectangle "**LXC 102: PBS**\n10.100.1.102" as lxc102
    rectangle "**LXC 200: Traefik**\n10.100.2.200 | LAN: 192.168.1.235" as lxc200
    rectangle "**LXC 201: Dashboards**\n10.100.2.201\nHomepage + Dashy + Glances" as lxc201
    rectangle "**LXC 202: Authelia**\n10.100.2.202" as lxc202
    rectangle "**LXC 304: Immich**\n10.100.3.104 | LAN: 192.168.1.222" as lxc304
    rectangle "**LXC 401: Jellyfin**\n10.100.4.101 | LAN: 192.168.1.226\nJellyfin + Jellystat + Jellyseerr" as lxc401
    rectangle "**LXC 402: Media Management**\n10.100.4.102\nArr Stack + Downloaders" as lxc402
    rectangle "**LXC 500: Monitoring**\n10.100.5.100\nPrometheus + Grafana + Loki + Alloy" as lxc500
    rectangle "**LXC 501: OpenWebUI**\n10.100.5.101\nOpenWebUI + Ollama (GPU)" as lxc501
    rectangle "**LXC 502: n8n**\n10.100.5.102" as lxc502
}

' ============================================================================
' Relationships
' ============================================================================

' Public -> Internal domains
pub_dashy --> int_dashy
pub_jellyfin --> int_jellyfin
pub_photos --> int_photos
pub_requests --> int_requests

' Internal -> LXC
int_dns --> lxc101
int_pbs --> lxc102
int_traefik --> lxc200
int_homepage --> lxc201
int_dashy --> lxc201
int_auth --> lxc202
int_photos --> lxc304
int_jellyfin --> lxc401
int_jellystat --> lxc401
int_requests --> lxc401
int_arr --> lxc402
int_arr2 --> lxc402
int_dl --> lxc402
int_grafana --> lxc500
int_prometheus --> lxc500
int_alertmanager --> lxc500
int_status --> lxc500
int_ntfy --> lxc500
int_ai --> lxc501
int_n8n --> lxc502

' ============================================================================
' Notes
' ============================================================================
note bottom of containers
**Dual-NIC Services** (have both container + LAN IPs):
- Traefik: LAN clients access all services
- AdGuard: DNS for LAN devices
- Jellyfin: DLNA/Chromecast
- Immich: Mobile app sync
end note

@enduml

# Homelab Alert Rules
# Only includes alerts for metrics we actually collect

groups:
  - name: services
    interval: 1m
    rules:
      # Prometheus target down
      - alert: TargetDown
        expr: up == 0
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: critical
        annotations:
          summary: "Target {{ $labels.instance }} is down"
          description: "Prometheus cannot reach {{ $labels.job }} target {{ $labels.instance }}"

      # Traefik high error rate
      - alert: TraefikHighErrorRate
        expr: sum(rate(traefik_entrypoint_requests_total{code=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(traefik_entrypoint_requests_total[5m])) > 0.05
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: "High error rate on Traefik"
          description: "More than 5% of requests are returning 5xx errors"

      # Traefik backend down
      - alert: TraefikBackendDown
        expr: traefik_service_server_up == 0
        for: 2m
        labels:
          severity: critical
        annotations:
          summary: "Traefik backend {{ $labels.service }} is down"
          description: "Backend service {{ $labels.service }} is not responding"

  - name: proxmox
    interval: 1m
    rules:
      # Proxmox host high CPU
      - alert: ProxmoxHighCPU
        expr: proxmox_node_cpustat_cpu_percent > 80
        for: 10m
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: "High CPU on Proxmox node"
          description: "Proxmox node CPU usage above 80% for 10 minutes (current: {{ $value | printf \"%.1f\" }}%)"

      # Proxmox host memory high
      - alert: ProxmoxHighMemory
        expr: (proxmox_node_memory_memused_bytes / proxmox_node_memory_memtotal_bytes) * 100 > 85
        for: 10m
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: "High memory on Proxmox node"
          description: "Proxmox node memory usage above 85% for 10 minutes"

      # Proxmox storage low
      - alert: ProxmoxStorageLow
        expr: (proxmox_storage_used_bytes / proxmox_storage_total_bytes) * 100 > 85
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: "Low storage on {{ $labels.storage }}"
          description: "Proxmox storage {{ $labels.storage }} is above 85% used"

      # Proxmox storage critical
      - alert: ProxmoxStorageCritical
        expr: (proxmox_storage_used_bytes / proxmox_storage_total_bytes) * 100 > 95
        for: 2m
        labels:
          severity: critical
        annotations:
          summary: "Critical storage on {{ $labels.storage }}"
          description: "Proxmox storage {{ $labels.storage }} is above 95% used"

      # LXC/VM down (no metrics for 5 minutes)
      - alert: ProxmoxVMDown
        expr: changes(proxmox_vm_uptime_seconds[5m]) == 0 and proxmox_vm_uptime_seconds > 0
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: "VM/LXC {{ $labels.name }} may be unresponsive"
          description: "No uptime changes detected for VM/LXC {{ $labels.vmid }} ({{ $labels.name }})"

  - name: monitoring
    interval: 1m
    rules:
      # Prometheus TSDB high cardinality
      - alert: PrometheusTSDBHighCardinality
        expr: prometheus_tsdb_head_series > 100000
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: "Prometheus high time series count"
          description: "Prometheus has more than 100k active time series (current: {{ $value }})"

# Alertmanager Configuration
# Routes alerts to ntfy for centralized notification aggregation

global:
  resolve_timeout: 5m

# Route tree
route:
  group_by: ['alertname', 'severity']
  group_wait: 30s
  group_interval: 5m
  repeat_interval: 4h
  receiver: 'ntfy'

  routes:
    # Critical alerts - immediate notification with high priority
    - match:
        severity: critical
      receiver: 'ntfy-critical'
      group_wait: 10s
      repeat_interval: 1h

    # Warning alerts - batched notifications with default priority
    - match:
        severity: warning
      receiver: 'ntfy'
      group_wait: 1m
      repeat_interval: 4h

# Inhibition rules
inhibit_rules:
  # Inhibit warning if critical is firing for same alertname
  - source_match:
      severity: 'critical'
    target_match:
      severity: 'warning'
    equal: ['alertname', 'instance']

# Receivers
receivers:
  # ntfy receiver for warnings
  - name: 'ntfy'
    webhook_configs:
      # ntfy - centralized notification aggregator
      # Uses built-in alertmanager template for formatted messages
      - url: 'http://ntfy:80/homelab-alerts?template=alertmanager&priority=default&tags=warning,homelab'
        send_resolved: true
        max_alerts: 10

  # ntfy receiver for critical alerts
  - name: 'ntfy-critical'
    webhook_configs:
      # ntfy with urgent priority and alertmanager template
      - url: 'http://ntfy:80/homelab-alerts?template=alertmanager&priority=urgent&tags=rotating_light,critical'
        send_resolved: true
        max_alerts: 10

# Templates for message formatting
templates:
  - '/etc/alertmanager/templates/*.tmpl'

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Loki - Log aggregation
  # ==========================================================================
  loki:
    image: grafana/loki:3.3.2
    container_name: loki
    command: -config.file=/etc/loki/local-config.yaml
    ports:
      - "3100:3100"
    volumes:
      - ./loki/config.yaml:/etc/loki/local-config.yaml:ro
      - loki_data:/loki
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:3100/ready || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Grafana Alloy - Unified telemetry collector (replaces OTEL Collector)
  # ==========================================================================
  alloy:
    image: grafana/alloy:v1.5.1
    container_name: alloy
    command:
      - run
      - --server.http.listen-addr=0.0.0.0:12345
      - --storage.path=/var/lib/alloy/data
      - /etc/alloy/config.alloy
    ports:
      - "4317:4317"   # OTLP gRPC receiver (backwards compat)
      - "4318:4318"   # OTLP HTTP receiver (backwards compat)
      - "12345:12345" # Alloy UI
    volumes:
      - ./alloy/config.alloy:/etc/alloy/config.alloy:ro
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
      - /var/log:/var/log/host:ro
      - alloy_data:/var/lib/alloy/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
      - loki
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "-qO-", "http://localhost:12345/-/ready"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Prometheus - Metrics storage and alerting
  # ==========================================================================
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:v3.1.0
    container_name: prometheus
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml'
      - '--storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus'
      - '--storage.tsdb.retention.time=30d'
      - '--web.enable-lifecycle'
      - '--web.enable-remote-write-receiver'
      - '--web.external-url=https://prometheus.homelab.rambtech.dev'
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./prometheus/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro
      - ./prometheus/alerts:/etc/prometheus/alerts:ro
      - prometheus_data:/prometheus
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 4096m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '1.0'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:9090/-/healthy || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s

ntfy:
    image: binwiederhier/ntfy:v2.11.0
    container_name: ntfy
    command:
      - serve
      - --cache-file=/var/cache/ntfy/cache.db
      - --attachment-cache-dir=/var/cache/ntfy/attachments
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    volumes:
      - ./ntfy/server.yml:/etc/ntfy/server.yml:ro
      - ntfy_cache:/var/cache/ntfy
      - ntfy_data:/var/lib/ntfy
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:80/v1/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

        NTFY_URL = "http://ntfy:80/homelab-alerts/json"

            if line:
                data = json.loads(line)
                msg = data.get("message", "")

          cpus: '1.0'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:9090/-/healthy || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Alertmanager - Alert routing and notifications
  # ==========================================================================
  alertmanager:
    image: prom/alertmanager:v0.28.1
    container_name: alertmanager
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml'
      - '--storage.path=/alertmanager'
      - '--web.external-url=https://alertmanager.homelab.rambtech.dev'
    ports:
      - "9093:9093"
    volumes:
      - ./alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:ro
      - ./alertmanager/templates:/etc/alertmanager/templates:ro
      - alertmanager_data:/alertmanager
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:9093/-/healthy || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Grafana - Visualization and dashboards
  # ==========================================================================
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:11.4.0
    container_name: grafana
    environment:
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER=admin
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-admin}
      - GF_USERS_ALLOW_SIGN_UP=false
      - GF_SERVER_ROOT_URL=https://grafana.homelab.rambtech.dev
      - GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_ENABLED=false
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    volumes:
      - ./grafana/provisioning:/etc/grafana/provisioning:ro
      - ./grafana/dashboards:/var/lib/grafana/dashboards:ro
      - grafana_data:/var/lib/grafana
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:3000/api/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Uptime Kuma - HTTP endpoint monitoring and status page
  # ==========================================================================
  uptime-kuma:
    image: louislam/uptime-kuma:1
    container_name: uptime-kuma
    ports:
      - "3001:3001"
    volumes:
      - uptime_kuma_data:/app/data
    dns:
      - 192.168.1.196  # AdGuard DNS for local domain resolution
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -sf http://localhost:3001/ > /dev/null || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s

  # ==========================================================================
  # AutoKuma - Declarative monitor management for Uptime Kuma
  # Monitors defined in ./autokuma/monitors.json
  # ==========================================================================
  autokuma:
    image: ghcr.io/bigboot/autokuma:1.0.0
    container_name: autokuma
    environment:
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__URL=http://uptime-kuma:3001
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__USERNAME=${UPTIME_KUMA_USERNAME:-admin}
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__PASSWORD=${UPTIME_KUMA_PASSWORD}
      - AUTOKUMA__STATIC_MONITORS=/monitors/monitors.json
      - AUTOKUMA__DOCKER__ENABLED=false
    volumes:
      - ./autokuma/monitors.json:/monitors/monitors.json:ro
    depends_on:
      - uptime-kuma
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    # Healthcheck removed: AutoKuma is distroless Rust binary with no health endpoint
    # Container health monitored via Docker restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy - Push notifications
  # ==========================================================================
  ntfy:
    image: binwiederhier/ntfy:v2.11.0
    container_name: ntfy
    command:
      - serve
      - --cache-file=/var/cache/ntfy/cache.db
      - --attachment-cache-dir=/var/cache/ntfy/attachments
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    volumes:
      - ./ntfy/server.yml:/etc/ntfy/server.yml:ro
      - ntfy_cache:/var/cache/ntfy
      - ntfy_data:/var/lib/ntfy
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:80/v1/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy-discord-forwarder - Forward ntfy notifications to Discord
  # ==========================================================================
  ntfy-discord-forwarder:
    image: python:3.12-alpine
    container_name: ntfy-discord-forwarder
    command:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      - |
        pip install --no-cache-dir requests &&
        python3 -u << 'ENDSCRIPT'
        import requests
        import json
        import os

        NTFY_URL = "http://ntfy:80/homelab-alerts/json"
        DISCORD_WEBHOOK = os.environ["DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL"]

        print(f"Starting ntfy->Discord forwarder. Listening to {NTFY_URL}")
        for line in requests.get(NTFY_URL, stream=True).iter_lines():
            if line:
                data = json.loads(line)
                msg = data.get("message", "")
                if msg:
                    print(f"Forwarding: {msg}")
                    requests.post(DISCORD_WEBHOOK, json={"content": msg})
        ENDSCRIPT
    environment:
      - DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL=${DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL}
    depends_on:
      - ntfy
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 128m
          cpus: '0.25'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pgrep -f python3 || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    restart: unless-stopped

  alloy_data:
  prometheus_data:
  alertmanager_data:
  grafana_data:
  uptime_kuma_data:
  ntfy_cache:
  ntfy_data:

# Alertmanager Configuration
# Routes alerts to ntfy for centralized notification aggregation

global:
  resolve_timeout: 5m

# Route tree
route:
  group_by: ['alertname', 'severity']
  group_wait: 30s
  group_interval: 5m
  repeat_interval: 4h
  receiver: 'ntfy'

  routes:
    # Critical alerts - immediate notification with high priority
    - match:
        severity: critical
      receiver: 'ntfy-critical'
      group_wait: 10s
      repeat_interval: 1h

    # Warning alerts - batched notifications with default priority
    - match:
        severity: warning
      receiver: 'ntfy'
      group_wait: 1m
      repeat_interval: 4h

# Inhibition rules
inhibit_rules:
  # Inhibit warning if critical is firing for same alertname
  - source_match:
      severity: 'critical'
    target_match:
      severity: 'warning'
    equal: ['alertname', 'instance']

# Alertmanager Configuration
# Routes alerts to ntfy for centralized notification aggregation

global:
  resolve_timeout: 5m

# Route tree
route:
  group_by: ['alertname', 'severity']
  group_wait: 30s
  group_interval: 5m
  repeat_interval: 4h
  receiver: 'ntfy'

  routes:
    # Critical alerts - immediate notification with high priority
    - match:
        severity: critical
      receiver: 'ntfy-critical'
      group_wait: 10s
      repeat_interval: 1h

    # Warning alerts - batched notifications with default priority
    - match:
        severity: warning
      receiver: 'ntfy'
      group_wait: 1m
      repeat_interval: 4h

# Inhibition rules
inhibit_rules:
  # Inhibit warning if critical is firing for same alertname
  - source_match:
      severity: 'critical'
    target_match:
      severity: 'warning'
    equal: ['alertname', 'instance']

# Receivers
receivers:
  # ntfy receiver for warnings
  - name: 'ntfy'
    webhook_configs:
      # ntfy - centralized notification aggregator
      # Uses alertmanager.yml template (mounted in ntfy container)
      # See: https://docs.ntfy.sh/publish/#templates
      - url: 'http://ntfy:80/homelab-alerts?template=alertmanager&priority=default&tags=warning,homelab'
        send_resolved: true
        max_alerts: 10
        http_config:
          follow_redirects: true

  # ntfy receiver for critical alerts
  - name: 'ntfy-critical'
    webhook_configs:
      # ntfy with urgent priority and alertmanager template
      - url: 'http://ntfy:80/homelab-alerts?template=alertmanager&priority=urgent&tags=rotating_light,critical'
        send_resolved: true
        max_alerts: 10
        http_config:
          follow_redirects: true

# Templates for message formatting
templates:
  - '/etc/alertmanager/templates/*.tmpl'

          cpus: '0.5'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:3100/ready || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Grafana Alloy - Unified telemetry collector (replaces OTEL Collector)
  # ==========================================================================
  alloy:
    image: grafana/alloy:v1.5.1
    container_name: alloy
    command:
      - run
      - --server.http.listen-addr=0.0.0.0:12345
      - --storage.path=/var/lib/alloy/data
      - /etc/alloy/config.alloy
    ports:
      - "4317:4317"   # OTLP gRPC receiver (backwards compat)
      - "4318:4318"   # OTLP HTTP receiver (backwards compat)
      - "12345:12345" # Alloy UI
    volumes:
      - ./alloy/config.alloy:/etc/alloy/config.alloy:ro
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
      - /var/log:/var/log/host:ro
      - alloy_data:/var/lib/alloy/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
      - loki
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "-qO-", "http://localhost:12345/-/ready"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Prometheus - Metrics storage and alerting
  # ==========================================================================
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:v3.1.0
    container_name: prometheus
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml'
      - '--storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus'
      - '--storage.tsdb.retention.time=30d'
      - '--web.enable-lifecycle'
      - '--web.enable-remote-write-receiver'
      - '--web.external-url=https://prometheus.homelab.rambtech.dev'
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./prometheus/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro
      - ./prometheus/alerts:/etc/prometheus/alerts:ro
      - prometheus_data:/prometheus
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 4096m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '1.0'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:9090/-/healthy || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Alertmanager - Alert routing and notifications
  # ==========================================================================
  alertmanager:
    image: prom/alertmanager:v0.28.1
    container_name: alertmanager
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml'
      - '--storage.path=/alertmanager'
      - '--web.external-url=https://alertmanager.homelab.rambtech.dev'
    ports:
      - "9093:9093"
    volumes:
      - ./alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:ro
      - ./alertmanager/templates:/etc/alertmanager/templates:ro
      - alertmanager_data:/alertmanager
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:9093/-/healthy || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Grafana - Visualization and dashboards
  # ==========================================================================
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:11.4.0
    container_name: grafana
    environment:
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER=admin
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-admin}
      - GF_USERS_ALLOW_SIGN_UP=false
      - GF_SERVER_ROOT_URL=https://grafana.homelab.rambtech.dev
      - GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_ENABLED=false
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    volumes:
      - ./grafana/provisioning:/etc/grafana/provisioning:ro
      - ./grafana/dashboards:/var/lib/grafana/dashboards:ro
      - grafana_data:/var/lib/grafana
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:3000/api/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Uptime Kuma - HTTP endpoint monitoring and status page
  # ==========================================================================
  uptime-kuma:
    image: louislam/uptime-kuma:1
    container_name: uptime-kuma
    ports:
      - "3001:3001"
    volumes:
      - uptime_kuma_data:/app/data
    dns:
      - 192.168.1.196  # AdGuard DNS for local domain resolution
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -sf http://localhost:3001/ > /dev/null || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s

  # ==========================================================================
  # AutoKuma - Declarative monitor management for Uptime Kuma
  # Monitors defined in ./autokuma/monitors.json
  # ==========================================================================
  autokuma:
    image: ghcr.io/bigboot/autokuma:1.0.0
    container_name: autokuma
    environment:
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__URL=http://uptime-kuma:3001
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__USERNAME=${UPTIME_KUMA_USERNAME:-admin}
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__PASSWORD=${UPTIME_KUMA_PASSWORD}
      - AUTOKUMA__STATIC_MONITORS=/monitors/monitors.json
      - AUTOKUMA__DOCKER__ENABLED=false
    volumes:
      - ./autokuma/monitors.json:/monitors/monitors.json:ro
    depends_on:
      - uptime-kuma
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    # Healthcheck removed: AutoKuma is distroless Rust binary with no health endpoint
    # Container health monitored via Docker restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy - Push notifications
  # ==========================================================================
  ntfy:
    image: binwiederhier/ntfy:v2.11.0
    container_name: ntfy
    command:
      - serve
      - --cache-file=/var/cache/ntfy/cache.db
      - --attachment-cache-dir=/var/cache/ntfy/attachments
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    volumes:
      - ./ntfy/server.yml:/etc/ntfy/server.yml:ro
      - ./ntfy/templates:/etc/ntfy/templates:ro
      - ntfy_cache:/var/cache/ntfy
      - ntfy_data:/var/lib/ntfy
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:80/v1/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy-discord-forwarder - Forward ntfy notifications to Discord
  # ==========================================================================
  ntfy-discord-forwarder:
    image: python:3.12-alpine
    container_name: ntfy-discord-forwarder
    command:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      - |
        pip install --no-cache-dir requests &&
        python3 -u << 'ENDSCRIPT'
        import requests
        import json
        import os

        NTFY_URL = "http://ntfy:80/homelab-alerts/json"
        DISCORD_WEBHOOK = os.environ["DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL"]

        print(f"Starting ntfy->Discord forwarder. Listening to {NTFY_URL}")
        for line in requests.get(NTFY_URL, stream=True).iter_lines():
            if line:
                data = json.loads(line)
                msg = data.get("message", "")
                if msg:
                    print(f"Forwarding: {msg}")
                    requests.post(DISCORD_WEBHOOK, json={"content": msg})
        ENDSCRIPT
    environment:
      - DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL=${DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL}
    depends_on:
      - ntfy
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 128m
          cpus: '0.25'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pgrep -f python3 || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  loki_data:
  alloy_data:
  prometheus_data:
  alertmanager_data:
  grafana_data:
  uptime_kuma_data:
  ntfy_cache:
  ntfy_data:

# ==========================================================================
  # alertmanager-ntfy-formatter - Format Alertmanager webhooks for ntfy
  # ==========================================================================
  alertmanager-ntfy-formatter:
    image: python:3.12-alpine
    container_name: alertmanager-ntfy-formatter
    command:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      - |
        pip install --no-cache-dir flask requests &&
        python3 -u << 'ENDSCRIPT'
        from flask import Flask, request
        import requests
        import json

        app = Flask(__name__)

        @app.route("/webhook", methods=["POST"])
        def webhook():
            data = request.json
            status = data.get("status", "unknown")
            receiver = data.get("receiver", "unknown")
            alerts = data.get("alerts", [])

            if not alerts:
                return "No alerts", 200

            # Format title
            first_alert = alerts[0]
            alertname = first_alert.get("labels", {}).get("alertname", "Unknown")
            if status == "firing":
                title = f"🚨 Alert: {alertname}"
                priority = first_alert.get("labels", {}).get("severity") == "critical" and "urgent" or "default"
                tags = "critical,rotating_light" if priority == "urgent" else "warning,homelab"
            else:
                title = f"✅ Resolved: {alertname}"
                priority = "default"
                tags = "resolved,homelab"

            # Format message body
            message_lines = [f"Status: {status.title()}", f"Receiver: {receiver}", ""]
            for alert in alerts:
                labels = alert.get("labels", {})
                annotations = alert.get("annotations", {})
                message_lines.append(f"Alert: {labels.get('alertname', 'Unknown')}")
                message_lines.append(f"Instance: {labels.get('instance', 'N/A')}")
                message_lines.append(f"Severity: {labels.get('severity', 'N/A')}")
                message_lines.append(f"Starts at: {alert.get('startsAt', 'N/A')}")
                if alert.get("endsAt") and alert["endsAt"] != "0001-01-01T00:00:00Z":
                    message_lines.append(f"Ends at: {alert['endsAt']}")
                if annotations.get("summary"):
                    message_lines.append(f"Summary: {annotations['summary']}")
                if annotations.get("description"):
                    message_lines.append(f"Description: {annotations['description']}")
                if alert.get("generatorURL"):
                    message_lines.append(f"Source: {alert['generatorURL']}")
                message_lines.append("")

            message = "\n".join(message_lines)

            # Send to ntfy
            ntfy_url = f"http://ntfy:80/homelab-alerts?priority={priority}&tags={tags}"
            headers = {"Title": title}
            resp = requests.post(ntfy_url, data=message.encode('utf-8'), headers=headers)
            print(f"Formatted alert: {title} -> ntfy (status: {resp.status_code})")

            return "OK", 200

        app.run(host="0.0.0.0", port=5001)
        ENDSCRIPT
    ports:
      - "5001:5001"
    depends_on:
      - ntfy
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:

          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 128m
          cpus: '0.25'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:5001/ || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    restart: unless-stopped

# ==========================================================================
  # alertmanager-ntfy-formatter - Format Alertmanager webhooks for ntfy
  # ==========================================================================
  alertmanager-ntfy-formatter:
    image: python:3.12-alpine
    container_name: alertmanager-ntfy-formatter
    command:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      - |
        pip install --no-cache-dir flask requests &&
        python3 -u << 'ENDSCRIPT'
        from flask import Flask, request
        import requests
        import json

        app = Flask(__name__)

        @app.route("/webhook", methods=["POST"])
        def webhook():
            data = request.json
            status = data.get("status", "unknown")
            receiver = data.get("receiver", "unknown")
            alerts = data.get("alerts", [])

            if not alerts:
                return "No alerts", 200

            # Format title
            first_alert = alerts[0]
            alertname = first_alert.get("labels", {}).get("alertname", "Unknown")
            if status == "firing":
                title = f"🚨 Alert: {alertname}"
                priority = first_alert.get("labels", {}).get("severity") == "critical" and "urgent" or "default"
                tags = "critical,rotating_light" if priority == "urgent" else "warning,homelab"
            else:
                title = f"✅ Resolved: {alertname}"
                priority = "default"
                tags = "resolved,homelab"

            # Format message body
            message_lines = [f"Status: {status.title()}", f"Receiver: {receiver}", ""]
            for alert in alerts:
                labels = alert.get("labels", {})
                annotations = alert.get("annotations", {})
                message_lines.append(f"Alert: {labels.get('alertname', 'Unknown')}")
                message_lines.append(f"Instance: {labels.get('instance', 'N/A')}")
                message_lines.append(f"Severity: {labels.get('severity', 'N/A')}")
                message_lines.append(f"Starts at: {alert.get('startsAt', 'N/A')}")
                if alert.get("endsAt") and alert["endsAt"] != "0001-01-01T00:00:00Z":
                    message_lines.append(f"Ends at: {alert['endsAt']}")
                if annotations.get("summary"):
                    message_lines.append(f"Summary: {annotations['summary']}")
                if annotations.get("description"):
                    message_lines.append(f"Description: {annotations['description']}")
                if alert.get("generatorURL"):
                    message_lines.append(f"Source: {alert['generatorURL']}")
                message_lines.append("")

            message = "\n".join(message_lines)

            # Send to ntfy
            ntfy_url = f"http://ntfy:80/homelab-alerts?priority={priority}&tags={tags}"
            headers = {"Title": title}
            resp = requests.post(ntfy_url, data=message.encode('utf-8'), headers=headers)
            print(f"Formatted alert: {title} -> ntfy (status: {resp.status_code})")

            return "OK", 200

        app.run(host="0.0.0.0", port=5001)
        ENDSCRIPT
    ports:
      - "5001:5001"
    depends_on:
      - ntfy
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 128m
          cpus: '0.25'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:5001/ || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy-discord-forwarder - Forward ntfy notifications to Discord
  # ==========================================================================
  ntfy-discord-forwarder:
    image: python:3.12-alpine
    container_name: ntfy-discord-forwarder
    command:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      - |
        pip install --no-cache-dir requests &&
        python3 -u << 'ENDSCRIPT'
        import requests
        import json
        import os

        NTFY_URL = "http://ntfy:80/homelab-alerts/json"
        DISCORD_WEBHOOK = os.environ["DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL"]

        print(f"Starting ntfy->Discord forwarder. Listening to {NTFY_URL}")
        for line in requests.get(NTFY_URL, stream=True).iter_lines():
            if line:
                data = json.loads(line)
                msg = data.get("message", "")
                if msg:
                    print(f"Forwarding: {msg}")
                    requests.post(DISCORD_WEBHOOK, json={"content": msg})
        ENDSCRIPT
    environment:
      - DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL=${DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL}
    depends_on:
      - ntfy
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 128m
          cpus: '0.25'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pgrep -f python3 || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    restart: unless-stopped

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Loki - Log aggregation
  # ==========================================================================
  loki:
    image: grafana/loki:3.3.2
    container_name: loki
    command: -config.file=/etc/loki/local-config.yaml
    ports:
      - "3100:3100"
    volumes:
      - ./loki/config.yaml:/etc/loki/local-config.yaml:ro
      - loki_data:/loki
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:3100/ready || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Grafana Alloy - Unified telemetry collector (replaces OTEL Collector)
  # ==========================================================================
  alloy:
    image: grafana/alloy:v1.5.1
    container_name: alloy
    command:
      - run
      - --server.http.listen-addr=0.0.0.0:12345
      - --storage.path=/var/lib/alloy/data
      - /etc/alloy/config.alloy
    ports:
      - "4317:4317"   # OTLP gRPC receiver (backwards compat)
      - "4318:4318"   # OTLP HTTP receiver (backwards compat)
      - "12345:12345" # Alloy UI
    volumes:
      - ./alloy/config.alloy:/etc/alloy/config.alloy:ro
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
      - /var/log:/var/log/host:ro
      - alloy_data:/var/lib/alloy/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
      - loki
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "-qO-", "http://localhost:12345/-/ready"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Prometheus - Metrics storage and alerting
  # ==========================================================================
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:v3.1.0
    container_name: prometheus
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml'
      - '--storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus'
      - '--storage.tsdb.retention.time=30d'
      - '--web.enable-lifecycle'
      - '--web.enable-remote-write-receiver'
      - '--web.external-url=https://prometheus.homelab.rambtech.dev'
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./prometheus/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro
      - ./prometheus/alerts:/etc/prometheus/alerts:ro
      - prometheus_data:/prometheus
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 4096m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '1.0'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:9090/-/healthy || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Alertmanager - Alert routing and notifications
  # ==========================================================================
  alertmanager:
    image: prom/alertmanager:v0.28.1
    container_name: alertmanager
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml'
      - '--storage.path=/alertmanager'
      - '--web.external-url=https://alertmanager.homelab.rambtech.dev'
    ports:
      - "9093:9093"
    volumes:
      - ./alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:ro
      - ./alertmanager/templates:/etc/alertmanager/templates:ro
      - alertmanager_data:/alertmanager
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:9093/-/healthy || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Grafana - Visualization and dashboards
  # ==========================================================================
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:11.4.0
    container_name: grafana
    environment:
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER=admin
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-admin}
      - GF_USERS_ALLOW_SIGN_UP=false
      - GF_SERVER_ROOT_URL=https://grafana.homelab.rambtech.dev
      - GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_ENABLED=false
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    volumes:
      - ./grafana/provisioning:/etc/grafana/provisioning:ro
      - ./grafana/dashboards:/var/lib/grafana/dashboards:ro
      - grafana_data:/var/lib/grafana
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:3000/api/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Uptime Kuma - HTTP endpoint monitoring and status page
  # ==========================================================================
  uptime-kuma:
    image: louislam/uptime-kuma:1
    container_name: uptime-kuma
    ports:
      - "3001:3001"
    volumes:
      - uptime_kuma_data:/app/data
    dns:
      - 192.168.1.196  # AdGuard DNS for local domain resolution
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -sf http://localhost:3001/ > /dev/null || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s

  # ==========================================================================
  # AutoKuma - Declarative monitor management for Uptime Kuma
  # Monitors defined in ./autokuma/monitors.json
  # ==========================================================================
  autokuma:
    image: ghcr.io/bigboot/autokuma:1.0.0
    container_name: autokuma
    environment:
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__URL=http://uptime-kuma:3001
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__USERNAME=${UPTIME_KUMA_USERNAME:-admin}
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__PASSWORD=${UPTIME_KUMA_PASSWORD}
      - AUTOKUMA__STATIC_MONITORS=/monitors/monitors.json
      - AUTOKUMA__DOCKER__ENABLED=false
    volumes:
      - ./autokuma/monitors.json:/monitors/monitors.json:ro
    depends_on:
      - uptime-kuma
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    # Healthcheck removed: AutoKuma is distroless Rust binary with no health endpoint
    # Container health monitored via Docker restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================

    image: binwiederhier/ntfy:v2.11.0
    container_name: ntfy

      - serve

    ports:

      - ./ntfy/server.yml:/etc/ntfy/server.yml:ro

    deploy:

    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:80/v1/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s

# Alertmanager Configuration
# Routes alerts to ntfy for centralized notification aggregation

global:
  resolve_timeout: 5m

# Route tree
route:
  group_by: ['alertname', 'severity']
  group_wait: 30s
  group_interval: 5m
  repeat_interval: 4h
  receiver: 'ntfy'

  routes:
    # Critical alerts - immediate notification with high priority
    - match:
        severity: critical
      receiver: 'ntfy-critical'
      group_wait: 10s
      repeat_interval: 1h

    # Warning alerts - batched notifications with default priority
    - match:
        severity: warning
      receiver: 'ntfy'
      group_wait: 1m
      repeat_interval: 4h

# Inhibition rules
inhibit_rules:
  # Inhibit warning if critical is firing for same alertname
  - source_match:
      severity: 'critical'
    target_match:
      severity: 'warning'
    equal: ['alertname', 'instance']

# Receivers
receivers:
  # ntfy receiver for warnings
  - name: 'ntfy'
    webhook_configs:
      # ntfy - centralized notification aggregator
      # Uses Alertmanager templates to format messages before sending
      - url: 'http://ntfy:80/homelab-alerts?priority=default&tags=warning,homelab&title={{ template "ntfy.title" . | urlquery }}&message={{ template "ntfy.message" . | urlquery }}'
        send_resolved: true
        max_alerts: 10
        http_config:
          follow_redirects: true

      # ntfy with urgent priority and formatted message

        send_resolved: true
        max_alerts: 10
        http_config:
          follow_redirects: true

The user reported two issues after the Alloy/Loki deployment:

The core request was to fix the ntfy message formatting so alerts display in a structured, readable format instead of raw JSON payload.

## 2. Key Technical Concepts

- **ntfy**: Push notification server with template support for formatting webhooks
- **Alertmanager webhook receivers**: Send full JSON payload to configured URLs
- **ntfy message templating**: Uses `X-Template` HTTP header to specify template file (discovered via user-provided documentation)
- **Go templates in Alertmanager**: Only work in template files, not in webhook URLs
- **OpenTofu workflow**: Always use IaC, never manual file manipulation
- **Flask webhook transformer**: Python service to receive/format/forward webhooks
- **ntfy publishing API**: Supports custom headers for title, priority, tags, and templates

## 3. Files and Code Sections

### `/tofu/apps/monitoring/deploy/ntfy/server.yml`
- **Why**: Configuration file for ntfy server
- **Changes**: Added then removed `template-dir: "/etc/ntfy/templates"` (not needed with X-Template header approach)
- **Final state**: Back to original without template-dir

### `/tofu/apps/monitoring/deploy/ntfy/templates/alertmanager.yml` (created then deleted)
- **Why**: Attempted to use ntfy's server-side template feature
- **Content**: Official alertmanager template from ntfy GitHub repo
```yaml

  {{- if eq .status "firing" }}
  🚨 Alert: {{ (first .alerts).labels.alertname }}
  {{- else if eq .status "resolved" }}

message: |

```
- **Result**: Deleted after learning this approach doesn't work

- **Changes**: Added ntfy.title and ntfy.message Go template definitions

```go
{{ if eq .Status "firing" }}🚨 Alert: {{ (index .Alerts 0).Labels.alertname }}{{ else }}✅ Resolved: {{ (index .Alerts 0).Labels.alertname }}{{ end }}
{{- end }}

{{ define "ntfy.message" -}}
Status: {{ .Status | title }}

Alert: {{ .Labels.alertname }}
Instance: {{ .Labels.instance }}

{{- end }}
```
- **Result**: These templates can't be used in webhook URLs (templates don't evaluate in URL field)

### Error 1: ntfy `?template=alertmanager` parameter didn't work

- **Test result**: Still received raw JSON
- **Root cause**: The `?template=` parameter is not how ntfy templates work

- **Problem**: Tried to embed Go templates in webhook URL: `?title={{ template "ntfy.title" . | urlquery }}`

# Alertmanager Configuration
# Routes alerts to ntfy for centralized notification aggregation

global:
  resolve_timeout: 5m

# Route tree
route:
  group_by: ['alertname', 'severity']
  group_wait: 30s
  group_interval: 5m
  repeat_interval: 4h
  receiver: 'ntfy'

  routes:
    # Critical alerts - immediate notification with high priority
    - match:
        severity: critical
      receiver: 'ntfy-critical'
      group_wait: 10s
      repeat_interval: 1h

    # Warning alerts - batched notifications with default priority
    - match:
        severity: warning
      receiver: 'ntfy'
      group_wait: 1m
      repeat_interval: 4h

# Inhibition rules
inhibit_rules:
  # Inhibit warning if critical is firing for same alertname
  - source_match:
      severity: 'critical'
    target_match:
      severity: 'warning'
    equal: ['alertname', 'instance']

# Receivers
receivers:
  # ntfy receiver for warnings
  - name: 'ntfy'
    webhook_configs:
      # ntfy with template header to format Alertmanager webhooks
      - url: 'http://ntfy:80/homelab-alerts?priority=default&tags=warning,homelab'
        send_resolved: true
        max_alerts: 10
        http_config:
          follow_redirects: true
        # Tell ntfy to use the alertmanager template
        http_config:
          headers:
            X-Template: 'alertmanager'

  # ntfy receiver for critical alerts
  - name: 'ntfy-critical'
    webhook_configs:
      # ntfy with template header to format Alertmanager webhooks
      - url: 'http://ntfy:80/homelab-alerts?priority=urgent&tags=rotating_light,critical'
        send_resolved: true
        max_alerts: 10
        http_config:
          follow_redirects: true
          headers:
            X-Template: 'alertmanager'

# Templates for message formatting
templates:
  - '/etc/alertmanager/templates/*.tmpl'

I found several examples of Alertmanager webhook configurations with authorization headers. Here's what I found:

## Bearer Token Authorization Examples

Alertmanager supports `bearer_token` and `bearer_token_file` options for setting the Authorization header with bearer tokens.

### Example 1: Using bearer_token in http_config

Here's a complete example with bearer token authorization:

```yaml
route:
  receiver: default
  group_by:
  - job
  routes:
  - receiver: rootly
    match:
      alertname: Rootly
    repeat_interval: 1m
receivers:
- name: rootly
  webhook_configs:
  - url: 'https://webhooks.rootly.com/webhooks/incoming/alertmanager_webhooks'
    send_resolved: true
    http_config:
      authorization:
        type: Bearer
        credentials: a0b9fcad1aae0689cfa05c17df497b2bc5c56d26d3e253503438864dbd6697ee
```


### Example 2: Alternative bearer_token syntax

From the Prometheus documentation, you can use either the `authorization` config or the `bearer_token` field directly in `http_config`:

```yaml
http_config:
  # Sets the `Authorization` header with the configured bearer token.
  bearer_token: <secret>
  # Sets the `Authorization` header with the bearer token read from the configured file.
  bearer_token_file: <filepath>
```


### Example 3: Basic Auth (for comparison)

Here's an example using BasicAuth instead of bearer tokens:

```yaml
receivers:
- name: "alerta"
  webhook_configs:
  - url: 'http://alerta:8080/api/webhooks/prometheus'
    send_resolved: true
    http_config:
      basic_auth:
        username: admin@alerta.io
        password: alerta
```


**Important Notes:**
- `basic_auth`, `bearer_token` and `bearer_token_file` options are mutually exclusive
- The `http_config` field is available for webhook receivers to configure HTTP client settings

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Loki - Log aggregation
  # ==========================================================================
  loki:
    image: grafana/loki:3.3.2
    container_name: loki
    command: -config.file=/etc/loki/local-config.yaml
    ports:
      - "3100:3100"
    volumes:
      - ./loki/config.yaml:/etc/loki/local-config.yaml:ro
      - loki_data:/loki
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:3100/ready || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Grafana Alloy - Unified telemetry collector (replaces OTEL Collector)
  # ==========================================================================
  alloy:
    image: grafana/alloy:v1.5.1
    container_name: alloy
    command:
      - run
      - --server.http.listen-addr=0.0.0.0:12345
      - --storage.path=/var/lib/alloy/data
      - /etc/alloy/config.alloy
    ports:
      - "4317:4317"   # OTLP gRPC receiver (backwards compat)
      - "4318:4318"   # OTLP HTTP receiver (backwards compat)
      - "12345:12345" # Alloy UI
    volumes:
      - ./alloy/config.alloy:/etc/alloy/config.alloy:ro
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
      - /var/log:/var/log/host:ro
      - alloy_data:/var/lib/alloy/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
      - loki
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "-qO-", "http://localhost:12345/-/ready"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Prometheus - Metrics storage and alerting
  # ==========================================================================
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:v3.1.0
    container_name: prometheus
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml'
      - '--storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus'
      - '--storage.tsdb.retention.time=30d'
      - '--web.enable-lifecycle'
      - '--web.enable-remote-write-receiver'
      - '--web.external-url=https://prometheus.homelab.rambtech.dev'
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./prometheus/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro
      - ./prometheus/alerts:/etc/prometheus/alerts:ro
      - prometheus_data:/prometheus
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 4096m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '1.0'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:9090/-/healthy || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Alertmanager - Alert routing and notifications
  # ==========================================================================
  alertmanager:
    image: prom/alertmanager:v0.28.1
    container_name: alertmanager
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml'
      - '--storage.path=/alertmanager'
      - '--web.external-url=https://alertmanager.homelab.rambtech.dev'
    ports:
      - "9093:9093"
    volumes:
      - ./alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:ro
      - ./alertmanager/templates:/etc/alertmanager/templates:ro
      - alertmanager_data:/alertmanager
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:9093/-/healthy || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Grafana - Visualization and dashboards
  # ==========================================================================
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:11.4.0
    container_name: grafana
    environment:
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER=admin
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-admin}
      - GF_USERS_ALLOW_SIGN_UP=false
      - GF_SERVER_ROOT_URL=https://grafana.homelab.rambtech.dev
      - GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_ENABLED=false
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    volumes:
      - ./grafana/provisioning:/etc/grafana/provisioning:ro
      - ./grafana/dashboards:/var/lib/grafana/dashboards:ro
      - grafana_data:/var/lib/grafana
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:3000/api/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Uptime Kuma - HTTP endpoint monitoring and status page
  # ==========================================================================
  uptime-kuma:
    image: louislam/uptime-kuma:1
    container_name: uptime-kuma
    ports:
      - "3001:3001"
    volumes:
      - uptime_kuma_data:/app/data
    dns:
      - 192.168.1.196  # AdGuard DNS for local domain resolution
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -sf http://localhost:3001/ > /dev/null || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s

  # ==========================================================================
  # AutoKuma - Declarative monitor management for Uptime Kuma
  # Monitors defined in ./autokuma/monitors.json
  # ==========================================================================
  autokuma:
    image: ghcr.io/bigboot/autokuma:1.0.0
    container_name: autokuma
    environment:
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__URL=http://uptime-kuma:3001
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__USERNAME=${UPTIME_KUMA_USERNAME:-admin}
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__PASSWORD=${UPTIME_KUMA_PASSWORD}
      - AUTOKUMA__STATIC_MONITORS=/monitors/monitors.json
      - AUTOKUMA__DOCKER__ENABLED=false
    volumes:
      - ./autokuma/monitors.json:/monitors/monitors.json:ro
    depends_on:
      - uptime-kuma
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    # Healthcheck removed: AutoKuma is distroless Rust binary with no health endpoint
    # Container health monitored via Docker restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy - Push notifications
  # ==========================================================================
  ntfy:
    image: binwiederhier/ntfy:v2.11.0
    container_name: ntfy
    command:
      - serve
      - --cache-file=/var/cache/ntfy/cache.db
      - --attachment-cache-dir=/var/cache/ntfy/attachments
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    volumes:
      - ./ntfy/server.yml:/etc/ntfy/server.yml:ro
      - ntfy_cache:/var/cache/ntfy
      - ntfy_data:/var/lib/ntfy
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:80/v1/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  # ==========================================================================
  # alertmanager-ntfy-formatter - Format Alertmanager webhooks for ntfy
  # ==========================================================================
  alertmanager-ntfy-formatter:
    image: python:3.12-alpine
    container_name: alertmanager-ntfy-formatter
    command:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      - |
        pip install --no-cache-dir flask requests &&
        python3 -u << 'ENDSCRIPT'
        from flask import Flask, request
        import requests
        import json

        app = Flask(__name__)

        @app.route("/webhook", methods=["POST"])
        def webhook():
            data = request.json
            status = data.get("status", "unknown")
            receiver = data.get("receiver", "unknown")
            alerts = data.get("alerts", [])

            if not alerts:
                return "No alerts", 200

            # Format title
            first_alert = alerts[0]
            alertname = first_alert.get("labels", {}).get("alertname", "Unknown")
            if status == "firing":
                title = f"🚨 Alert: {alertname}"
                priority = first_alert.get("labels", {}).get("severity") == "critical" and "urgent" or "default"
                tags = "critical,rotating_light" if priority == "urgent" else "warning,homelab"
            else:
                title = f"✅ Resolved: {alertname}"
                priority = "default"
                tags = "resolved,homelab"

            # Format message body
            message_lines = [f"Status: {status.title()}", f"Receiver: {receiver}", ""]
            for alert in alerts:
                labels = alert.get("labels", {})
                annotations = alert.get("annotations", {})
                message_lines.append(f"Alert: {labels.get('alertname', 'Unknown')}")
                message_lines.append(f"Instance: {labels.get('instance', 'N/A')}")
                message_lines.append(f"Severity: {labels.get('severity', 'N/A')}")
                message_lines.append(f"Starts at: {alert.get('startsAt', 'N/A')}")
                if alert.get("endsAt") and alert["endsAt"] != "0001-01-01T00:00:00Z":
                    message_lines.append(f"Ends at: {alert['endsAt']}")
                if annotations.get("summary"):
                    message_lines.append(f"Summary: {annotations['summary']}")
                if annotations.get("description"):
                    message_lines.append(f"Description: {annotations['description']}")
                if alert.get("generatorURL"):
                    message_lines.append(f"Source: {alert['generatorURL']}")
                message_lines.append("")

            message = "\n".join(message_lines)

            # Send to ntfy
            ntfy_url = f"http://ntfy:80/homelab-alerts?priority={priority}&tags={tags}"
            headers = {"Title": title}
            resp = requests.post(ntfy_url, data=message.encode('utf-8'), headers=headers)
            print(f"Formatted alert: {title} -> ntfy (status: {resp.status_code})")

            return "OK", 200

        app.run(host="0.0.0.0", port=5001)
        ENDSCRIPT
    ports:
      - "5001:5001"
    depends_on:
      - ntfy
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 128m
          cpus: '0.25'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:5001/ || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy-discord-forwarder - Forward ntfy notifications to Discord
  # ==========================================================================
  ntfy-discord-forwarder:
    image: python:3.12-alpine
    container_name: ntfy-discord-forwarder
    command:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      - |
        pip install --no-cache-dir requests &&
        python3 -u << 'ENDSCRIPT'
        import requests
        import json
        import os

        NTFY_URL = "http://ntfy:80/homelab-alerts/json"
        DISCORD_WEBHOOK = os.environ["DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL"]

        print(f"Starting ntfy->Discord forwarder. Listening to {NTFY_URL}")
        for line in requests.get(NTFY_URL, stream=True).iter_lines():
            if line:
                data = json.loads(line)
                msg = data.get("message", "")
                if msg:

# Alertmanager Configuration
# Routes alerts to ntfy for centralized notification aggregation

global:
  resolve_timeout: 5m

# Route tree
route:
  group_by: ['alertname', 'severity']
  group_wait: 30s
  group_interval: 5m
  repeat_interval: 4h
  receiver: 'ntfy'

  routes:
    # Critical alerts - immediate notification with high priority
    - match:
        severity: critical
      receiver: 'ntfy-critical'
      group_wait: 10s
      repeat_interval: 1h

    # Warning alerts - batched notifications with default priority
    - match:
        severity: warning
      receiver: 'ntfy'
      group_wait: 1m
      repeat_interval: 4h

# Inhibition rules
inhibit_rules:
  # Inhibit warning if critical is firing for same alertname
  - source_match:
      severity: 'critical'
    target_match:
      severity: 'warning'
    equal: ['alertname', 'instance']

# Receivers
receivers:
  # ntfy receiver for warnings
  - name: 'ntfy'
    webhook_configs:
      # ntfy with template header to format Alertmanager webhooks
      - url: 'http://ntfy:80/homelab-alerts?priority=default&tags=warning,homelab'
        send_resolved: true
        max_alerts: 10
        http_config:

          headers:
            X-Template: 'alertmanager'

      - url: 'http://ntfy:80/homelab-alerts?priority=urgent&tags=rotating_light,critical'
        send_resolved: true
        max_alerts: 10
        http_config:
          follow_redirects: true
          headers:
            X-Template: 'alertmanager'

# Templates for message formatting
templates:
  - '/etc/alertmanager/templates/*.tmpl'

# Alertmanager Configuration
# Routes alerts to ntfy for centralized notification aggregation

global:
  resolve_timeout: 5m

# Route tree
route:
  group_by: ['alertname', 'severity']
  group_wait: 30s
  group_interval: 5m
  repeat_interval: 4h
  receiver: 'ntfy'

  routes:
    # Critical alerts - immediate notification with high priority
    - match:
        severity: critical
      receiver: 'ntfy-critical'
      group_wait: 10s
      repeat_interval: 1h

    # Warning alerts - batched notifications with default priority
    - match:
        severity: warning
      receiver: 'ntfy'
      group_wait: 1m
      repeat_interval: 4h

# Inhibition rules
inhibit_rules:
  # Inhibit warning if critical is firing for same alertname
  - source_match:
      severity: 'critical'
    target_match:
      severity: 'warning'
    equal: ['alertname', 'instance']

# Receivers
receivers:
  # ntfy receiver for warnings (via formatter service)
  - name: 'ntfy'
    webhook_configs:
      # Send to formatter service which will format and forward to ntfy
      - url: 'http://alertmanager-ntfy-formatter:5001/webhook'
        send_resolved: true
        max_alerts: 10
        http_config:
          http_headers:
            X-Template: 
              values: ['alertmanager']
          follow_redirects: true

  # ntfy receiver for critical alerts (via formatter service)
  - name: 'ntfy-critical'
    webhook_configs:
      # Send to formatter service which will format and forward to ntfy
      - url: 'http://alertmanager-ntfy-formatter:5001/webhook'
        send_resolved: true
        max_alerts: 10
        http_config:
          http_headers:
            X-Template: 
              values: ['alertmanager']
          follow_redirects: true

# Templates for message formatting
templates:
  - '/etc/alertmanager/templates/*.tmpl'
